paper.title: Scaling Laws, Tabular Data and Actuarial Ratemaking Models
paper.abstract: Scaling laws in modern deep learning describe how held-out loss improves as model capacity, training data, and compute increase, often following power-law trends. We investigate whether analogous scaling regularities arise in actuarial ratemaking, where data are tabular, heterogeneous, and noisy, and where classical models such as GLMs remain strong baselines. Using a real-world motor insurance portfolio, we train models from different families across increasing fractions of the training data an

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文把 scaling law 的经验框架迁移到精算费率建模，研究在表格、异质、噪声较强的保险数据上，模型性能是否会随训练数据规模呈现可拟合的幂律趋势。核心任务是车险 claim frequency 预测，评估指标是 out-of-sample Poisson deviance。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 预训练的相关性较弱，因为它不是语言模型、通用表征、训练目标或大规模优化问题。但它有一个可借鉴点：scaling law 不应被理解成只属于 Transformer 语言建模的现象，而是一个关于数据规模、模型类、不可约误差和边际收益的统计工具。对预训练研究的启发主要在方法论层面：不同数据分布和模型族会有不同 exponent 与 loss floor；在高噪声、低信噪比任务中，增加数据可能改善 held-out likelihood，但收益斜率和饱和点会强依赖模型类。
summary.technical_approach: 论文以真实车险组合数据为实验对象，将“数据规模”定义为训练使用的 policy-period records 数量，并用 exposure-years 作为精算语境下的样本量参照。任务选择 claim frequency，而不是 severity，因为 frequency 对每个 policy-period 都有观测，适合做数据规模扫描。模型族覆盖传统统计模型和深度模型两端：GLM、正则化 GLM、feed-forward neural networks，以及表格 Transformer / TabM 一类更复杂架构。评估使用 Poisson deviance，因为频数目标可建模为 exposure-adjusted Poisson mean，deviance 对应 held-out log-likelihood 的差异。scaling law 形式沿用 L∞ 加幂律项的设定，用数据量、参数量或计算量解释 held-out loss 的下降。
summary.experiments: 实验设计是在多个训练数据比例和多个随机种子上训练不同模型族，并比较 out-of-sample Poisson deviance 随数据增加的变化。摘要给出的主要结果是：所有模型族都会从更多数据中受益，但 scaling exponent 差异明显，说明模型类决定了边际收益速度和可能的饱和行为。文中动机部分强调 GLM 在小到中等数据区间可能仍是强基线，而深度表格模型在较大数据区间可能继续获得收益。可见内容没有提供可核验的具体样本量、参数规模、deviance 数值或 exponent 拟合值，因此不宜补写数字。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 10 到 15 分钟。对 LLM 预训练研究者，重点看 scaling-law 设定、数据规模定义、Poisson deviance 作为 likelihood loss 的解释，以及不同模型族 exponent 的拟合结果表。精算定价业务背景、premium adequacy、loss ratio 和利润解释可以略读。需要保持边界感：这篇更像是 scaling-law 工具在表格保险数据上的案例研究，不应直接外推到 token-level LM loss 或 Chinchilla-style compute-optimal scaling。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper applies the scaling-law framework to actuarial ratemaking on noisy heterogeneous tabular data. It studies whether held-out Poisson deviance for motor insurance claim-frequency prediction follows predictable trends as the amount of training data increases.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to LLM pretraining is limited, since the work is not about language modeling, representation learning, tokenizer design, or large-scale optimization. The useful connection is methodological. Scaling laws are treated as empirical loss-resource relationships rather than as a property unique to decoder-only Transformers. The paper also highlights a point that matters for pretraining studies: exponents and irreducible loss floors depend strongly on the data distribution, noise level, target, and model family. In low signal-to-noise tabular regimes, more data can still help, but the slope and saturation behavior may differ sharply across model classes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses a real motor insurance portfolio and defines data size as the number of policy-period records used for training, with exposure-years serving as an actuarial analogue of example count. The target is claim frequency rather than claim severity, because frequency is observed for every policy-period record and is therefore better suited to controlled data-scaling experiments. The compared model families include classical GLMs, regularized GLM variants, feed-forward neural networks, and more complex tabular architectures such as tabular Transformers or TabM-style models. The loss is out-of-sample Poisson deviance, which is appropriate because each prediction is an exposure-adjusted Poisson mean and deviance corresponds to a likelihood-based held-out loss. The scaling-law framing follows an irreducible-loss-plus-power-law form, with terms for resources such as data size, model capacity, or compute.
summary_en.experiments: The experimental plan trains multiple model families across increasing fractions of the training set and multiple random seeds, then evaluates held-out Poisson deviance. The abstract reports that all model families improve with more data, but their scaling exponents differ substantially. This implies that the marginal return to more data is model-dependent, and that classical GLMs and deep tabular models may occupy different regimes. The provided content does not expose the exact portfolio size, fitted exponent values, parameter counts, or deviance improvements, so those numbers should be checked directly in the empirical results tables before drawing operational conclusions.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 10- to 15-minute skim is sufficient for an LLM pretraining reader. Focus on the scaling-law formulation, the operational definition of data size, the use of Poisson deviance as a likelihood loss, and the tables or figures that fit exponents for each model family. The actuarial pricing discussion around premium adequacy, loss ratio, and profit can be skimmed unless the application domain matters. The main caution is not to map the results directly onto token-level LM scaling; this is a tabular, noisy, domain-specific setting with different targets and loss geometry.

recommendation.zh: 将 Scaling Law 拓展到表格数据（精算领域），发现不同架构（如 TabM vs 纯 Transformer）的 scaling 指数差异巨大，对关注跨模态/跨领域 scaling 普适性的研究员有一定参考价值。
recommendation.en: Extends Scaling Laws to tabular data (actuarial domain), finding significant differences in scaling exponents across architectures (e.g., TabM vs. pure Transformer); offers reference value for researchers interested in the universality of scaling across modalities/domains.

paper.title: Coupled Scaling: A Representational Accessibility Framework for Neural Scaling Laws
paper.abstract: Existing theories derive neural scaling from data geometry or a specified data-model spectrum, but systems trained on the same data can scale differently when architecture or optimization changes the representations they can efficiently reach. We introduce Coupled Scaling, a task-conditioned framework in which finite-budget scaling depends on the relation between task structure and the geometry accessible to an architecture-optimization system. In a solvable mode-truncation model, loss separates

summary.core_problem: 解释为什么同一数据集上的模型，在架构或优化器不同的情况下，会呈现不同的 scaling law。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 scaling law 理论框架。它把有限预算下的扩展性能从“数据几何单独决定”改写为“任务结构、架构可达表示、优化顺序共同决定”，对理解非 Transformer、MoE、优化器变更后的 scaling 偏移有概念价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Coupled Scaling，一个任务条件化的 representational accessibility 框架。论文用可解的 mode-truncation 模型把损失分解为两部分：架构支持之外的目标能量，以及架构支持内但尚未解析的尾部。对于任意优先级顺序，残差指数被夹在由 supported tail 和 completed high-value prefix 决定的区间内，并给出由覆盖率 log-rate 与累积尾部 log-rate 相乘得到的有限预算 scaling 指数。
summary.experiments: 摘要主要描述理论模型和可解情形，没有给出大规模 LLM 训练实验。关键结果是残差指数位于 [ρ_{A,O,T}γ_{A,T}, γ_{A,T}]，在 bounded off-prefix gain 条件下由 completed prefix 决定，即 α_{A,O,T}=ρ_{A,O,T}γ_{A,T}。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why systems trained on the same data can obey different scaling behavior when the architecture or optimizer changes the representations they can efficiently reach.
summary_en.importance: It contributes a theoretical scaling-law framework rather than an empirical LLM recipe. The useful idea is to make finite-budget scaling depend on task structure, accessible representation geometry, and optimization order, which is relevant when comparing Transformers, MoE, SSMs, or optimizer changes.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces Coupled Scaling, a task-conditioned representational accessibility framework. In a solvable mode-truncation model, the loss is decomposed into target energy outside architectural support and an unresolved supported tail. For arbitrary priority orderings, the residual is bounded between the best-N supported tail and the tail beyond the largest completed high-value prefix; under bounded off-prefix gain, the completed prefix determines the observed exponent.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract presents a theoretical construction rather than large-scale LLM experiments. The central quantitative statement is that the residual exponent lies in [ρ_{A,O,T}γ_{A,T}, γ_{A,T}], and under bounded off-prefix gain becomes α_{A,O,T}=ρ_{A,O,T}γ_{A,T}.

recommendation.zh: 理论味较重；只看指数夹逼和 accessibility 定义，可作为解释架构更换后 scaling 漂移的备查。
recommendation.en: Theory-heavy; read the exponent bound and accessibility definition only, useful as a reference for scaling shifts under architecture changes.

paper.title: Momentum in large-batch training: Polyak enlarges the critical batch size, Nesterov improves data efficiency
paper.abstract: We study when and how momentum improves large-batch training in the one-pass regime, using power-law kernel regression as a tractable setting. We first characterize risk stability through the critical learning rate, defined as the largest learning rate for stable training, and obtain $\eta_{\mathrm{SGD}}^{\mathrm{crit}}\eqsim 1$, $\eta_{\mathrm{Polyak}}^{\mathrm{crit}}\eqsim \min\{1,B(1-\rho)\}$, and $\eta_{\mathrm{Nesterov}}^{\mathrm{crit}}\eqsim \min\{1,B^\beta(1-\rho)\}$, where $B$ is the bat

summary.core_problem: 在一次遍历数据的大 batch 训练中，解释 Polyak momentum 与 Nesterov momentum 分别如何改变稳定学习率、临界 batch size 和数据效率。
summary.importance: 这是训练动力学与 scaling 分析工作。它不直接训练 LLM，但讨论的问题贴近大规模预训练：当 batch 变大、数据预算固定时，动量到底是在扩大稳定区间，还是在提升样本利用率。
summary.technical_approach: 论文使用 power-law kernel regression 作为可解析模型，定义 risk stability 下的 critical learning rate，并推导 SGD、Polyak、Nesterov 三种优化器的稳定学习率量级：SGD 为常数级，Polyak 与 B(1-rho) 相关，Nesterov 与 B^beta(1-rho) 相关。随后在固定数据预算下优化最终风险，得到三阶段 batch-size 相图。
summary.experiments: 摘要呈现的是理论结果而非大模型实测。核心结果包括 eta_SGD^crit 约为 1，eta_Polyak^crit 约为 min{1, B(1-rho)}，eta_Nesterov^crit 约为 min{1, B^beta(1-rho)}；并刻画从早期 transient、power-law decay 到 noise floor 的风险动态。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how Polyak and Nesterov momentum affect stable learning rates, critical batch size, and data efficiency in one-pass large-batch training.
summary_en.importance: This is a training-dynamics and scaling-law analysis. It does not train LLMs, but the question is relevant to pretraining: under a fixed data budget, does momentum mainly enlarge the stable batch regime or improve sample efficiency?
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors analyze power-law kernel regression as a tractable model, define the critical learning rate for risk stability, and derive stability scalings for SGD, Polyak momentum, and Nesterov momentum. They then optimize final-step risk over admissible learning rates and momentum factors to obtain a three-regime batch-size phase diagram.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports theoretical rather than large-scale empirical results. Key scalings include eta_SGD^crit around 1, eta_Polyak^crit around min{1, B(1-rho)}, and eta_Nesterov^crit around min{1, B^beta(1-rho)}, together with risk dynamics from transient behavior to power-law decay and a noise floor.

recommendation.zh: 只看相图和临界学习率推导；它不会替代 LLM ablation，但能校准对大 batch momentum 的直觉。
recommendation.en: Read the phase diagram and critical-LR derivation; it will not replace LLM ablations, but it sharpens intuition about momentum at large batch.

paper.title: SMELT: Scaling Laws for Compute-Matched MoE Looped Transformers
paper.abstract: Looped Transformers increase effective depth by iterating a shared block of layers, but most evaluations compare at fixed model size, conflating architectural advantage with extra FLOPs. We study looping on Mixture-of-Experts Transformers while closely matching per-token FLOPs, total non-embedding parameters, and KV cache. Through a series of ablations, we arrive at a recipe we call SMELT (Sparse MoE Transformer, middle layers Loop Twice), which loops the middle half of layers twice while matchi

summary.core_problem: Looped Transformers（循环 Transformer）通过重复执行同一组层来增加有效深度，但以往评估通常在固定参数量下进行，导致架构优势与额外的计算量（FLOPs）混淆。本文旨在严格控制计算预算（单 token FLOPs、非 embedding 参数量、KV cache 大小）的前提下，探究循环架构是否真正具备优势，并推导其 Scaling Law。
summary.importance: 这是首个在严格的“三预算对齐”（FLOPs、参数量、KV Cache）下验证 Looped Transformer 优势的工作。它证明了在同等计算和显存开销下，循环架构不仅能降低 Loss，而且在 Scaling Law 上表现出更陡峭的下降趋势，为未来高效大模型架构设计（特别是结合 MoE）提供了极具价值的实证依据。
summary.technical_approach: 作者利用 MoE 架构解耦参数量和 FLOPs 的特性来实现预算对齐：循环带来的额外计算量通过减小隐藏层维度来补偿；减小维度损失的参数量通过增加 MoE 专家数量来弥补；KV cache 的对齐则通过调整注意力头大小和 GQA 比例实现。通过消融实验，作者提出 SMELT（Sparse MoE Transformer, middle layers Loop Twice）配方：1) 仅循环中间一半的层；2) 赋予循环模型比基线更大的有效深度/宽度比；3) 循环 2 次（而非 3 或 4 次）。
summary.experiments: 在高达 54B 非 embedding 参数的四个规模上训练 SMELT 和基线模型。结果显示，SMELT 在所有规模和稀疏度下均取得更低的验证 Loss。拟合的 Chinchilla 风格 Scaling Law 表明，SMELT 的 Loss 随计算量下降更快，在计算最优前沿上可节省 6.8%–18.0% 的训练 FLOPs。在 DCLM 和 MMLU 评测中，SMELT 几乎在所有对齐组中胜出，且在代码数据、长上下文和多样本 ICL 任务上优势更明显。机制分析发现，第二次循环放大了第一次的残差更新，注意力机制将权重从 attention sink 转移到内容相关的 token 上。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Section 3 的预算对齐方法（这是本文最核心的实验设计基础）和 SMELT 配方的推导过程。Section 4 的 Scaling Law 拟合结果（图表）直观展示了计算效率的提升。Section 6 的机制分析（特别是第二次循环时注意力权重的转移）对理解循环架构的工作原理很有启发。

summary_en.core_problem: Looped Transformers increase effective depth by repeating layers, but prior evaluations often fix parameter count, conflating architectural benefits with extra FLOPs. This paper investigates whether looping offers genuine advantages when strictly matching compute budgets (per-token FLOPs, non-embedding parameters, and KV cache size) and derives scaling laws for this architecture.
summary_en.importance: This is the first work to validate the advantages of Looped Transformers under strict 'triple-budget matching' (FLOPs, parameters, KV Cache). It demonstrates that under equal compute and memory costs, looped architectures not only achieve lower loss but also exhibit a steeper scaling law, providing highly valuable empirical evidence for future efficient LLM architecture design, especially when combined with MoE.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors leverage the decoupling of parameters and FLOPs in MoE architectures to achieve budget matching: the extra compute from looping is offset by reducing the hidden dimension; the lost parameter capacity is recovered by increasing the number of MoE experts; KV cache parity is restored by adjusting head size and GQA ratio. Through ablations, they propose SMELT (Sparse MoE Transformer, middle layers Loop Twice): 1) loop only the middle half of layers; 2) use a larger effective depth-to-width ratio than the baseline; 3) loop twice (instead of 3 or 4 times).
summary_en.experiments: SMELT and baselines were trained across four scales up to 54B non-embedding parameters. SMELT achieved lower validation loss at all scales and sparsity levels. Fitted Chinchilla-style scaling laws show SMELT's loss drops faster with compute, saving 6.8%–18.0% training FLOPs on the compute-optimal frontier. On DCLM and MMLU, SMELT outperformed baselines in nearly all matched pairs, with more pronounced gains on code, long contexts, and multi-shot ICL. Mechanistic analysis reveals the second loop amplifies the first's residual updates and shifts attention weights from sinks to content-relevant tokens.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the budget matching methodology (the foundation of the experimental design) and the derivation of the SMELT recipe. Section 4's scaling law results visually demonstrate the compute efficiency gains. Section 6's mechanistic analysis, particularly the shift in attention weights during the second loop, provides insightful intuition into how looped architectures function.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得立刻进内部 ablation：它把 looped 架构最常见的比较污染基本清干净了；先看 scaling fit 和 code/long-context 增益，若你做 MoE，prior 应该更新。
recommendation.en: This is worth immediate internal ablation: it removes the usual confounds in looped-architecture comparisons; start with the scaling fits and the code/long-context gains—if you work on MoE, your prior should move.

paper.title: Deriving Scaling Laws for OpenEuroLLM Models: Learning Rate, Batch Size and Loss
paper.abstract: We study the scaling behavior of learning rate and batch size in pretraining dense large language models on English-prevalent corpora. Beyond scaling \textit{jointly optimal} learning rates and batch sizes, we investigate their \textit{marginal} evolution with model capacity and data scale and develop a model that captures these relationships. As we employ a Warmup-Stable-Decay learning rate schedule, we further investigate the gains from learning rate annealing over a broad range of hyperparame

summary.core_problem: 在预训练密集型大语言模型时，学习率、批大小和损失函数如何随模型容量和数据规模进行扩展（Scaling）？
summary.importance: 系统研究了预训练超参数（学习率、批大小）的 Scaling 行为，特别是它们随模型和数据规模的边际演变，并评估了 WSD (Warmup-Stable-Decay) 调度下的退火增益，为开源 LLM 预训练提供了重要的经验指导。
summary.technical_approach: 通过在不同模型容量和数据预算下进行广泛的超参数扫描，研究了联合最优和边际最优的学习率与批大小。特别关注了 WSD 调度，分析了稳定期和衰减期最优超参数的迁移性，并拟合了考虑模型和数据交互的损失函数 Scaling 形式。
summary.experiments: 在英语语料库上训练了不同规模的模型，评估了近期提出的显式建模模型容量与数据集大小交互的 Scaling 形式，发现这些方法能有效捕捉欠训练和过训练状态。
summary.authors_note: 来自 Jülich Supercomputing Centre 和 University of Turku 的研究团队，关注开源 LLM 的 Scaling 规律。

summary_en.core_problem: How do learning rate, batch size, and loss scale with model capacity and data size during the pretraining of dense large language models?
summary_en.importance: Systematically studies the scaling behavior of pretraining hyperparameters (LR, batch size), especially their marginal evolution with model and data scale, and evaluates annealing gains under the WSD schedule, providing crucial empirical guidance for open-source LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Investigates jointly and marginally optimal learning rates and batch sizes through extensive hyperparameter sweeps across different model capacities and data budgets. Focuses on the WSD schedule, analyzing the transferability of optimal hyperparameters between stable and decay phases, and fits loss scaling forms that account for model-data interaction.
summary_en.experiments: Trains models of various sizes on English corpora, evaluating recently proposed scaling forms that explicitly model the interaction between model capacity and dataset size, finding them effective in capturing both undertraining and overtraining regimes.
summary_en.authors_note: Research team from Jülich Supercomputing Centre and University of Turku, focusing on scaling laws for open-source LLMs.

recommendation.zh: 系统研究了 WSD 调度下 LR 和 Batch Size 的 Scaling 规律，特别是退火阶段的超参数迁移性，对实际预训练调参极具参考价值，建议重点看实验结论和拟合公式。
recommendation.en: Systematically studies the scaling of LR and Batch Size under the WSD schedule, especially hyperparameter transferability during annealing, highly valuable for practical pretraining tuning; focus on experimental conclusions and fitted formulas.

paper.title: Cross-Session Decomposition Attacks: Scaling Risk and Intent-Aligned Retrieval Defense
paper.abstract: Scaling laws are usually read as a capability story: lower language-modeling loss yields more useful models. We study a safety consequence of this mechanism in \emph{cross-session decomposition attacks}, where benign-looking subqueries are asked across independent interactions and later recomposed toward a forbidden objective. We formalize this setting as \emph{compositional safety risk} and prove a conditional risk-transfer bound: when the reference environment already contains dispersed eviden

summary.core_problem: 研究 Scaling Laws 带来的安全隐患：模型规模越大（Loss 越低），是否越容易在跨会话的分解攻击（Cross-Session Decomposition Attacks）中重组出有害信息？
summary.importance: 从理论和实证角度揭示了 Scaling Law 的阴暗面，证明了更强的基础能力（更低的 Loss）会直接导致更高的组合性安全风险（Compositional Safety Risk）。
summary.technical_approach: 形式化定义了“组合性安全风险”，并证明了一个条件风险转移边界：当环境中存在分散的风险重组证据时，部署时的组合风险与模型在允许子查询上的多余 Loss 受控。通过合成数据实验（注入支持性事实）和 600 个意图的预训练 LLM 评估来验证。
summary.experiments: 合成实验表明，更宽的 Transformer 对未见过但可推导的指令赋予更低的 Loss。在 Qwen3 和 Gemma3 家族上的评估显示，更大的模型在跨会话攻击下表现出更大的有害能力提升。
summary.authors_note: 来自滑铁卢大学和 Vector Institute。

summary_en.core_problem: Investigating the safety implications of Scaling Laws: do larger models (with lower loss) become more susceptible to reconstructing harmful information in cross-session decomposition attacks?
summary_en.importance: Reveals the dark side of Scaling Laws theoretically and empirically, proving that stronger base capabilities (lower loss) directly lead to higher compositional safety risks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Formalizes 'compositional safety risk' and proves a conditional risk-transfer bound: when dispersed evidence for risky reconstruction exists, the deployed composed risk is bounded by the model's excess loss on allowed subqueries. Validated through synthetic withholding experiments (injecting supporting facts) and evaluation on a 600-intent pretrained LLM benchmark.
summary_en.experiments: Synthetic experiments show wider transformers assign lower loss to held-out instructions recoverable from injected facts. Evaluations on Qwen3 and Gemma3 families demonstrate that larger models exhibit greater harmful-capability uplift under cross-session attacks.
summary_en.authors_note: From University of Waterloo and Vector Institute.

recommendation.zh: 将 Scaling Law 与安全风险（跨会话组合攻击）建立了理论联系，证明了更强的泛化能力天然带来更高的组合越狱风险，值得关注其理论推导。
recommendation.en: Establishes a theoretical link between Scaling Laws and safety risks (cross-session compositional attacks), proving that stronger generalization inherently brings higher compositional jailbreak risks.

paper.title: A Layered Simplex Architecture for Large Alphabets
paper.abstract: Probability estimation over large alphabets under log loss is a well-studied problem, with celebrated methods such as the Good-Turing estimator. We introduce and study a new Bayesian estimator with four notable properties. First, its construction is exceptionally simple: multiply independent uniform draws from the probability simplex coordinate-wise and renormalize. Depth is the only structural parameter, and averaging over depths eliminates the need to tune it. Second, the regret of the resulti

summary.core_problem: 解决大字表概率估计在 log loss 下的建模与 regret 分析问题，试图在简单可计算的贝叶斯估计器与实际文本分布之间取得平衡。
summary.importance: 它不是 LLM 论文，但和语言建模的一个基础问题直接相关：大词表、Zipf 分布、编码 regret。价值主要在于提供一个 unusually tractable 的估计器，让数据量、字表大小、深度之间的 scaling 关系可以显式分析。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 layered simplex estimator：从概率单纯形独立均匀采样多个向量，逐坐标相乘后再归一化；depth 是唯一结构超参，还可对 depth 做混合以免调参。作者给出该 mixture regret 的显式且可高效计算表达式，并据此分析数据规模、字表大小和 depth 的关系。
summary.experiments: 在合成数据和真实文本 benchmark 上，与 Good-Turing 等经典大字表估计方法比较，结果显示该方法在不依赖复杂调参的情况下具有竞争力。摘要未给出具体语料规模或提升幅度，更像是理论+小规模实证结合的工作，而非现代大规模 LM 训练实验。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Ruediger Urbanke，信息论与编码理论领域知名学者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies probability estimation over large alphabets under log loss, aiming to balance estimator simplicity with analyzable regret on text-like heavy-tailed distributions.
summary_en.importance: This is not an LLM paper, but it touches a foundational language-modeling issue: large vocabularies, Zipfian targets, and coding regret. Its main value is the unusually tractable estimator that makes scaling in data size, alphabet size, and depth explicit.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes a layered simplex estimator: draw independent samples uniformly from the probability simplex, multiply them coordinate-wise, and renormalize. Depth is the only structural parameter, and averaging over depths removes tuning. The resulting mixture admits an explicit and efficiently computable regret expression, enabling scaling analysis.
summary_en.experiments: The method is compared against classical large-alphabet estimators such as Good-Turing on synthetic and real-text benchmarks, and is reported to be competitive without specialized tuning. The abstract gives no modern LM-scale setup, so this reads as a theory-plus-small-scale empirical paper rather than a large-scale language-model training study.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors include Ruediger Urbanke, a well-known researcher in information theory and coding.

recommendation.zh: 和现代 LLM 距离有点远，但如果你关心 Zipf 词表、log-loss regret、tokenizer 之后的长尾估计，这篇的显式公式值得备查；正文不必细读。
recommendation.en: A bit far from modern LLM practice, but if you care about Zipfian vocabularies, log-loss regret, and long-tail estimation after tokenization, the explicit regret formula is worth bookmarking; no need for a full read.

paper.title: Children, but not language models, show accelerating returns in word learning
paper.abstract: Children learn hundreds of words over the first years of their lives, in a process that begins slowly but quickly picks up speed. Prior models describe vocabulary growth as evidence accumulation over time. Here we show that the process is best characterized as accelerating accumulation: children learn more from each additional unit of linguistic experience than they did from the one before. In contrast to children, language models -- even those trained on child-directed speech -- do not accelera

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“儿童词汇量为什么随年龄上升”，而是更具体的问题：儿童每新增一单位语言经验时，学习效率是否恒定，还是会随发展阶段持续提高。作者把早期词汇习得写成一个可解释的累积模型：每个词有难度，每个儿童有学习能力，能力随时间和输入累积而变化。关键检验点是能力增长对经验的指数项 κ：若 κ=1，表示纯累积，后来的输入和早期输入同样有效；若 κ>1，表示加速累积，后期同样一份输入带来的词汇学习收益更高。论文进一步把这个问题放到儿童与语言模型的对照上：儿童是否表现出不同于标准 scaling law 的学习动力学。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义不在于它提出了一个可直接替代 LLM 训练目标的方法，而在于它给出了一条很清楚的反例：儿童词汇学习的样子，不像现有语言模型那样遵循近似恒定比例回报的数据扩展规律，而是表现出显著的“越学越会学”。这直接触到几个基座问题。第一，现有 next-token 预训练可能缺少一种会随内部表征成熟而提高样本效率的机制。第二，单纯增加 token 并不能解释人类极低数据量下的词汇习得。第三，若儿童的加速来自表征重组、概念绑定、跨模态 grounding、记忆检索或课程结构，那么这些因素就值得被重新放回 pretrain 设计里。贡献类型更接近“训练动力学上的认知基准”和“对 scaling law 外推边界的约束”，不是工程 recipe，但对研究方向有实质牵引力。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者把词汇习得建成一个带时间项的 Rasch/IRT 风格模型。每个词 j 有难度 δ_j，每个儿童 i 在时间 t 的能力 θ_i(t) 由三部分组成：基线效率 ξ_i、加速项 κ_i log(t/a0)、以及清醒时长 H 对总暴露量的贡献。儿童是否会说出某个词，由能力与词难度的差决定。这里最关键的设计有三点。第一，作者坚持使用有真实零点、可做对数变换的量纲变量，例如每小时听到的 token 数和词汇类型数，这使“增长形状”能被直接解释为经验回报的缩放关系，而不是仅仅做经验拟合。第二，作者把重点从词属性转向儿童间差异，不预设频率足以解释习得，而是把词难度作为自由参数估计，从而把“学习效率是否随发展加速”单独识别出来。第三，作者系统比较了四个模型：M0 无加速、M1 去掉个体效率差异、M2 去掉个体加速差异、M3 同时保留群体加速和个体差异。这样可以区分“平均上存在加速”与“只是个体异质性造成表面弯曲”。

全文里还有一个很重要但摘要不显眼的点：作者不是只看总词汇量曲线，而是用 item-level longitudinal CDI 数据做贝叶斯拟合。这样每个词的习得年龄、每个儿童的轨迹、以及词难度分布都在同一个模型里被约束。相比只拟合总词汇量，这种做法更能避免把测量工具形状误当成学习机制。作者还做了 2PL IRT、层级池化、不同表单选择、线性时间增长等替代设定，说明高 κ 不是某个参数化偶然产物。
summary.experiments:
实验核心基于 Wordbank 的五个纵向 CDI 数据集，覆盖美式英语、挪威语和日语，单语、典型发展儿童 8–36 个月，总样本 N=1841，且每个儿童至少有 3 次纵向测量。作者只分析 reported production，因为覆盖年龄更长、可靠性也更高。

结果上，M3 加速累积模型在五个数据集上都优于消融模型。与次优模型相比，item-level leave-one-out expected log predictive density 的提升都大于 760，说明不是边际改进，而是模型族层面的明显更优。更关键的是 κ 的估计在所有数据集上都远大于 1，范围约为 10.6 [10.5, 10.8] 到 13.3 [13.2, 13.3]，对“纯累积”假设形成很强拒绝。层级模型、扩大数据集、改用 2PL IRT、调整 CDI 词项选择后，κ 依然稳定地远高于 1。线性增长模型也没有提供更好拟合。

个体差异方面，儿童间加速参数的标准差 σ_b 在 3.2 到 6.6 之间，群体分布下 99.5% 的儿童都高于 κ=1。作者也很克制地指出：由于 CDI 纵向序列通常较稀疏，单个儿童的 κ 很难被高精度预测；但如果已有 5 次以上历史 CDI，加入群体级加速项后，91.9% 的儿童轨迹预测得到改善。这说明“加速”主要是群体层面稳健现象，而不是一个适合做个体诊断的高置信参数。

论文后半段最有解释力的结果，是把加速参数转成“学习一个词所需暴露次数随年龄下降”。作者用拟合模型计算词的 AoA，并据此说明：后期习得词并不一定因为更容易，而是儿童在后期对同样输入更高效。摘要里举了 book 与 ibex 的直观例子，正文则把这种现象形式化为 AoA 与词难度、群体平均效率和 κ 的关系。与语言模型对照时，作者发现即便在 child-directed speech 上训练，LM 仍更接近恒定比例回报，而没有儿童那种明显加速。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先看模型定义和 Figure 1。重点不是公式本身，而是作者如何把“词汇增长曲线”改写成“单位经验的边际收益是否上升”的问题。随后看模型比较部分，尤其是 M0–M3 的设定、LOO ELPD 结果，以及 κ 在不同数据集和替代模型中的稳定性。这些部分决定了结论是否只是拟合技巧。

第二个值得细读的是 AoA 与暴露需求的推导。这里能看出作者真正想说的不是“儿童词汇量增长快”，而是“后期每次暴露更值钱”。如果关心 pretrain，这一段最有启发：它把样本效率提升写成了一个可量化的动力学对象。

第三个重点是与语言模型的对照分析。阅读时要留意作者比较的到底是什么量：不是简单比最终词汇量，而是比经验回报曲线的形状。如果想深挖，可以追问三件事：一，儿童的 κ>1 可能来自哪些机制，哪些是现有 LM 完全没有的；二，child-directed speech 训练为何仍不产生加速，说明数据分布不是唯一解释；三，这种加速是否更像 curriculum、memory consolidation、world grounding 或 latent concept formation 的综合效应。预计精读时间 60–90 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a sharper question than whether children’s vocabulary grows with age. It asks whether the return on each additional unit of linguistic experience stays constant or increases over development. The authors formalize early word learning as an accumulator model with word difficulty and child ability, then test whether the ability term grows with a pure accumulation law or with acceleration. The key parameter is κ: κ=1 means later exposure is no more useful than earlier exposure, while κ>1 means the learner becomes increasingly efficient. The child–LM comparison is then framed as a comparison of learning dynamics, not final performance.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is conceptual but concrete. It provides a strong counterexample to the idea that language learning is well described by the same constant-proportional-return behavior that current LMs often exhibit under scaling laws. Children appear to get better at using data as they learn; LMs mostly do not. That matters because it points to a missing mechanism in standard pretraining: representation growth, grounding, memory consolidation, curriculum effects, or concept formation may change sample efficiency over time in ways next-token training does not capture. The contribution is not a new training recipe. It is a well-identified empirical constraint on what a plausible learning dynamic should look like if one wants to explain human-level data efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The technical core is a time-dependent Rasch/IRT-style model of vocabulary acquisition. Each word j has a difficulty δ_j. Each child i has an ability θ_i(t) composed of a baseline efficiency ξ_i, an acceleration term κ_i log(t/a0), and a waking-hours term H that links developmental time to cumulative exposure. Word production probability is determined by the gap between child ability and word difficulty. The central modeling move is to interpret growth on ratio-scale variables with real zeros, so log transforms have a direct meaning in terms of returns to experience rather than being a generic curve-fitting trick.

Three design choices matter. First, the model is built on interpretable units such as tokens heard per hour and vocabulary size in word types. Second, word difficulty is estimated freely rather than reduced to frequency, which lets the analysis isolate whether learning efficiency itself changes over development. Third, the authors compare four nested models: no acceleration, no individual efficiency variation, no individual acceleration variation, and the full accelerating accumulator. This is important because it separates true acceleration from apparent curvature induced by heterogeneity.

A major strength, visible only in the full paper, is that the model is fit to item-level longitudinal CDI data rather than aggregate vocabulary counts. That means word difficulty, age of acquisition, and child trajectories are jointly constrained. The paper also checks robustness with hierarchical pooling, 2PL IRT variants, alternative item selections on CDI forms, and linear-time growth alternatives. The high κ estimates survive these changes, which makes the result much harder to dismiss as a parameterization artifact.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical analysis uses five longitudinal Wordbank datasets covering American English, Norwegian, and Japanese, with monolingual typically developing children aged 8–36 months. Total N is 1,841, and each child has at least three longitudinal administrations. The study focuses on reported production rather than comprehension because it is available over a wider age range and is more reliable.

The full accelerating model wins on all five datasets. Relative to the next-best ablation, the item-level leave-one-out expected log predictive density improves by more than 760 in every dataset, which is a large gap for this kind of model comparison. The estimated acceleration parameter κ is far above the pure-accumulator value of 1 in every case, roughly 10.6 [10.5, 10.8] to 13.3 [13.2, 13.3]. These estimates remain essentially unchanged in larger data settings, hierarchical pooling, 2PL IRT variants, and alternative CDI item selections. Linear growth models do not fit better.

There is also substantial between-child variation in acceleration, with σ_b ranging from 3.2 to 6.6, yet the fitted population distribution places 99.5% of children above κ=1. The authors are careful about what can and cannot be inferred at the individual level: typical CDI series are too sparse to estimate a child-specific κ precisely, but adding a population acceleration term improves trajectory prediction for 91.9% of children when at least five prior CDIs are available.

One of the most useful interpretive results is the conversion from acceleration to exposure requirements. The model implies that the number of exposures needed to learn a word drops sharply over development. Later-acquired words are not simply easier; the learner is more efficient. In the LM comparison, even models trained on child-directed speech do not show this accelerating pattern and instead look closer to constant proportional returns.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the model definition and Figure 1. The main point is not the notation itself, but how the paper reframes vocabulary growth as a question about the marginal value of experience. Then read the model comparison section carefully, especially the M0–M3 ablations, the LOO ELPD table, and the robustness checks around κ. Those are the parts that establish the result as a property of the data rather than a flexible fit.

Next, focus on the age-of-acquisition and exposure interpretation. This is where the paper becomes most relevant to pretraining: acceleration is turned into a measurable statement about sample efficiency improving over time. Finally, read the child-versus-LM comparison with care. The comparison is about the shape of the learning curve, not about matching final vocabulary counts.

Three questions are worth carrying while reading: what mechanisms could generate κ>1 in children; why child-directed-speech training alone does not induce similar acceleration in LMs; and whether the missing ingredient is better described as curriculum, memory, grounding, or latent concept formation. A careful read takes about 60–90 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会动到一个很深的 prior：现有 LM 的数据效率曲线形状可能就和儿童不同。先看 curve definition 和 control setup；若定义站得住，很多“多喂数据就行”的想法都得重估。
recommendation.en: This challenges a deep prior: current LM learning curves may be qualitatively unlike children’s. Read the curve definition and controls first; if that part holds up, a lot of ‘just scale data’ intuitions need revisiting.

paper.title: Abra: Scaling Diffusion Image Training
paper.abstract: Compute-optimal scaling laws guide the training of frontier language models yet remain largely unexplored for visual generation. We present a systematic scaling law study for text-to-image diffusion models using Abra, a controlled family of flow-matching transformers trained across three orders of magnitude worth of compute ($10^{19}$ to $10^{22}$ FLOPs), reaching significantly larger compute budgets than previous works. We demonstrate that diffusion models scale just as predictably as language

summary.core_problem: 扩散模型在视觉生成任务中缺乏系统性的 Scaling Law 研究，导致训练时计算资源的分配（模型大小与训练数据量的权衡）缺乏理论指导。
summary.importance: 首次为文本到图像（T2I）扩散模型建立了严谨的 Compute-Optimal Scaling Law，填补了视觉生成领域在预训练 Scaling 规律上的空白。其结论打破了 LLM 领域的 Chinchilla 定律在视觉任务中的适用性，对未来大规模视觉生成模型的训练资源分配具有直接指导意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出了 ABRA，一个基于 Flow-Matching Transformer 的受控模型家族。通过在跨越三个数量级（10^19 到 10^22 FLOPs）的计算预算下进行系统性训练，研究了模型参数量和训练数据量（图像 token 数）之间的最优分配。研究方法借鉴了 LLM 领域的 Scaling Law 研究范式，但针对扩散模型的特性（如 CFG、不同的评估指标）进行了适配。
summary.experiments: 实验表明，扩散模型的 Scaling 规律与语言模型一样可预测，但达到计算最优所需的数据量远大于 LLM。具体而言，计算最优发生在每个参数约 200 个图像 token 处，这是 LLM Chinchilla 定律（每个参数 20 个 token）的十倍。此外，与语言模型不同，扩散模型对过度训练（Overtraining）具有鲁棒性，这意味着在计算资源受限时，增加训练数据量（即使超过最优比例）通常是有益的。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Section 4.1 中关于 Iso-FLOP 分析的图表（如 Table 7 和 Table 8），理解不同评估指标（如 FID, CLIPScore）下的 Scaling 规律差异。深入阅读关于过度训练鲁棒性的讨论，这与 LLM 的训练动态有显著不同。

summary_en.core_problem: The lack of systematic Scaling Law studies for diffusion models in visual generation tasks leads to a lack of theoretical guidance for allocating computing resources (the trade-off between model size and training data volume) during training.
summary_en.importance: This work establishes rigorous Compute-Optimal Scaling Laws for text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models for the first time, filling a gap in pre-training scaling laws for visual generation. The findings challenge the applicability of the Chinchilla scaling laws from the LLM domain to visual tasks, providing direct guidance for resource allocation in training future large-scale visual generation models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce ABRA, a controlled family of Flow-Matching Transformers. By systematically training across three orders of magnitude of compute budgets (10^19 to 10^22 FLOPs), they investigate the optimal allocation between model parameter count and training data volume (image tokens). The methodology adapts the Scaling Law research paradigm from the LLM domain to the specific characteristics of diffusion models (e.g., CFG, different evaluation metrics).
summary_en.experiments: Experiments demonstrate that diffusion models scale as predictably as language models but require significantly more data to reach compute optimality. Specifically, compute optimality occurs at approximately 200 image tokens per parameter, ten times the Chinchilla prescription for LLMs (20 tokens per parameter). Furthermore, unlike language models, diffusion models are robust to overtraining, implying that increasing training data (even beyond the optimal ratio) is generally beneficial when compute is constrained.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Iso-FLOP analysis charts in Section 4.1 (e.g., Table 7 and Table 8) to understand the differences in scaling laws across various evaluation metrics (e.g., FID, CLIPScore). Read the discussion on robustness to overtraining carefully, as it highlights a significant difference from LLM training dynamics.

recommendation.zh: 把视觉扩散的compute-optimal做到了足够大算力区间，200 tokens/param与“不过训更鲁棒”会直接影响多模态算力配比；先看最优比与过训分析。
recommendation.en: Large-range compute-optimal scaling for visual diffusion; the ~200 tokens/param optimum and overtraining robustness should change how you budget compute for multimodal diffusion—read the optimal-ratio and overtraining sections first.

paper.title: Cross-Entropy Risk Estimation for Language Models: Inconsistency Must Be Dense, and the Holdout Method Is No Exception
paper.abstract: Language models are compared by their held-out per-token cross-entropy risk---the quantity scaling laws are fitted to. We show that it cannot be consistently estimated. Consistency, or convergence to the estimand, is defined relative to a \emph{possible state of the world}: a pair consisting of a data-generating distribution and a model we turn out to train. Quantifying over models as well as data-generating mechanisms is essential, because what decides whether a model's risk is estimable is a t

summary.core_problem: 语言模型用留出集上的平均逐 token 交叉熵作为预测风险估计，并据此选择 checkpoint、报告模型质量、拟合 scaling law。论文指出这一估计量在一般情况下不一致：真实逐 token 风险可能无穷，而有限风险与无穷风险在分布空间中任意接近，任何基于有限样本的估计器都无法稳定区分二者。
summary.importance: 这是对预训练评测基础假设的统计学校准。held-out loss 并非天然收敛到真实风险；scaling law 所拟合的损失只有在额外尾部正则条件下才有明确估计意义。论文同时给出 context window 的独立统计理由，并提示需要替代估计目标。它没有否定经验做法，但明确了实践中隐含的前提。
summary.technical_approach: 把待估量定义为状态 (p,q) 上的泛函，p 是数据生成分布，q 是训练得到的模型；一致性必须同时对 p 和 q 量化，因为 q 诱导分布的尾部性质无法由权重直接读出，也无法由有限样本恢复。由于序列空间可数、softmax 具有 full support，风险是可能发散的非负无穷和；任意小的概率质量移动都可使有限风险变为无穷，反之亦然。由此把估计问题归约为有限/无穷风险的假设检验，证明没有检验能一致判决。定理 1 给出一般不可能性；定理 2 在期望序列长度有界且模型 full support 这两个自然限制下仍成立；定理 3 进一步说明失败点是稠密的，任何可由邻域认证的假设都不足以挽救一致性。正面出路包括：有限上下文窗口使下一 token 概率存在正下界 β，损失随长度线性增长，在期望序列长度有限时风险有限；以及一个只在风险低于预设阈值 r 时需要准确知道真值的替代估计目标。
summary.experiments: 纯理论工作，没有神经网络或数据实验。结果以三个定理和证明给出：任意估计器在所有风险存在的状态上不一致；在有界期望长度与 full support 限制下仍不一致；不一致状态在状态空间中稠密。正面命题给出 bounded context window 下风险有限的充要条件。
summary.reading_guide: 重点读第 3 节拓扑构造、第 4 节一致性定义与三个定理、第 5 节两个出路。核心创新不是又一个评测偏差，而是把 q 也纳入一致性量化，并证明稠密不可能性。可跳过测度论细节，但要理解“有限/无穷风险任意接近”和“context window 作为统计正则化”这两点。替代估计目标部分在提供的文本中不完整，需参考原文后续。

summary_en.core_problem: Language models are ranked by held-out per-token cross-entropy, the same quantity used to select checkpoints and fit scaling laws. The paper shows this risk cannot be estimated consistently in general: the true risk may be infinite, and states with finite and infinite risk are topologically close enough that no finite-sample estimator can reliably tell them apart.
summary_en.importance: It is a foundational correction to the statistical assumptions behind pretraining evaluation. Held-out loss does not automatically converge to population risk; the loss values used in scaling laws are well-defined estimands only under additional tail assumptions. The result also gives an independent statistical justification for bounded context windows and points to alternative estimands. It does not invalidate empirical practice, but it makes its hidden premises explicit.
summary_en.technical_approach: The estimand is treated as a functional over states (p,q), where p is the data-generating distribution and q is the trained model. Consistency is quantified over both p and q, because the tail behavior of q is not readable from its weights or recoverable from samples. On a countable sequence space with softmax full support, risk is a nonnegative infinite series that can diverge; an arbitrarily small mass shift can turn finite risk into infinite risk and vice versa. Estimation is therefore reduced to testing finite versus infinite risk, and no such test can be consistent. Theorem 1 gives the general impossibility; Theorem 2 retains it under bounded expected sequence length and full support; Theorem 3 shows the failures are dense, so no neighborhood-certifiable assumption restores consistency. Two escape routes are discussed: a bounded context window yields finitely many next-token distributions and hence a positive probability floor β, making loss linear in length and risk finite whenever expected sequence length is finite; and a thresholded estimand that only requires the true risk when it is below a pre-specified r.
summary_en.experiments: This is a theoretical paper with no neural-network or dataset experiments. The main results are three theorems: no estimator is consistent at every state where the estimand exists; the impossibility survives bounded expected length and full support; and inconsistent states are dense. A positive proposition characterizes finite risk under a bounded context window.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the topological construction, Section 4 for the refined consistency definition and theorems, and Section 5 for the two ways out. The central move is quantifying consistency over q as well as p and proving dense inconsistency. Measure-theoretic proof details can be skimmed; the key intuitions are the finite/infinite risk adjacency and the context window as statistical regularization. The alternative-estimand discussion is incomplete in the available excerpt.

recommendation.zh: 如果你用验证 loss 拟合 scaling law，这篇会逼你重看“loss 可估”这个默认前提；先读定理假设再信结论。
recommendation.en: If you fit scaling laws from validation loss, this forces a check on the estimability assumption; read the theorem conditions before accepting the punchline.

paper.title: Rules or Character? Scaling Laws for AI Safety Design
paper.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) safety systems combine character shaping (e.g., Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback [RLHF], Constitutional AI), which modifies behavioral distributions at training time, with rule enforcement (e.g., output filters, safety classifiers), which blocks harmful outputs at inference time, yet little formal analysis exists on how their optimal balance should change as deployment scales increase. We introduce a stylized comparative-statics model that parameterizes saf

summary.core_problem: AI 安全中 character shaping（RLHF/Constitutional AI）与 rule enforcement（输出过滤器/安全分类器）的最优配比如何随部署规模变化，缺乏形式化分析。
summary.importance: 首次用闭式比较静态模型形式化安全资源在训练时 character 与推理时 rule 间的 scaling 权衡，给出可检验的 α* 预测。
summary.technical_approach: 用一个参数 α∈[0,1] 在两类安全手段间分配资源，建模 filter 的规模相关退化、共模故障、character fragility，在乘性 Pareto 伤害模型下推导期望损失闭式并用 Monte Carlo 做 CVaR 尾部分析。
summary.experiments: 在乐观/中性/悲观三种场景下给出最优 α* 的数值曲线和敏感性，但属于 stylized model，无真实 LLM 训练或部署数据校准。

summary_en.core_problem: How the optimal balance between character shaping (RLHF/Constitutional AI) and rule enforcement (filters/safety classifiers) should shift with deployment scale lacks formal analysis.
summary_en.importance: A first closed-form comparative-statics model formalizing how safety resources should be split between training-time character and inference-time rules as scale grows, yielding testable α* predictions.
summary_en.technical_approach: Parameterizes the allocation as α∈[0,1], models scale-dependent filter degradation, common-mode failures, and character fragility under a multiplicative Pareto damage model; derives expected harm in closed form and augments it with CVaR tail analysis via Monte Carlo.
summary_en.experiments: Reports optimal α* across optimistic/moderate/pessimistic scenarios, but the model is stylized and not calibrated against real LLM training or deployment data.

recommendation.zh: 作为 safety scaling 的 toy 模型可一看，假设过强、无实证校准，别把 α* 数字当真，但权衡框架可供内部讨论。
recommendation.en: A toy formal model of safety-resource scaling; assumptions are strong and empirically uncalibrated, so treat α* as illustrative rather than actionable, but the framing is useful for internal debate.

paper.title: Neural Quadratic Forms: A Unified Minimal Model for Sudden Learning and Scaling Laws
paper.abstract: Neural networks trained by gradient descent on a smooth cost function can nevertheless learn in steps: the cost holds on long plateaus and then drops abruptly. Meanwhile, training losses instead follow smooth power laws. Variants of both behaviors occur in architectures with very different microscopic structures, which is the signature of a few relevant collective variables. We show that a symmetry fixes what those variables are: a network layer is a sum over interchangeable units, so relabeling

summary.core_problem: 神经网络训练中两类看似矛盾的规律性现象——单条轨迹上的 plateau-then-drop 阶跃式学习，以及跨模型/数据/计算规模的平滑幂律 scaling law——能否由同一个最小模型统一解释？论文从置换对称性出发，给出了一个普适的二次型展开。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值偏理论侧：它把 matrix sensing、phase retrieval、diagonal/quadratic networks、deep linear networks 等 17 个此前各自独立分析的可解代理模型统一到同一个 NQF 表达式下，并指出架构差异只通过一个结构矩阵 A(x) 进入。这为理解 feature acquisition 的顺序、plateau 成因以及 scaling law 的谱结构提供了共同语言，但目前主要是 near-origin 小初始化展开，对真实大规模 LLM 训练的定量预测能力仍需后续验证。
summary.technical_approach: 核心观察是：一个由 d 个可交换单元组成的模块（MLP 隐单元、attention head、MoE expert、conv channel）在重标号下不变，即具有 S_d 对称性。在初始化尺度 ε 很小、且单元梯度在原点为零的条件下，对参数空间原点做 Taylor 展开，对称性强制三阶项消失，最低阶非平凡项为 Tr[WW^T A(x)]，外加一个 μ^T g(x) 线性项（多数实际架构中为零）。所有架构特异性被压缩进 p×p 的对称结构矩阵 A(x)，其稀疏模式和耦合由架构和输入决定；序参量是 M=WW^T 而非单个权重。值得注意的是，对 attention 而言，value 和 readout 块在二阶出现，而 Q、K 矩阵要到四阶才进入——这给出了 attention 训练早期动力学的一个具体预测。论文进一步用该二次型推导 excess loss 对 rescaled training time 的幂律，并指出同一谱结构也支配模型/数据规模 scaling。
summary.experiments: 论文以理论构造为主，实验部分用于验证 NQF 对不同架构的统一描述以及 plateau/drop 动力学和幂律拟合。具体数字在提供的全文片段中未完整给出；论文声称 17 个既有可解模型是 NQF 在特定 A 下的特例，并引用大模型二次模型仍定量准确的相关工作作为支撑。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，建议重点看 Figure 1（NQF 形式与 A(x) 的架构对应）、Theorem 1 的陈述与对称性论证、以及 attention 部分关于 Q/K 到四阶才出现的讨论。对做训练动力学或 scaling law 理论建模的人，这篇提供了一个干净的对称性出发点；对主要做大规模实验的研究员，知道有这样一个统一框架即可，不必深究证明细节。预计精读 1–2 小时，泛读 30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Can two seemingly incompatible regularities of neural network training—step-like plateau-then-drop learning along a single trajectory and smooth power-law scaling across model/data/compute—be explained by one minimal model? The paper derives a universal quadratic expansion from permutation symmetry.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is primarily theoretical. It unifies 17 previously separate solvable proxies—matrix sensing, phase retrieval, diagonal and quadratic networks, deep linear networks, and others—under a single neural quadratic form (NQF), with architectural differences entering only through a structure matrix A(x). This offers a common language for feature acquisition order, plateau formation, and the spectral structure behind scaling laws. It is, however, a near-origin small-initialization expansion; quantitative predictive power for real large-scale LLM training remains to be established.
summary_en.technical_approach: The key observation is that a module of d interchangeable units (hidden units, attention heads, MoE experts, conv channels) is invariant under relabeling, i.e. has S_d symmetry. Under small initialization scale ε and a vanishing-gradient-at-origin condition, a Taylor expansion about the origin has its cubic term killed by symmetry, leaving the leading nontrivial term Tr[WW^T A(x)] plus a linear μ^T g(x) term that vanishes for most practical architectures. All architecture specificity is compressed into a p×p symmetric structure matrix A(x) whose sparsity pattern and couplings are fixed by the architecture and input; the order parameter is M=WW^T rather than individual weights. Notably, for attention the value and readout blocks appear at quadratic order, while Q and K enter only at quartic order—a concrete prediction about early-training dynamics. The same quadratic form is then used to derive a power law for excess loss versus rescaled training time, with the same spectral structure argued to govern model- and data-size scaling.
summary_en.experiments: The paper is primarily a theoretical construction; experiments validate the NQF as a unified description across architectures and its fit to plateau/drop dynamics and power laws. Specific numbers are not fully contained in the available text. The paper claims 17 existing solvable models are special cases of the NQF at particular A, and cites prior work arguing quadratic models remain quantitatively accurate even for large language models.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim material. Focus on Figure 1 (the NQF form and how A(x) maps to architecture), the statement of Theorem 1 and its symmetry argument, and the discussion of Q/K appearing only at quartic order in attention. For researchers working on training dynamics or scaling-law theory, it provides a clean symmetry-based starting point; for those mainly running large-scale experiments, awareness of the unifying framework is enough without diving into proofs. Estimated 1–2 hours for a careful read, 30 minutes for a skim.

recommendation.zh: 只看推导假设和跨 attention/MoE 的映射；若实验证据干净，值得加入训练早期动力学 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the assumptions and the attention/MoE reductions; if the evidence is clean, it is worth folding into early-training dynamics ablations.

paper.title: Epiplexity Guided Data Selection and Generation for Out-of-Distribution Generalization
paper.abstract: Modern systems are increasingly expected to transfer across tasks not specified during training. What data facilitates generalization in these new, unanticipated settings? One hypothesis is that data with more structural information could contain shared circuits and subprograms that could be recycled in a wider array of downstream settings. Epiplexity, a recently proposed measure of the structural information a compute-bounded learner can extract from data, provides a mechanism to reason about t

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文想解决一个数据选择问题：如果目标是提升未预先指定任务上的 OOD 泛化，应该选择什么数据，而不是只按领域、质量分或去重规则做经验混合。
summary.importance: 对预训练数据研究的启发在于，它把“有用数据”从静态质量判断转成了训练过程中的可学习结构信号。epiplexity 不是简单的信息量，也不是 loss 高低；它关注模型在训练中能否持续从数据里提取结构。这个视角对数据受限、多 epoch 训练、合成数据生成都有意义。不过目前更像一个可操作化的数据信号原型，贡献量级主要在方法和诊断框架，而不是已经给出大规模预训练 recipe。
summary.technical_approach: 论文围绕 epiplexity 做了两个算法。EpiSelect 用每个自然数据域的 loss 曲线拟合 scaling law，预测继续在该域训练会带来的 epiplexity 增益，再用这个增益做在线 batch/domain 选择。这样做的动机是：直接计算完整 epiplexity 代价高，而 loss 曲线的面积可以近似表示“模型还能从该数据中学到多少结构”。EpiGen 则把 epiplexity 增益作为 reward，训练一个数据生成器为 learner 产生更有学习价值的数据，并用 REINFORCE 做策略梯度优化。这个目标会同时排斥两类无效数据：过于重复的数据很快学完，epiplexity 低；纯噪声学不动，epiplexity 也低。与常见 data selection 方法相比，它不是直接优化验证集 loss 或领域权重，而是试图优化训练过程中的结构学习进展。
summary.experiments: 实验核心有三点。第一，EpiSelect 在数据选择上优于已有强基线，说明用 epiplexity gain 做在线选择可以带来更好的 OOD 泛化。第二，EpiGen 生成的数据能提升 learner 表现，说明 epiplexity 可以作为合成数据的训练信号，而不只是分析指标。第三，论文指出 The Pile 作为数据选择评测存在明显偏差：只用 PileCC 训练的简单 baseline 竟然可以超过已有数据选择方法，因此作者转向 Common Pile，以控制不同 domain size 对结果的影响。论文还验证了一个关键假设：较高 epiplexity 与更好的 OOD 泛化在多个设置下相关。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议看三部分，约 30–45 分钟。先看 epiplexity 的定义和图 1，重点理解为什么重复数据和噪声都会得到低 epiplexity。然后看 EpiSelect 的 scaling-law 估计方式，关注它如何把 per-domain loss curve 转成在线选择信号。最后看 The Pile 评测问题和 Common Pile 设置，这部分对做数据 mixture 实验的人很有参考价值。EpiGen 可以略读，重点看 reward 设计和 REINFORCE 是否稳定，而不必深陷生成器实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to select or generate training data when the target is out-of-distribution generalization to tasks that were not known during training.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for pretraining research is a process-based view of data quality. Epiplexity measures how much learnable structure a compute-bounded learner can extract from data during training. This is different from static notions such as domain label, token count, loss, or heuristic quality score. The work is most useful as a data-selection signal and diagnostic framework, rather than as a fully validated large-scale pretraining recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper operationalizes epiplexity in two ways. EpiSelect fits scaling laws to per-domain loss curves and predicts the expected epiplexity gain from additional in-domain training tokens. Batches or domains are then selected to maximize this predicted gain. EpiGen trains a generator to produce data that increases the learner’s epiplexity, using REINFORCE with epiplexity gain as the reward. The objective naturally avoids both trivial data, which is learned too quickly, and random noise, which does not produce sustained loss reduction. Compared with validation-loss-driven selection, the method tries to optimize the learner’s structural learning progress.
summary_en.experiments: The reported experiments support three claims. EpiSelect improves data selection over strong baselines for OOD generalization. EpiGen shows that epiplexity can be used as a reward for synthetic data generation. The paper also identifies a limitation of The Pile as a data-selection benchmark: training only on PileCC can outperform existing selection methods, suggesting that domain-size effects can dominate the evaluation. The authors therefore use Common Pile to better control domain-size confounds and report that higher epiplexity correlates with better OOD generalization across several settings.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30–45 minutes. Read the epiplexity definition and the intuition figure first, especially the contrast between repetitive sequences, noise, and structured data. Then read the EpiSelect section to understand how loss-curve scaling laws become an online selection rule. Finally, read the benchmark discussion around The Pile and Common Pile, which is directly relevant to data-mixture experiments. The EpiGen section is worth a lighter pass, focusing on the reward definition and whether the policy-gradient setup is stable.

recommendation.zh: 用epiplexity量化数据结构信息做预训练数据选择的思路很新，scaling law拟合采样权重的方法可直接在内部数据配比实验中测试。
recommendation.en: The idea of using epiplexity to quantify data structural information for pretraining data selection is novel; the scaling-law-fitted sampling weight method can be directly tested in internal data mixture experiments.

paper.title: Small-Scale Experiments: Are We There Yet?
paper.abstract: Scaling laws promised cost-effective experiments; six years later, they have yet to fully deliver. Instead, researchers have found them unreliable at small scales (starting at 4M parameters) and concluded that sizable models cannot be avoided. We show this is not the case: the confounding factor is hyperparameters. Small models are highly sensitive, but hyperparameter sensitivity fades with scale. This small-scale sensitivity makes scaling laws easy to miss because they only emerge on the fully

summary.core_problem: 为什么 scaling law 在小规模实验中难以复现、从小模型得到的结论经常无法迁移到大模型？论文指出关键混淆变量是超参数：小模型对超参数极度敏感，而这种敏感性随规模增大而消退；只有在充分调参的前沿上，scaling law 才会显现。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究方法学有直接影响。它给出了一条可操作的路径：在 4M 参数尺度上做数百组配置的彻底搜索，再用简单规则把超参数外推到大模型，从而显著降低实验成本并提高结论可靠性。这对学术团队和工业界的 model-centric 研究都有现实意义，也解释了 Kaplan 与 Hoffmann 两派结论分歧的来源。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三层。第一，对 scaling law recipe 做消融，比较参数计数方式、embedding 是否计入、学习率衰减、warmup 长度等因素，发现这些细节影响有限，而超参数是否充分调优才是决定性因素。第二，用 noisy quadratic model（Lourie et al. 2025a）刻画超参数损失曲面：在最优值附近曲面是二次、低秩、近似正态的；随参数和数据同步增长，好配置在超参空间中所占比例扩大，其几何机制是曲面的内在维度下降——模型规模的维度祝福治愈了超参数的维度诅咒，有效超参数维度最终趋近于 1。第三，把三个工具组合成方法论：noisy quadratic limit 判断是否已充分调参，scaling law 描述损失随规模的变化，perplexity–capability correspondence 检查预训练损失变化是否转化为下游能力。论文用这套方法重新审视了 transformer 中 normalization 层位置（Pre-LN vs Post-LN）这一历史争议问题作为示范。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖从 4M 起的多个规模，最小模型单卡一小时内可训完。关键发现：(1) 小模型需要搜索数百个超参配置才能触及充分调优前沿，常见的小网格搜索远远不够；(2) 超参数敏感性随规模显著下降，大模型用简单规则即可迁移；(3) 在充分调优后，scaling law 可一直延伸到 4M 参数；(4) 对 recipe 各成分的消融显示参数计数、学习率衰减等选择对最终 scaling law 形状影响较小，调参充分性才是主导因素；(5) 用 normalization 位置案例演示了完整的小规模诊断流程。
summary.reading_guide: 重点读 §3（recipe 消融，看哪些因素真正影响 scaling law）、§4（超参数损失曲面的几何解释，尤其是 intrinsic dimension 下降的论证）、§5（方法论整合与 normalization 位置案例）。§2 的背景部分对不熟悉 noisy quadratic limit 的读者有必要快速过一遍。图表方面关注展示不同调参预算下 scaling law 是否出现的对比图，以及超参空间中好配置比例随规模变化的图。值得深挖的是：把 intrinsic dimension 下降与具体优化器超参（lr、beta、wd、warmup）对应起来，看哪些维度最先坍缩；以及这套方法论在 data-centric 研究（数据配比、课程）上是否同样成立——作者明确指出可能需要不同技术。

summary_en.core_problem: Why are scaling laws hard to reproduce at small scale, and why do small-model conclusions so often fail to transfer? The paper identifies hyperparameters as the confounding factor: small models are extremely sensitive to hyperparameters, and this sensitivity fades with scale. Scaling laws only emerge on the fully tuned frontier, which requires far more search than most studies run.
summary_en.importance: Direct methodological impact on pretraining research. It offers an actionable path: run exhaustive searches over hundreds of configurations at the 4M-parameter scale (trainable in under an hour on one GPU), then carry hyperparameters up with simple rules. This lowers experiment cost and raises rigor for both academic and industry model-centric research, and it explains the historical Kaplan-versus-Hoffmann discrepancy.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three layers. First, ablations of the scaling-law recipe (parameter counting, embedding inclusion, LR decay, warmup length) show these details matter little compared to whether hyperparameters are fully tuned. Second, the noisy quadratic model (Lourie et al. 2025a) characterizes the hyperparameter loss surface as quadratic, low-rank, and approximately normal near the optimum; as parameters and data grow together, good configurations fill a larger fraction of the space because the intrinsic dimension of the surface drops—the blessing of dimensionality from parameters cures the curse of dimensionality in hyperparameters, with the effective number of hyperparameters approaching one. Third, three tools are combined into a methodology: the noisy quadratic limit diagnoses whether tuning is complete, scaling laws describe loss vs. scale, and the perplexity–capability correspondence checks whether pretraining-loss changes translate into downstream capabilities. The normalization-placement debate (Pre-LN vs Post-LN) is used as a worked demonstration.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments span scales from 4M parameters upward, with the smallest models training in under an hour on a single GPU. Key findings: (1) small models may require hundreds of hyperparameter configurations to reach the fully tuned frontier—common small grids are insufficient; (2) hyperparameter sensitivity fades markedly with scale, so simple rules suffice to transfer upward; (3) once fully tuned, scaling laws extend down to 4M parameters; (4) recipe ablations show parameter counting and LR decay have limited effect on the scaling-law shape, while tuning adequacy dominates; (5) the normalization-placement case study demonstrates the full small-scale diagnostic workflow.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on §3 (recipe ablations—what actually affects the scaling law), §4 (geometric account of the hyperparameter loss surface, especially the intrinsic-dimension argument), and §5 (methodology synthesis and the normalization case study). Skim §2 for the noisy-quadratic background if unfamiliar. Pay attention to figures comparing whether scaling laws appear under different tuning budgets, and to plots showing how the fraction of good configurations grows with scale. Worth digging into: which optimizer hyperparameters (lr, beta, wd, warmup) collapse first as intrinsic dimension drops, and whether the methodology transfers to data-centric research (mixtures, curricula)—the authors explicitly note this may require different techniques.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻对内部小模型 scaling 实验复盘超参搜索预算；它改变“小尺度无规律”的默认解释。
recommendation.en: Immediately audit hyperparameter-search budgets in internal small-scale scaling runs; this changes the default explanation for noisy small-scale laws.

paper.title: Compute-Optimal Is Not Cluster-Optimal: Systems-Aware Scaling for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts
paper.abstract: In large-scale pretraining, the algorithm, architecture, and systems decisions are conventionally made in disconnected stages. A scaling law stage selects an architecture and training recipe, optimizing loss under compute constraints, and a separate systems stage then optimizes the implementation for hardware efficiency. In this work, we develop MOSAIC, which formulates model architecture and systems co-design as an optimization problem. MOSAIC couples a predictive scaling law with a calibrated

summary.core_problem: 传统LLM scaling law只在理论模型FLOPs约束下优化预测loss，选定模型大小、训练token数，完全不考虑真实集群上的MFU（模型FLOPs利用率）、跨设备通信开销、内存占用、最优并行布局等系统因素，实际执行时再针对固定架构做系统调优。这种两阶段脱节在MoE模型上问题尤其突出：专家数、路由稀疏度等MoE特有参数既影响最终loss，也对系统效率有极大影响，理论上的compute-optimal配置放到真实硬件上可能吞吐量差数倍，甚至因为内存/通信瓶颈根本无法高效运行。
summary.importance: 将系统约束端到端整合进MoE scaling law框架，打破了传统两阶段流程（先按理论FLOPs选架构、再做系统调优）的脱节问题。核心贡献在于解决了现有MoE scaling law的一个核心失效点：纯理论FLOPs约束下推导出的最优稀疏度会落在可行域边界，推荐的高专家数配置往往因通信爆炸、内存不足导致实际MFU低数倍，根本无法达到预期训练效率。这个框架会直接改变大规模MoE的训练规划流程：优化目标从“理论模型FLOPs最优”转向“集群实际可交付有效FLOPs最优”，让架构选择、token预算、并行策略在同一个优化问题里求解，相同墙钟/集群预算下能获得质量更好的模型。
summary.technical_approach: 提出MOSAIC框架，将MoE架构与系统的协同设计建模为混合整数非线性规划问题。首先，推导了暴露系统约束必要性的MoE scaling law，证明在仅约束模型FLOPs的情况下，MoE的最优稀疏度位于可行域边界——即稀疏度越高、loss越低，不存在内点最优，不加入系统硬约束的话优化结果无实际意义。其次，构建经过校准的系统性能模型，可对任意给定MoE架构在目标集群上的MFU、多维度并行（数据/张量/流水线/专家）的通信开销、显存占用进行量化估计，并自动搜索最优并行切分方案。最后，不同于传统方法先求解连续无约束最优、再匹配最近似离散架构的流程，MOSAIC直接在有效的离散架构参数网格（专家数、活跃参数量、总参数量、训练token数、层维度）上最小化预测loss，一次性输出集群适配的最优MoE结构、训练token预算、并行执行方案。相比之前仅在MoE scaling law中加入内存约束的工作，MOSAIC纳入了决定真实训练吞吐量的全链路系统开销。
summary.experiments: 核心分析结论显示，仅受模型FLOPs约束的MoE scaling law会把最优稀疏度推到可行域边界，loss随稀疏度升高持续下降，直到碰到系统硬限制。校准后的系统性能模型可量化之前scaling工作忽略的真实开销，比如专家数过高时专家并行all-to-all通信带来的MFU骤降。相比标准两阶段流程，MOSAIC选出的配置可在固定墙钟时间、固定集群规模下交付更低的最终loss——核心是平衡高稀疏度带来的理论loss收益，和通信、硬件利用率不足带来的实际吞吐量损失，避免了过度配置专家数带来的“理论FLOPs好看、实际跑不动”的常见问题。
summary.reading_guide: 优先看第6.1节和图1，这部分拆解了无约束MoE scaling law的边界最优失效模式，是整个工作的核心动机。其次看系统性能模型的构建与校准方法，重点关注MoE特有的专家并行通信开销、不同并行维度的权衡如何被参数化为架构选择的函数。最后看优化问题的建模部分，对比传统“连续求解+离散匹配”流程，理解直接在离散架构网格上求解混合整数规划的必要性。可以延伸思考的方向：框架如何纳入推理成本约束做训推一体的架构优化，如何适配异构集群、长上下文额外开销、新型MoE路由机制。

summary_en.core_problem: Conventional LLM scaling laws select model size and training token budgets by optimizing predicted loss under theoretical model FLOPs constraints, without accounting for real cluster overheads: attainable Model FLOPs Utilization (MFU), cross-device communication cost, memory footprint, and optimal parallel placement. Systems tuning is treated as a separate, post-hoc step for a fixed architecture. This disconnect is particularly severe for sparse MoE models, where design choices like expert count and routing sparsity have outsized impacts on both end loss and systems efficiency, leading to theoretically “compute-optimal” configurations that can be several times slower on real hardware, or even impractical to run due to memory and communication bottlenecks.
summary_en.importance: This work integrates systems constraints end-to-end into MoE scaling laws, closing the gap in the standard two-stage training planning workflow. It resolves a core failure mode of existing MoE scaling laws: under pure model FLOPs constraints, derived optimal sparsity values lie at the feasibility boundary, with recommended high expert counts often delivering a fraction of expected throughput due to communication overhead and memory pressure. The framework shifts MoE training planning from optimizing for notional model FLOPs to optimizing for actual hardware-delivered useful FLOPs, jointly selecting architecture, token budget, and parallel execution strategy in a single optimization step. This enables configurations that deliver better end model quality for fixed wall-clock time and fixed cluster hardware.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed MOSAIC framework formulates MoE architecture-systems co-design as a mixed-integer nonlinear program. First, the authors derive a MoE scaling law that demonstrates the necessity of systems constraints: under model-FLOPs-only constraints, optimal MoE sparsity sits at the feasibility boundary, with loss monotonically decreasing as sparsity increases, meaning no interior optimum exists without explicit systems limits. Second, a calibrated system performance model estimates, for any given MoE architecture on a target cluster, attainable MFU, communication overhead across data/tensor/pipeline/expert parallelism dimensions, memory usage, and the best available parallel layout. Third, instead of solving a continuous unconstrained optimum and snapping to the nearest valid discrete architecture (the standard practice), MOSAIC directly minimizes predicted loss over a discrete grid of valid architecture choices—expert count, active parameters, total parameters, training token count, layer dimensions—to jointly output a cluster-tailored MoE geometry, token budget, and parallel execution plan. Unlike prior work that added only memory constraints to MoE scaling laws, MOSAIC accounts for the full stack of systems overheads that determine real training throughput.
summary_en.experiments: A core analytical result shows that MoE scaling laws constrained only by model FLOPs push optimal sparsity to the feasibility boundary, with loss continuing to drop as sparsity increases until hard systems limits are hit. The calibrated performance model quantifies overheads ignored in prior scaling work, including sharp MFU degradation from all-to-all expert communication at high expert counts. Relative to the standard two-stage workflow, MOSAIC-selected configurations deliver lower end loss for fixed wall-clock time and fixed cluster size, by balancing theoretical loss gains from higher sparsity against real throughput losses from communication and poor hardware utilization. This avoids the common pitfall of over-provisioning experts, which produces strong theoretical FLOPs numbers but poor real cluster efficiency.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with Section 6.1 and Figure 1, which document the boundary-optimum failure mode of unconstrained MoE scaling laws—the core motivating observation for the work. Next, focus on the system performance model calibration, particularly how MoE-specific expert parallel communication costs and parallelism tradeoffs are parameterized as functions of architecture choices. Finally, study the mixed-integer optimization formulation to understand why direct optimization over the discrete architecture grid is necessary, rather than solving a continuous problem and rounding to valid values. Open directions to explore include extending the framework to incorporate inference cost constraints for joint train-test optimization, supporting heterogeneous clusters, and modeling overheads from long context windows and novel routing mechanisms.

recommendation.zh: 应读方法和优化目标：它把 Chinchilla 式 loss 最优从“纸面 FLOPs”拉回集群约束，值得在内部 MoE 规划中复现。
recommendation.en: Read the objective and method sections: it moves Chinchilla-style loss optimality from paper FLOPs to cluster constraints, worth reproducing for internal MoE planning.

paper.title: Skaling: Chinchilla's Exponents Meet Kaplan's Coupling
paper.abstract: Neural scaling laws are foundational for language model development, yet standard formulations systematically under- and overestimate loss at data-scarce and overtraining extremes. This failure originates in the underlying assumption that model size and training data impact the loss independently. To address this, we introduce the Skaling law, a generalized functional form that couples model capacity and data through a single interaction exponent. This simple extension reduces the Mean Absolute

summary.core_problem: 现有 LLM scaling law 在数据稀缺和过训练极端区间会系统性低估或高估 loss，原因是默认模型规模和训练 token 数对 loss 的影响彼此独立。
summary.importance: 贡献是 scaling law 形式的修正。论文把 Chinchilla 风格的指数与 Kaplan 风格的耦合思想结合，引入容量与数据之间的交互项，用于更可靠地从小规模实验外推完整训练网格。这直接关系到预训练预算分配和低成本 scaling sweep 设计。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Skaling law：在标准 scaling 函数中加入一个 coupling interaction exponent，让模型容量和数据规模通过单一交互指数共同影响 loss。论文还配合 sparse grid 策略，只在低 compute 区域采样，用拟合后的函数外推高 compute/full-grid 表现。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告 Skaling 在插值与外推区间将 Mean Absolute Percentage Error 降低 1.5-3 倍；结合低 compute sparse grid，可用约 10 倍更少的 sweep compute 达到准确 full-grid extrapolation。摘要未列出具体模型族、参数范围、token 范围和数据集细节。
summary.authors_note: David Lopez-Paz 和 Kartik Ahuja 是机器学习泛化、因果与表示学习方向的知名研究者；摘要未提供作者机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses systematic loss misprediction by standard neural scaling laws in data-scarce and overtrained regimes, attributing the failure to the assumption that model size and training data affect loss independently.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a revised scaling-law functional form. It combines Chinchilla-style exponents with Kaplan-style coupling and introduces an interaction term between capacity and data. This is directly relevant to pretraining budget allocation and the design of cheap scaling sweeps.
summary_en.technical_approach: Skaling adds a single interaction exponent that couples model capacity and data size in the loss model. The authors pair this form with a sparse-grid strategy restricted to low-compute regimes, then extrapolate to the full training grid.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a 1.5-3x reduction in Mean Absolute Percentage Error across interpolation and extrapolation regimes. With sparse low-compute grids, Skaling achieves accurate full-grid extrapolation using roughly 10x less compute than uniform sweeps. The abstract does not specify model families, parameter ranges, token ranges, or datasets.
summary_en.authors_note: David Lopez-Paz and Kartik Ahuja are known for work on generalization, causality, and representation learning; the abstract does not provide institutional affiliations.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻复现到内部 scaling sweep；若 coupling 指数稳定，data-scarce/overtrain 区间的预算决策会变。
recommendation.en: Replicate this on internal scaling sweeps soon; if the coupling exponent is stable, budget choices in data-scarce and overtrained regimes change.

paper.title: LLaDA MoE v2: Scaling Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) offer an alternative to autoregressive (AR) language modeling, yet the scaling behavior of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) dLLMs remains poorly understood. We systematically characterize how optimization hyperparameters, compute allocation, and architecture scale for MoE dLLMs, identifying quantitative differences from scaling trends previously reported for AR models. Specifically, for optimization, the optimal nominal batch size grows faster, while the optimal learnin

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 MoE diffusion language model 的 scaling recipe 问题：当训练预算变大时，batch size、learning rate、模型-数据分配，以及 MoE 的专家数、激活比例、专家粒度和 shared expert 容量应该如何一起缩放。核心点是，不能直接照搬 AR MoE 的经验，因为 dLLM 的训练目标、监督位置和条件信息结构都不同。
summary.importance: 这是对新型语言建模范式有直接价值的预训练论文。它把 diffusion LM 从“能不能训出可用模型”推进到“如何按 compute 做系统缩放”。贡献主要有三类。第一，给出 MoE dLLM 的优化超参 scaling 规律：最优 nominal batch size 随 compute 增长更快，最优 learning rate 随 compute 衰减更快。第二，通过 IsoFLOP 分析发现 MoE dLLM 在模型-数据分配上略偏数据侧，即最优 token budget 的增长快于 activated model-side computation。第三，把 MoE 架构参数化为 activation ratio、expert granularity、shared-expert ratio，并在不同 compute 下做缩放分析，指出更大规模下更倾向于在固定 activated capacity 下扩大 expert pool。最终训练出的 LLaDA MoE v2 30B-A3B 是对这些规律的验证，而不只是一个模型发布。
summary.technical_approach: 论文以 masked diffusion LM 为基础。训练时对序列中每个位置按噪声水平 t 独立替换为 [MASK]，双向 Transformer 只在 masked positions 上预测原 token；推理时从全 mask 序列出发，迭代去噪并逐步填回 token。这个目标和 AR next-token prediction 不同：AR 每个 token 只看左侧前缀，dLLM 每个被 mask 的 token 看的是被污染的全序列，且有效监督密度随 mask ratio 变化。MoE 部分使用 routed experts 加 shared expert。作者把架构写成三个变量：activation ratio A=(n_a+n_s)/(n_e+n_s)，表示每个 token 激活的专家容量占总专家容量的比例；expert granularity G=2d_model/d_expert，表示专家切分得多细；shared-expert ratio S=n_s/(n_a+n_s)，表示激活容量中多少走 shared pathway。实验上先用小中等 compute 做网格扫描，拟合最优 batch size 和 learning rate 的 power law；再用 IsoFLOP 固定训练 FLOPs，改变 activated model compute 与 token 数，估计最优模型-数据分配；最后扫描 MoE 架构变量，得到专家池规模、激活容量和 shared capacity 的设计规则。这个流程的价值在于它把 dLLM 的目标差异显式反映到 scaling 决策里，而不是把 MoE 只当作 AR Transformer 的稀疏 FFN 替换件。
summary.experiments: 最终模型 LLaDA MoE v2 是 30B 总参数、A3B activated 参数的 MoE dLLM，从头在 23.5T tokens 上预训练。论文报告它在若干知识、推理和代码 benchmark 上接近 Qwen3 30B-A3B，同时使用约 65% 的预训练 token；也以更少训练 compute 达到此前 MoE dLLM 的水平。经过标准 SFT 后，LLaDA MoE v2 在 8 个 reasoning/coding benchmark 中有 7 个超过 SDAR Chat 30B-A3B，并且在多个 benchmark 上与 Qwen3 保持可比，尽管 Qwen3 还包含额外 RL 阶段。消融和 scaling 实验的主要信息不在单点分数，而在趋势：dLLM 的最优 batch 更快变大，学习率更快变小；数据量相对 activated compute 的边际价值更高；固定每 token 激活计算时，扩大总专家池在更大规模下更有利。这些趋势都说明 dLLM MoE 的训练动态和 AR MoE 不完全一致。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先看 Preliminaries，确认作者如何定义 masked diffusion objective，以及 MoE 的 A/G/S 三个架构变量。然后看 scaling law 相关章节和 Table 1，这是论文最核心的信息密度所在：batch、learning rate、model-data allocation、MoE architecture 四条结论都在那里汇总。IsoFLOP 图需要重点看横轴到底是 activated compute、token 数还是总参数，避免把总参数扩张误读成每 token 计算扩张。架构消融部分应关注固定 activated capacity 时增加 expert pool 的收益，以及 shared expert 的作用边界。最后再看 LLaDA MoE v2 的训练和评测，用它判断前面 scaling recipe 是否能外推到 30B-A3B、23.5T-token 量级。值得深挖的点有三个：mask ratio 下的有效监督密度如何影响 batch scaling；dLLM 的双向条件信息是否改变数据最优配比；MoE router 在 denoising 过程中是否学习到与 AR 不同的专家分工。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the scaling recipe for Mixture-of-Experts diffusion language models: how batch size, learning rate, model-data allocation, and MoE architecture should change as training compute grows. The central issue is that AR MoE heuristics cannot be copied directly because dLLMs use a masked denoising objective rather than left-to-right next-token prediction.
summary_en.importance: This is directly relevant to pretraining research on alternative language-modeling paradigms. It moves diffusion LMs from the question of trainability to the question of compute-optimal scaling. The contribution has three main parts. First, it characterizes optimization scaling for MoE dLLMs: the optimal nominal batch size grows faster with compute, while the optimal learning rate decays faster. Second, IsoFLOP analysis shows a mild data-side tilt: the optimal token budget grows faster than activated model-side computation. Third, it studies MoE design through activation ratio, expert granularity, and shared-expert ratio, finding that larger scales increasingly favor larger expert pools at fixed activated capacity. LLaDA MoE v2 30B-A3B is then used as an end-to-end validation of the recipe, not merely as a model release.
summary_en.technical_approach: The model family is based on masked diffusion language modeling. During training, each token is independently replaced by [MASK] according to a noise level t, and a bidirectional Transformer predicts the clean tokens only at masked positions. During generation, the model starts from a fully masked sequence and iteratively denoises it. This differs from AR training in two important ways: supervision is attached to masked positions rather than every next-token conditional, and each prediction conditions on a corrupted full sequence rather than a clean prefix. The MoE layer contains routed experts plus a shared expert. The architecture is parameterized by activation ratio A=(n_a+n_s)/(n_e+n_s), expert granularity G=2d_model/d_expert, and shared-expert ratio S=n_s/(n_a+n_s). The study then performs compute-scaling sweeps: fitting power laws for optimal batch size and learning rate, running IsoFLOP experiments to trade activated model computation against training tokens, and scanning MoE architecture variables to decide how total expert capacity should be decomposed at larger scales. The key methodological point is that scaling decisions are calibrated under the dLLM objective, rather than treating MoE as a drop-in sparse FFN borrowed from AR Transformers.
summary_en.experiments: The final validation model, LLaDA MoE v2, has 30B total parameters with 3B activated parameters and is pretrained from scratch on 23.5T tokens. It approaches Qwen3 30B-A3B on several knowledge, reasoning, and coding benchmarks while using about 65% as many pretraining tokens. It also matches a prior MoE dLLM trained without this scaling guidance at a fraction of the compute. After standard SFT, LLaDA MoE v2 outperforms SDAR Chat 30B-A3B on seven of eight reasoning and coding benchmarks and remains competitive with Qwen3 on multiple benchmarks, even though Qwen3 includes an additional RL stage. The most important experimental results are the scaling trends rather than any single benchmark number: larger compute prefers faster-growing batch size, faster-decaying learning rate, more tokens relative to activated compute, and larger expert pools under fixed activated capacity. These are concrete signs that MoE dLLMs have training dynamics that differ from AR MoE models.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read carefully. Start with the preliminaries to pin down the masked diffusion objective and the A/G/S MoE parameterization. Then focus on the scaling-law sections and Table 1, which contain the main practical conclusions for batch size, learning rate, model-data allocation, and MoE architecture. In the IsoFLOP plots, check whether the axis refers to activated compute, token count, or total parameters; otherwise it is easy to confuse capacity growth with per-token compute growth. In the architecture ablations, look for the effect of increasing the expert pool at fixed activated capacity and for the role of shared experts. Read the LLaDA MoE v2 training and evaluation section last, as an extrapolation test of the recipe at the 30B-A3B and 23.5T-token scale. The deeper questions to track are how mask-ratio-dependent supervision changes batch scaling, whether bidirectional corrupted context changes the data-optimal point, and whether the MoE router learns a different specialization pattern under denoising than under AR prediction.

recommendation.zh: MoE+dLLM 第一批系统 scaling 数据，batch/LR/data-model 分配三条曲线都与 AR 不同；做 diffusion LM 或 MoE 训练的应直接对照内部 recipe 复现。
recommendation.en: First systematic scaling data for MoE diffusion LMs; batch/LR/data-model curves all diverge from AR priors—directly actionable for anyone training dLLMs or MoE.

paper.title: Towards joint scaling laws with optimal batch size schedules
paper.abstract: Modern deep learning typically keeps the batch size static throughout training, thus overlooking the joint effect of learning rate and batch size on the training dynamics. In this paper, we study the deep learning dynamics through the lens of convex optimization and derive a joint characterization of loss in terms of both schedules, applicable to general optimizers and model architectures. This characterization yields a closed-form optimal batch size schedule for any prescribed learning rate sch
