summary_en.technical_approach: The Unified Neural Scaling Law (UNSL) is a multi-level functional form, constructed from the inside out: (1) Multivariate Broken Neural Scaling Law (MBNSL): extends the univariate BNSL of Caballero et al. to multiple dimensions, defining a sequence of smoothly connected hyperplanes in multi-log space, with n hyperbreaks separating n+1 hyperplanes, each with its own exponents (gradients) for each input dimension; the position and sharpness of each hyperbreak are controlled by learned parameters; (2) R layer: combines MBNSL outputs, allowing different scaling regimes to be modeled for different subsets of input dimensions; (3) Q layer: additional combination layer; (4) Final output layer. The core innovation is the use of product index sets M and summation index sets T to achieve piecewise-linear modeling of multidimensional scaling trajectories (in multi-log space), while sigmoid-like smooth transition functions handle hyperbreaks to保证 differentiability and fitting stability. Each hyperbreak is defined by a product condition ∏x_i^c_ijk = d_jk, corresponding to a hyperplane in multi-log space.
summary_en.experiments: The paper validates UNSL across multiple architectures and task sets. Compared to alternative scaling law functional forms, UNSL yields considerably more accurate extrapolations on the test set. Specifically, UNSL accurately models and extrapolates multivariate scaling behaviors that other functional forms cannot express, including non-monotonic transitions in overfitting scaling behavior (performance degradation after exceeding optimal training steps) and non-monotonic relationships between hyperparameters (learning rate, weight initialization std) and performance metrics. Specific numerical details on parameter counts, data sizes, etc. are not fully provided in the available text, but the expressive power of the functional form itself is the central contribution—it handles an arbitrary number of input dimensions (parameters, data, training steps, inference steps, learning rate, initialization scale, etc.).
summary_en.reading_guide: Deep read, ~60-90 minutes. Focus on: (1) Section 2 for the functional form definition, especially the layer-by-layer construction logic of Equations 1-4, and how MBNSL generalizes BNSL to multiple dimensions; (2) The mathematical definition and geometric meaning of hyperbreaks, and why the product form ∏x_i^c = d is used to define breakpoints; (3) Section 3 (not fully presented in the provided text) for experimental results and extrapolation accuracy comparisons; (4) Specific examples of non-monotonic behavior modeling, particularly overfitting and hyperparameter modeling. Points worth digging deeper: the precise relationship between this functional form and prior scaling laws (when it reduces to BNSL, when it reduces to Kaplan's power law), the data and computational cost required to fit this function, and concrete parameter fitting examples in real LLM pretraining scenarios.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutional author information not explicitly provided in the text. The paper cites work by Sutton, Tolstikhin, Bahri, Caballero, and other key scaling law researchers, indicating deep domain familiarity.

recommendation.zh: 如果 UNSL 真的能在“多维同时变动”下稳健外推，它会直接影响你怎么做预算与 ablation；优先核查公式形态、拟合协议和外推评估是否干净。
recommendation.en: If UNSL truly extrapolates under joint multi-axis variation, it changes how you budget compute and design ablations—first audit the functional form, fitting protocol, and whether extrapolation tests are clean.

paper.title: How Should LLMs Consume High-Quality Data? Optimal Data Scheduling via Quality-Aware Functional Scaling Laws
paper.abstract: High-quality data is scarce in large language model (LLM) training, yet how to schedule its use jointly with training dynamics lacks theoretical guidance. We extend functional scaling laws by incorporating a data-quality dimension, and solve the joint data-quality and batch-size scheduling problem in asymptotic closed form. The solution reveals two regimes and a dual role of high-quality data. In the noise-limited regime, high-quality data should be used as a signal amplifier: lowering the batch

summary.core_problem: 高质量数据（教材、数学证明、专家代码）是LLM训练中最稀缺的资源。当前业界普遍的做法是在训练后期引入高质量数据进行mid-training，但这与学习率衰减的训练动态存在根本冲突——模型在学习强度（每token有效更新幅度）最弱的时候才接触最好的数据。此前缺乏对数据质量调度与训练动力学联合优化的理论框架。
summary.importance: 首次建立了数据质量感知的函数缩放定律（quality-aware functional scaling law），以解析形式给出了数据质量与batch size联合调度的最优解。提出的noise-limited/signal-limited双regime洞察是训练动力学理解上的概念性进展。DSR（Drop-Stable-Rampup）调度策略可直接应用于mid-training流水线，在15B MoE模型上验证了显著效果。
summary.technical_approach: 将Li et al. (2026)的函数缩放定律扩展到时变数据质量维度，通过标签噪声方差的混合比例p(t)建模数据质量。超额风险（excess risk）分解为信号学习项和噪声积累项，两者均受数据质量调度p(t)和batch size调度b(t)的联合控制。将问题建模为变分优化问题，推导出渐近闭式最优调度（定理4.3）。解空间呈现两个regime：在noise-limited regime，高质量数据应作为信号放大器——降低batch size将更干净的数据转化为更多信号而不放大噪声；在signal-limited regime，高质量数据应作为噪声抑制器——后期放置减少终端噪声而不牺牲信号积累。基于理论提出DSR策略：在数据质量切换时降低batch size，保持低水平稳定以积累信号，最后ramp up抑制噪声。
summary.experiments: 在15B MoE模型、108B tokens的mid-training设置下验证。DSR在14个基准上平均准确率相比WSD（Hu et al. 2024）提升+1.70，相比Cosine-decay提升+2.98。包含消融实验验证双regime理论的合理性，以及不同强度/内容/位置扰动的综合分析。
summary.reading_guide: 第3节（质量感知函数缩放定律的推导）是理论核心。第4节（定理4.3及双regime分析）是关键概念洞察。第5节（DSR策略和实验结果）是实践落地部分。图2（regime可视化）和表1（主要结果）为必看图表。第3-4节的数学推导需要仔细阅读，附录可能包含完整证明。建议深度阅读：1.5-2小时。
summary.authors_note: 未在提供内容中明确标注机构。理论深度和实验规模（15B MoE，108B tokens）表明可能来自大型AI研究机构。

summary_en.core_problem: High-quality data (textbooks, mathematical proofs, expert-curated code) is the scarcest resource in LLM training. The current standard practice introduces high-quality data late for mid-training, but this fundamentally conflicts with learning rate decay dynamics—the model encounters its best data precisely when learning intensity (effective update magnitude per token) is weakest. No theoretical framework for the joint optimization of data quality scheduling and training dynamics previously existed.
summary_en.importance: Establishes the first quality-aware functional scaling law, providing closed-form optimal solutions for the joint scheduling of data quality and batch size. The two-regime insight (noise-limited vs signal-limited) represents a conceptual advance in understanding training dynamics. The DSR (Drop-Stable-Rampup) schedule is directly actionable for mid-training pipelines and has been validated at scale on a 15B MoE model.
summary_en.technical_approach: Extends functional scaling laws (Li et al. 2026) with a time-varying data quality dimension, modeling data quality through the mixing proportion p(t) of label noise variance. Excess risk decomposes into a signal-learning term and a noise-accumulation term, both jointly controlled by the data quality schedule p(t) and batch-size schedule b(t). Formulates as a variational optimization problem and derives asymptotic closed-form optimal schedules (Theorem 4.3). The solution exhibits two regimes: in the noise-limited regime, high-quality data acts as a signal amplifier—lowering batch size converts cleaner data into more signal without amplifying noise; in the signal-limited regime, it acts as a noise suppressor—late placement reduces terminal noise without sacrificing signal accumulation. Translates to DSR strategy: drop batch size at quality transition, hold stable low to accumulate signal, then ramp up to suppress noise.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on a 15B MoE model with 108B tokens in a mid-training setting. DSR improves average accuracy across 14 benchmarks by +1.70 over WSD (Hu et al. 2024) and +2.98 over Cosine-decay (Loshchilov and Hutter 2017). Includes ablation studies validating the two-regime theory and comprehensive analysis of corruptions with different intensity, content, and location.
summary_en.reading_guide: Section 3 (derivation of quality-aware functional scaling law) is the theoretical core. Section 4 (Theorem 4.3 and two-regime analysis) is the key conceptual insight. Section 5 (DSR recipe and experimental results) is the practical payoff. Figure 2 (regime visualization) and Table 1 (main results) are essential. The mathematical derivations in Sections 3-4 require careful reading; appendices likely contain full proofs. Recommended reading time: 1.5-2 hours for thorough understanding.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutional affiliation not explicitly stated in the provided content. The theoretical depth and experimental scale (15B MoE, 108B tokens) suggest a major AI research institution.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻看理论假设和实验附录；若结论稳，会改变高质量数据只适合后期 anneal 的默认做法。
recommendation.en: Read the assumptions and appendix first; if the evidence holds, it changes the default habit of saving clean data mostly for late annealing.

paper.title: Compute Optimal Tokenization
paper.abstract: Scaling laws enable the optimal selection of data amount and language model size, yet the impact of the data unit, the token, on this relationship remains underexplored. In this work, we systematically investigate how the information granularity of tokens, controlled by the compression rate (i.e., average bytes of text per token), affects scaling trends. We train 988 latent tokenized models (BLT) ranging from 50M to 7B parameters that enable setting the desired compression rate. This flexibility

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 scaling law 里一个长期被简化的问题：训练数据到底应该按 token 计量，还是按底层文本信息量计量。传统 Chinchilla 式结论把最优数据量写成 tokens per parameter，但 token 不是稳定单位。不同 tokenizer 的压缩率不同，同样一段文本可以被表示成更多或更少 token。论文把压缩率定义为平均每个 token 覆盖的字节数，并系统研究压缩率如何改变最优模型规模、最优数据量和固定算力下的 loss。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的影响很直接：如果结论成立，compute-optimal 配比不应简单写成固定的 token/parameter，而应写成更接近 byte/parameter 的关系。也就是说，换 tokenizer 或提高压缩率后，不能机械沿用“每参数 20 个 token”这类经验规则。更高压缩率会减少序列长度，释放训练 FLOPs，但也会让每个 token 承载更多信息，增加建模难度。论文的贡献不是提出一个新 tokenizer，而是把 tokenization 纳入 scaling law 的自变量，使 tokenizer 选择从经验工程问题变成可估计的算力分配问题。
summary.technical_approach: 论文使用 Byte Latent Transformer 作为主要实验工具，因为 BLT 可以在不改变词表大小的情况下控制压缩率。模型把字节序列先由局部 encoder 聚合成 latent tokens，再由全局 Transformer 在 latent token 上建模，最后由 decoder 回到字节级做 next-byte prediction。这样可以把“压缩率”从“词表设计”里解耦出来，避免 BPE 这类方法里词表大小、token 边界、参数量和压缩率同时变化。作者还去掉了原 BLT 中的 byte n-gram hash embeddings，因为 n-gram 可能跨越多个 latent token，会干扰对目标压缩率的控制。局部 encoder/decoder 的 scaling recipe 也做了调整，偏向增加宽度而不是深度，以降低局部模块成为瓶颈的风险。核心建模思路是拟合带压缩率变量的 scaling law：数据规模既可按 token 数表示，也可按 byte 数表示；训练算力则由模型大小、token 数和 BLT 局部模块开销共同决定。随后作者用 subword tokenizer 模型做外部验证，检查 BLT 上观察到的规律是否只是 latent tokenization 的架构效应。多语言实验进一步用 parity，即平行句在不同语言中的 byte 长度比，解释不同语言下最优数据配比和压缩率的变化。
summary.experiments: 主要实验规模较大：作者训练了 988 个 BLT 模型，参数量覆盖 50M 到 7B，并在一系列目标压缩率下拟合 scaling trends。文中明确对比了常见 BPE 在英文 DCLM 风格语料上的压缩率约 4.57 bytes/token，以及 SuperBPE 约 6.16 bytes/token；BLT 的实验范围覆盖并超过这些压缩率。关键结论是，在 compute-optimal 配置下，最优模型参数量与数据的 byte 数更接近成比例关系，而不是与 token 数成比例关系。等价地说，当压缩率升高时，最优 token/parameter 会下降；保持固定 token/parameter 会导致实际喂入的 byte 数随压缩率变化，从而偏离最优算力分配。实验还显示压缩率不是越高越好。提高压缩率减少了全局 Transformer 处理的 token 数，但每个 latent token 需要承载更多局部信息，局部 encoder/decoder 的负担和预测难度会上升，因此存在固定算力下的较优压缩区间。subword-tokenized 模型实验用于验证趋势是否可迁移到常规 tokenizer；多语言实验则表明，语言的 byte parity 会影响最优配比，byte 长度更高的语言不能直接套用英文 token 规则。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction 中对四个研究问题的定义，它把论文从“比较 tokenizer”提升到了“重写 scaling law 单位”的层面。Methodology 里要重点看 BLT 的改动、局部模块 scaling recipe、压缩率控制方式，以及为什么去掉 hash n-gram embeddings。实验部分建议优先看三个图表：一是不同压缩率下 loss 随模型大小和数据量的 scaling 曲线；二是 compute-optimal frontier 上参数量、token 数、byte 数的关系；三是最优压缩率随算力预算变化的曲线。subword tokenizer 部分适合检查外推性，尤其要看 BPE、SuperBPE 与 BLT 的趋势是否一致。多语言部分建议关注 parity 的定义和实证关系，它对多语预训练的数据配比有直接参考价值。值得深挖的问题有两个：第一，BLT 局部模块开销如何进入算力估计；第二，byte-level loss 与常规 token-level perplexity 如何公平比较。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a basic but often hidden assumption in language-model scaling laws: whether training data should be measured in tokens or in a tokenizer-independent unit of information. The usual Chinchilla-style rule expresses the optimal data-to-parameter ratio in tokens per parameter, but a token is not a stable unit. The same text can become many short tokens or fewer compressed tokens depending on the tokenizer. The paper treats compression rate, defined as average bytes per token, as an explicit scaling variable and studies how it changes compute-optimal model size, data size, and loss.
summary_en.importance: The main implication is that pretraining recipes should not blindly reuse a fixed tokens-per-parameter rule after changing the tokenizer. The paper’s central result is that compute-optimal model size tracks the amount of data measured in bytes more closely than the amount measured in tokens. As compression increases, the optimal number of tokens per parameter should decrease. This gives tokenizer design a quantitative role in compute allocation: a more compressed tokenizer reduces sequence length and saves FLOPs, but it also makes each token carry more information and can increase modeling difficulty. The contribution is less about proposing a new tokenizer and more about making tokenization part of the scaling-law problem.
summary_en.technical_approach: The main experimental tool is Byte Latent Transformer, because it can vary compression rate without changing vocabulary size. BLT first aggregates byte-level inputs into latent tokens with a local encoder, applies a global Transformer over those latent tokens, and then uses a decoder to predict bytes. This separates compression rate from vocabulary size and avoids the confounding present in subword tokenizers, where token boundaries, vocabulary, parameter count, and compression are coupled. The authors modify the original BLT setup by removing byte n-gram hash embeddings, since such n-grams can span more bytes than a latent token and would interfere with controlled compression. They also adjust the scaling of local modules, favoring width over depth. The scaling analysis then fits laws that include compression rate, comparing data measured in tokens with data measured in bytes. Additional subword-tokenized Transformer experiments test whether the trends are specific to BLT. Multilingual experiments use parity, the byte-length ratio of parallel sentences across languages, to explain shifts in optimal data ratios and compression rates.
summary_en.experiments: The experimental sweep is substantial: 988 BLT models are trained, ranging from 50M to 7B parameters, across multiple target compression rates. The paper explicitly compares this range with common subword regimes, including a popular BPE tokenizer at about 4.57 bytes per token on English DCLM-like text and SuperBPE at about 6.16 bytes per token. The key empirical finding is that, along the compute-optimal frontier, parameter count scales with training data measured in bytes rather than tokens. Equivalently, increasing compression should reduce the optimal tokens-per-parameter ratio. The experiments also show that compression is not free. Higher compression shortens the global sequence and reduces Transformer FLOPs, but each latent token must represent more bytes, increasing local modeling burden and prediction difficulty. This leads to an optimal compression region under a fixed compute budget rather than a monotonic preference for maximum compression. The subword experiments are used as a sanity check against the BLT-only interpretation, while the multilingual experiments show that byte parity matters when transferring English-derived scaling rules to other languages.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the research questions in the introduction carefully; they define the paper as a scaling-law study rather than a tokenizer comparison. In the methodology, focus on the BLT modifications, the way compression rate is controlled, the local-module scaling recipe, and the removal of hash n-gram embeddings. In the experimental sections, prioritize the figures that show scaling curves across compression rates, the compute-optimal frontier relating parameters to tokens and bytes, and the estimated optimal compression rate as compute changes. The subword-tokenizer section is useful for checking whether the BLT observations transfer to standard tokenizer families such as BPE and SuperBPE. The multilingual section is worth reading for its use of parity, since it connects tokenizer fairness and multilingual pretraining allocation. Two details deserve close inspection: how the paper accounts for BLT local-module compute, and how byte-level losses are compared with conventional token-level perplexity.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改 tokenizer scaling 的默认假设：应按 bytes 重画内部 Chinchilla 曲线，并把压缩率纳入 compute-optimal 搜索。
recommendation.en: This changes the tokenizer-scaling prior: redraw internal Chinchilla curves in bytes, and treat compression rate as a compute-optimal search variable.

paper.title: Same Architecture, Different Capacity: Optimizer-Induced Spectral Scaling Laws
paper.abstract: Scaling laws have made language-model performance predictable from model size, data, and compute, but they typically treat the optimizer as a fixed training detail. We show that this assumption misses a fundamental axis of representation scaling: how effectively the optimizer converts added FFN width into utilized spectral capacity. Using eigenspectra of feed-forward network representations, measured through soft and hard spectral-ranks, we find that \emph{the same Transformer architecture reali

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是一个被传统 scaling law 简化掉的问题：同一套 Transformer 架构和 FFN 宽度扩展，在不同优化器下是否真的获得了同样的表示容量。作者的结论是否定的。验证损失可以接近，但 FFN 表示的谱结构会明显不同，尤其是 hard spectral rank 的扩展斜率差异很大。这说明优化器不只是影响收敛速度或等效算力效率，也会决定新增 FFN 宽度是否被转化为可用的主导表示方向。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的影响在于，它把优化器从“训练细节”提升为“容量实现机制”的一部分。传统 scaling law 常把参数量、数据量、算力作为主轴，优化器最多进入常数项或效率因子。这篇论文给出的证据更细：即使 loss 相近，内部表示的谱容量扩展也可能不同。对大模型预训练来说，这会影响三个判断：第一，扩大 FFN 宽度不保证自动获得等比例有效容量；第二，长尾 token 和中频 token 的容量分配会受优化器影响；第三，架构改动的效果需要和优化器一起看，不能单独归因。贡献主要是诊断框架和经验规律，不是直接给出一个完整新训练 recipe，但它对 optimizer selection、宽度 scaling、表示监控都有实际参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是用 FFN hidden representation 的特征谱来度量“宽度被利用到什么程度”。作者关注 Transformer 中参数占比较高的 FFN 模块，对其表示协方差或相关矩阵做谱分析，并用 soft spectral rank 和 hard spectral rank 两类指标描述容量。soft rank 更像熵加权的有效维度，能反映谱质量是否扩散到更多方向；hard rank 更敏感于主导特征方向，能看出新增维度是否形成了强而可用的表示轴。作者在固定架构、固定宽度扩展计划、固定数据设置的条件下，比较 AdamW、Muon、NorMuon，以及带 rank constraint 的 Dion 变体。关键做法不是只比较最终 loss，而是拟合 spectral rank 随 FFN 宽度增长的幂律斜率 β，并进一步按 token 频率分层，分别观察 HEAD、MID、TAIL 等 token regime 的谱容量扩展。论文还用 Rényi-entropy 形式的谱分析检查不同谱集中度区域，避免结论只来自某一个 rank 定义。与只讨论 optimizer loss-scaling 的工作不同，这里讨论的是 optimizer 如何改变 representation geometry；与固定 optimizer 下的 FFN spectral scaling 工作不同，这里把 scaling law 定义为 architecture-optimizer pair 的性质。
summary.experiments: 主要结果是优化器导致的 hard-rank scaling 差异明显大于 soft-rank。全文给出的范围显示，soft spectral rank 的宽度扩展斜率集中在 β_soft≈0.66 到 1.01，说明不同优化器都能让谱质量随宽度扩散；但 hard spectral rank 的斜率跨度为 β_hard≈0.29 到 0.82，差异很大。AdamW 的 hard-rank scaling 最弱，整体实验中约 β=0.29；Muon 接近线性扩展，约 β=0.82。在 rare-token 或 TAIL 表示上，AdamW 也表现出较弱 hard-rank 扩展，摘要中给出 β=0.44，而 Muon 能显著改善这一点。hard-soft asymmetry 也随优化器变化：AdamW 的差距约 Δ_1,2=0.37，Muon 和 Dion(1/2) 约为 0.14，说明 matrix-aware 或正交化倾向更强的优化器能把新增 FFN 宽度更有效地转成集中、可用的表示方向。一个重要实验结论是，学习率调参和更长训练不能消除这种谱差异；AdamW 可以在 perplexity 上追近其他优化器，但表示谱仍不同。作者还比较了注意力 head rank、RoPE 移除、部分 PostLN 等架构因素。结果显示，切换优化器带来的谱变化往往不小于这些架构干预；在某些 PostLN 配置中，正交化优化器能训练到可用 perplexity，而 AdamW 失败。这些结果支持一个更强的判断：架构容量能否被实现，依赖优化几何。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction 中关于“matched loss 不等于 matched geometry”的论证，这是理解全文的主线。方法部分需要重点看 FFN eigenspectrum 的构造、soft/hard spectral rank 的定义、幂律拟合方式，以及 Rényi-entropy 分析，因为这些决定了结论是否可靠。实验部分建议优先看三组图表：第一，spectral rank 随 FFN width 的 scaling 曲线，尤其是 AdamW 与 Muon 的 hard-rank 斜率对比；第二，按 token frequency 分层的谱容量结果，用来判断优化器对长尾学习的影响；第三，学习率、训练时长、验证 loss 匹配后的对照实验，用来排除“只是没训够”这一解释。架构干预部分可以放在第二遍读，重点看 optimizer 与 attention rank、RoPE、PostLN 的交互，而不是单独记每个架构改动的结果。值得深挖的是：hard rank 是否和下游长尾知识、事实记忆、rare token prediction 有更直接的相关性；Muon/Dion 类优化器的收益来自正交化、矩阵级更新，还是来自更稳定的谱范数控制。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a missing axis in scaling-law analysis: whether the same Transformer architecture realizes the same representational capacity when trained with different optimizers. The answer is no. Validation loss can be similar, but the FFN representation spectrum can scale very differently with width. The central claim is that added FFN width is not automatically converted into usable spectral capacity; the optimizer helps determine whether new dimensions become strong representational modes or remain diffuse spectral mass.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is that optimizer choice is treated as part of capacity realization, not merely as a convergence-speed or compute-efficiency detail. Standard scaling laws usually parameterize loss by model size, data, and compute, while the optimizer is fixed or absorbed into a constant. This work shows a representation-level effect that survives loss matching. It matters for width scaling, FFN design, optimizer selection, and diagnostics for long-tail learning. The contribution is primarily an empirical scaling and analysis framework rather than a full training recipe, but the implication is practical: architecture changes should be evaluated together with the optimizer that realizes their capacity.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper analyzes eigenspectra of FFN representations. FFNs are a natural target because they contain a large fraction of Transformer parameters and expose an expanded latent space whose utilization can be measured spectrally. The authors compute soft and hard spectral ranks from FFN representation spectra. Soft rank captures entropy-weighted spectral spread, while hard rank is more sensitive to concentration into dominant eigenmodes. They then fit power laws between spectral rank and FFN width under a fixed architecture and width schedule, comparing AdamW, Muon, NorMuon, and rank-constrained Dion variants. The key distinction from loss-scaling work is that the measured object is representation geometry, not only validation perplexity. The paper also stratifies representations by token frequency, which tests whether optimizer-induced capacity changes are uniform or concentrated in difficult frequency regimes. Rényi-entropy spectral analysis is used as a robustness check across different concentration sensitivities.
summary_en.experiments: The strongest result is the separation between soft-rank and hard-rank scaling. Soft-rank exponents are relatively clustered, with β_soft in roughly the 0.66 to 1.01 range. Hard-rank exponents are much more optimizer-dependent, spanning about β_hard=0.29 to 0.82. AdamW shows weak hard-rank scaling, around β=0.29 in the aggregate setting, while Muon reaches near-linear scaling, around β=0.82. On rare-token or TAIL representations, AdamW also scales poorly; the abstract reports β=0.44 for AdamW in this regime, while Muon substantially improves utilization. The hard-soft asymmetry is itself optimizer-dependent: AdamW has a larger gap, about Δ_1,2=0.37, whereas Muon and Dion(1/2) reduce it to around 0.14. The paper further shows that learning-rate tuning, longer training, and matched perplexity do not remove the spectral gap. Additional comparisons with attention-rank changes, RoPE removal, and partial PostLN configurations indicate that optimizer-induced spectral shifts can dominate or reshape architecture-induced effects. In some PostLN settings, orthonormal or matrix-aware optimizers reach useful perplexity where AdamW does not.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the introduction carefully for the central distinction between matched loss and matched representation geometry. In the methods section, focus on how FFN spectra are computed, how soft and hard spectral ranks are defined, and how the width-scaling exponents are fit. The most important experimental figures are the spectral-rank scaling curves across width, the token-frequency-stratified results, and the controls for learning rate, training duration, and loss matching. The architecture-interaction experiments are best read after the main optimizer comparison; their main role is to show that architectural capacity is expressed through optimizer geometry. A useful follow-up question is whether hard spectral rank correlates with rare-token prediction, factual recall, or long-tail knowledge retention more directly than validation loss.

recommendation.zh: 会改变我对 optimizer ablation 的 prior：不要只看 loss，应立刻复现谱秩随宽度的曲线。
recommendation.en: This changes the optimizer-ablation prior: loss alone is insufficient; reproduce the spectral-rank-vs-width curves internally.

paper.title: Scaling Behaviors of LLM Reinforcement Learning Post-Training: An Empirical Study in Mathematical Reasoning
paper.abstract: While scaling laws for large language models (LLMs) during pre-training have been extensively studied, their behavior under reinforcement learning (RL) post-training remains largely unexplored. This paper presents a systematic empirical investigation of scaling behaviors in RL-based post-training, with a particular focus on mathematical reasoning. Based on a set of experiments across the full Qwen2.5 dense model series (0.5B to 72B), we characterize how model scale, data volume, and computationa

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 RL post-training 在数学推理上的 scaling 行为：给定模型规模、RL 计算量、可用题目数量和数据复用强度，模型的 Pass Rate 改善是否存在可预测规律。它关心的不是某个 RL recipe 的单点效果，而是类似预训练 scaling law 的资源分配问题：在固定 FLOPs、固定唯一数据量、或固定总训练样本量时，应当选择多大的模型、训练多久、是否重复使用数据。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的价值在于，它把 post-train RL 从经验配方推进到可量化的资源规划问题。预训练 scaling law 通常用 loss、参数量、token 数和 compute 建模；这篇工作把类似思想放到 reasoning RL，使用 1 - PassRate 作为 test loss，分析模型规模和 RL 资源之间的关系。最有用的结论有三点：第一，大模型在 RL 阶段也更 compute-efficient 和 data-efficient，不只是初始能力更强；第二，这种效率提升有饱和趋势，不能简单外推为参数越大越划算；第三，在数据受限时，重复使用小规模高质量题目接近使用更大语料的效果。这对 RL pretrain、reasoning mid-train、以及后训练预算分配都有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法设计比较干净。作者选用 Qwen2.5 同构模型族，覆盖 0.5B、1.5B、3B、7B、14B、32B、72B，尽量让参数规模成为主要变量。RL 训练使用 VeRL 框架，训练数据来自 Reasoning360 的 guru-RL-92k 数学子集，并经过去重和难度过滤；题目按 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 的 pass rate 从易到难排序，用作 curriculum。评测分两类：一类是 500 道同分布 held-out math problems，用于拟合和验证 scaling 公式；另一类是更宽的泛化评测，包括 AIME2024、AMC2023、GSM8K、MATH500、HumanEval、Zebra Puzzle、SuperGPQA。核心建模是把 RL 后的 test loss 写成模型规模 N 和资源预算 X 的函数，其中 X 可以是 compute C 或数据量 D。经验上，loss 随资源预算呈近似 log-linear 的下降；斜率可理解为学习效率 k(N)。进一步，k(N) 随模型规模增大而提高，但以饱和函数逼近上限 K_max，表示大模型的边际 RL 效率收益会递减。这个设定比简单拟合每个模型的学习曲线更有解释力，因为它同时回答了“同样预算给哪个尺寸”和“继续加大模型是否还划算”。
summary.experiments: 实验规模是这篇论文的主要支撑。作者在 Qwen2.5 0.5B 到 72B 上训练了 63 个 RL 模型，使用超过 50k 道数学题。主要结果显示，在 0.5B–72B 范围内，RL 带来的 loss reduction 与 compute 大致满足 log-linear 趋势；大模型不仅起点更好，单位 compute 和单位数据带来的提升也更高。论文还比较了 base model 和 instruct model，报告所提出的 power-law 形式在两类初始化上都具有预测性，能够外推较大模型表现和训练后期轨迹。数据受限实验显示，重复曝光较小数据集的效果接近使用更多唯一题目，说明对 math RL 来说，高质量题目的 reuse 是有效策略。附录还分析了 GRPO 中 rollout number 的影响，用于理解采样数量对 RL 学习效率和稳定性的作用。给定片段没有提供具体 benchmark 分数和拟合参数，因此不应过度解读绝对提升幅度；更可靠的结论是趋势、相对效率和可预测性。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读实验设置、scaling law 公式和三组资源约束实验。优先看：1）模型族、数据、curriculum 和评测协议，判断变量控制是否足够干净；2）loss versus compute/data 的主图，重点看不同模型尺寸的斜率差异；3）k(N) 饱和拟合，判断 32B 到 72B 的边际收益是否已经明显下降；4）data-constrained 和 data reuse 实验，因为这部分最接近实际 RL 数据预算决策；5）base 与 instruct 初始化的对比，理解预训练/指令调优状态如何影响 RL scaling；6）GRPO rollout number 的附录，关注采样预算与学习信号质量之间的关系。深挖时要特别注意两个限制：数学题 reward 相对清晰，结论未必直接迁移到开放式偏好 RL；使用 Qwen2.5 单一模型族有利于控制变量，但也限制了架构和 tokenizer 差异下的外推。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether RL post-training for mathematical reasoning has predictable scaling behavior. The central question is how model size, RL compute, unique training problems, and data reuse interact when the target metric is pass-rate improvement rather than pretraining cross-entropy. It frames RL post-training as a resource allocation problem: under fixed FLOPs, fixed unique data, or fixed total sample budget, which model size and training regime should be preferred.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an empirical scaling study for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. It extends the scaling-law mindset from pretraining loss to reasoning RL, using 1 - PassRate as a test loss. The useful signal is not just that larger models perform better after RL, but that they learn more efficiently during RL as well. At the same time, the efficiency gain appears to saturate with scale, so the result does not support a naive “larger is always proportionally better” extrapolation. The data reuse finding is also practically relevant: when high-quality reasoning problems are scarce, repeated exposure to a smaller curated set can be close to using a larger pool of unique problems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study controls model-family variation by using Qwen2.5 models from 0.5B to 72B parameters: 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B, 32B, and 72B. RL runs are conducted with VeRL. The training set is the math subset of guru-RL-92k from Reasoning360, after deduplication and difficulty filtering. Problems are sorted by increasing difficulty using the pass rate of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, forming a curriculum. Evaluation has two layers: a 500-problem in-domain held-out set for fitting and validating the scaling relation, and a broader benchmark suite covering AIME2024, AMC2023, GSM8K, MATH500, HumanEval, Zebra Puzzle, and SuperGPQA. The proposed formulation models post-RL test loss as a function of model size N and a resource budget X, where X can be compute or data. Empirically, loss decreases approximately log-linearly with the resource budget. The slope is interpreted as a learning-efficiency term k(N), and k(N) increases with model size but approaches a saturation limit K_max. This is the key modeling choice: it separates initial capability from RL learning efficiency and makes diminishing returns explicit.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical base consists of 63 RL-trained LLMs across the Qwen2.5 scale range, trained on more than 50k math problems. The main observation is that, from 0.5B to 72B, RL-induced loss reduction follows an approximately log-linear trend with compute. Larger models start stronger and also gain more per unit of compute and per unit of data. The paper reports that the same power-law style relation is predictive for both base and instruction-tuned initializations, including extrapolation to larger models and later training stages. In the data-limited regime, reusing a smaller set of problems is nearly as effective as increasing the number of unique problems under comparable total exposure. The appendix also studies the number of rollouts in GRPO, which is relevant for separating sample budget from reward-signal quality. The provided text does not expose exact benchmark scores or fitted coefficients, so the robust takeaway is the shape of the scaling behavior rather than a specific numerical improvement.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the experimental setup first, especially the model family, curriculum construction, reward/evaluation protocol, and the distinction between in-domain scaling validation and out-of-domain generalization. Then focus on the main loss-versus-compute and loss-versus-data plots, looking at slope differences across model sizes. The most important figure is the saturation fit for k(N), because it determines whether scaling RL to larger models remains cost-effective. The data-constrained and data-reuse sections are worth close reading for practical training decisions. Also inspect the comparison between base and instruction-tuned initializations, since it indicates how much the RL scaling law depends on the starting policy. The GRPO rollout-number ablation is useful for understanding whether more samples improve learning by reducing variance or by changing the exploration distribution.

recommendation.zh: 要读：它把 RLVR 拉进 scaling-law 框架，尤其应复现 k(N) 饱和项，避免把大模型 RL 效率外推得过满。
recommendation.en: Read it for the k(N) saturation result; the setup is narrow, but it is a useful guardrail against naive RLVR scale extrapolation.

The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: Dropout Universality: Scaling Laws and Optimal Scheduling at the Edge-of-Chaos
paper.abstract: We develop a mean-field theory of dropout as a perturbation of critical signal propagation at the edge of chaos. Dropout shifts the perfect-alignment fixed point, making the depth scale for information propagation finite even at critical initialization. We derive critical and crossover scaling laws for correlation decay and establish that smooth activations and kinked, ReLU-like activations constitute distinct universality classes, with different critical exponents and a universal two-parameter

summary.core_problem: 从均值场角度解释 dropout 如何扰动 edge-of-chaos 临界信号传播，并推导相关衰减的 scaling law 与最优调度。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是基础训练动力学分析，尝试把 dropout 强度、网络深度、激活函数光滑性和信息传播长度联系起来；对 LLM 预训练不是直接 recipe，但对正则化与初始化临界性的关系有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 把 dropout 建模为对临界信号传播的扰动，分析 perfect-alignment fixed point 的偏移；区分 smooth activations 与 ReLU-like kinked activations 两类 universality class，并给出 detuning 与 dropout strength 下的双参数 scaling collapse。随后在固定 dropout budget 下推导 saturated dropout profiles，并用 rank-flow tie-breaker 选择 front-loaded schedules。
summary.experiments: 摘要声称 front-loaded dropout schedule 在不增加计算成本的情况下显著降低 held-out test loss，并报告 accuracy 也有收益；但未给出网络规模、任务、baseline、具体数值或是否覆盖 Transformer/LLM setting。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how dropout perturbs critical signal propagation at the edge of chaos and derives scaling laws for correlation decay and dropout scheduling.
summary_en.importance: This is a foundational training-dynamics analysis rather than an LLM pretraining recipe. It may still be useful for understanding the interaction between regularization, initialization criticality, depth, and activation smoothness.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work models dropout as a perturbation of mean-field critical propagation, showing that it shifts the perfect-alignment fixed point and makes the information-propagation depth scale finite. It separates smooth and ReLU-like kinked activations into different universality classes and proposes budget-constrained saturated dropout profiles with a rank-flow tie-breaker favoring front-loaded schedules.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims that front-loaded dropout schedules substantially reduce held-out test loss at no additional compute cost, with accuracy gains. It does not specify model scale, datasets, baselines, effect sizes, or whether the results transfer to Transformer-scale training.

recommendation.zh: 只看理论主张和调度实验即可；若没有 Transformer 实验，就别把结论外推到 LLM dropout recipe。
recommendation.en: Read the theory claim and scheduling experiment only; without Transformer evidence, do not promote it into an LLM dropout recipe.

paper.title: Introspective X Training: Feedback Conditioning Improves Scaling Across all LLM Training Stages
paper.abstract: We tackle the question of how to scale more efficiently across the many, ever-growing stages of current LLM training pipelines. Our guiding intuition stems from the fact that the dynamics of later stages of the pipeline, e.g. post-training, can be used to inform earlier stages such as pre-training. To this end, we propose Introspective Training (or IXT), inspired by offline reward-conditioned reinforcement learning and applicable to any stage of training. IXT uses a thinking reward model to anno

summary.core_problem: 随着 LLM 训练阶段（预训练、中继训练、后训练）的不断增加，如何打破阶段间的壁垒，利用后期阶段的动态（如数据质量区分）来指导和提升早期阶段（如预训练）的计算效率。
summary.importance: 提出了一种跨越所有训练阶段的通用方法 IXT，通过在预训练早期引入质量感知，显著提升了 Scaling 效率（最高 2.8 倍 FLOPs 效率提升），为优化长周期 LLM 训练 pipeline 提供了重要参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Introspective Training (IXT)，受离线奖励条件 RL 启发。核心机制是：使用一个“思考型奖励模型”（如 Qwen3-30B-A3B）根据预设的 rubric（涵盖写作风格、专业度、教育价值、事实密度、效率等维度）对训练数据进行离线标注，生成自然语言 critique 或模板化的质量 token。在训练时，将这些反馈作为 prefix 附加到数据前，使模型在 NTP 目标下进行条件生成。测试时，通过提供描述期望输出特征的 prefix（质量标签或 critique）来引导生成。
summary.experiments: 在 7B 规模模型上，从头开始、95B、12T、18T token 阶段以及 SFT 阶段进行了广泛实验。结果表明：1. IXT 改变了 scaling 曲线，即使算上标注数据的额外计算开销，也能实现高达 2.8 倍的 FLOPs 效率提升；2. 在 95B token 早期阶段引入 IXT 进行数学和代码领域特化，能带来显著提升（HumanEval +9.2，MATH +10.1），且优势能保持到 18T 阶段；3. 在更广泛的混合数据上，IXT 相比标准训练平均提升 6.3 分；4. 自由形式的自然语言 critique 比模板化 token 平均高 2.6 分，且两者均优于无条件训练。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 IXT 的核心机制（Section 2），特别是 rubric 的设计和自然语言 critique 的生成方式。仔细阅读实验部分（Section 3），关注不同训练阶段（从头、95B、12T、18T、SFT）引入 IXT 的效果对比，以及关于 FLOPs 效率提升的分析。消融实验中关于不同反馈形式（自然语言 vs. 模板 token）的对比也值得深挖。

summary_en.core_problem: As LLM training pipelines grow with more stages (pre-training, mid-training, post-training), how to break the silos between stages and leverage the dynamics of later stages (e.g., data quality differentiation) to guide and improve the computational efficiency of earlier stages (e.g., pre-training).
summary_en.importance: Proposes IXT, a general method applicable across all training stages, which significantly improves scaling efficiency (up to 2.8x FLOPs efficiency gain) by introducing quality awareness early in pre-training, providing an important reference for optimizing long-cycle LLM training pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Introspective Training (IXT), inspired by offline reward-conditioned RL. The core mechanism is: using a 'thinking reward model' (e.g., Qwen3-30B-A3B) to offline annotate training data based on a predefined rubric (covering dimensions like writing style, expertise, educational value, fact density, efficiency, etc.), generating natural language critiques or templated quality tokens. During training, this feedback is prepended to the data as a prefix, enabling conditional generation under the NTP objective. At test time, generation is steered by providing a prefix describing desired output characteristics (quality label or critique).
summary_en.experiments: Extensive experiments on 7B scale models from scratch, at 95B, 12T, 18T token stages, and SFT stages. Results show: 1. IXT bends the scaling curve, achieving up to 2.8x FLOPs efficiency gains even accounting for the extra compute for data annotation; 2. Introducing IXT for math and code domain specialization early at the 95B token stage brings significant improvements (HumanEval +9.2, MATH +10.1), and the advantage persists up to the 18T stage; 3. On a broader data blend, IXT improves the average score by 6.3 points compared to standard training; 4. Free-form natural language critiques outperform templated tokens by 2.6 points on average, and both are better than unconditional training.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the core mechanism of IXT (Section 2), especially the design of the rubric and the generation of natural language critiques. Carefully read the experiments section (Section 3), paying attention to the comparison of introducing IXT at different training stages (from scratch, 95B, 12T, 18T, SFT), and the analysis of FLOPs efficiency gains. The ablation study comparing different feedback forms (natural language vs. templated tokens) is also worth digging into.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻复现小规模 ablation：它直接挑战“预训练只需均匀 token loss”的 prior，成本核算是主要坑。
recommendation.en: Worth an immediate small-scale ablation: it challenges the prior that pretraining only needs uniform token loss, with cost accounting as the main trap.

paper.title: A Bitter Lesson for Data Filtering
paper.abstract: We investigate data filtering for large model pretraining via new scaling studies that target the high compute, data-scarce regime. In spite of an apparently common belief that filtering data to include only high-quality information is essential, our experiments suggest that with enough compute, the best data filter is no data filter. We find that sufficiently trained large parameter models not only tolerate low-quality and distractor data, but in fact benefit from nominally ``poor'' data.

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要回答一个直接但代价很高的问题：在大模型预训练进入高算力、数据相对稀缺的区间后，传统的数据过滤是否仍然必要。常见做法是假设 Common Crawl 里有大量低质量文本，需要用质量分类器、规则、困惑度过滤等方法保留少量高质量子集。作者挑战的是这个前提：如果模型足够大、训练足够久，过滤掉的大量“低质量”数据是否反而成为限制 scaling 的瓶颈。
summary.importance: 对预训练数据策略的影响很具体：数据过滤不应被看成固定的离线质量工程，而应看成随算力、模型规模、数据池大小变化的优化问题。低算力时，高质量子集通常更有效，因为模型还没有能力从噪声和异质数据里稳定提取信息；高算力时，过滤带来的 token 损失、覆盖面损失和重复训练代价会逐渐超过质量收益。这个结论会改变数据管线的优先级：与其只追求更强的静态过滤器，更应关注去重、解析、毒性和安全约束、数据来源覆盖、epoching 策略，以及可预测的 compute-dependent filtering。它不是说所有脏数据都无害，而是说在普通 Common Crawl 这类大池子里，现有过滤器可能在大规模训练下过早丢掉了有用统计量。
summary.technical_approach: 作者采用缩放实验而不是单点大训练来研究过滤效果。核心设计是保留 Common Crawl 原始池与若干过滤版本之间的相对大小关系，把它们按比例缩小，然后在这些池子上系统改变模型大小和训练步数。训练步数增加会带来 epoching，模型大小增加会提高每步计算量，两者共同模拟高算力、数据受限的预训练区间。评价时不是只比较同等 token 或同等步数下的性能，而是比较在不同计算预算下各数据选择策略能达到的最好结果。这个设计抓住了过滤的关键代价：过滤不只是提高平均质量，也会减少可用 token，增加重复训练。作者进一步构建 pool size、training steps、model size 之间的经验 scaling law，用于预测某个数据池规模下什么时候 no-filter 会变成最优选择。随后他们做了更激进的鲁棒性实验，把随机字符串、词序打乱文档等“junk”数据加入训练，测试大模型是否只是在容忍噪声，还是能从极弱信号里获得收益。最后给出后验理论模型，解释为什么有限容量模型更需要清洗，而高容量、长训练模型可以从噪声生成过程和边缘统计中受益。
summary.experiments: 几个数字最关键。DCLM-Baseline 这类强过滤数据大约只保留原始 Common Crawl 的 1%，对应约 3.8T tokens；而 DCLM-Pool 规模约 240T tokens。作者的缩放实验覆盖约两个数量级的计算变化，结论在小池放大到更大池时仍能观察到：只要模型足够大，完整池最终会超过过滤池。基于 scaling law，他们估计 240T token 的 Common Crawl 池可能在约 1e30 FLOPs 附近进入 no-filter 最优区间。低算力区间过滤仍然占优，这一点很重要，因为它解释了很多既有数据过滤工作的成功经验；差异出现在更大模型、更长训练、数据重复更明显的区间。噪声实验显示，随机字符串在低算力下会拖累性能，但大模型长训练后可以缩小差距；词序打乱文档更有意思，因为它保留了 unigram 分布但破坏了句法和语义顺序，充分训练的大模型仍能从中获益。这说明模型利用的不只是人工定义的“高质量文档”，还包括词频、实体分布、主题覆盖、长尾词表等较弱统计信号。作者也明确限制了结论边界：如果存在大量看起来像高质量文本但事实错误、恶意构造或安全风险高的数据，仍可能有害；他们只是没有在 Common Crawl 的自然噪声里观察到足以抵消规模收益的坏影响。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction 中对数据受限预训练和 DCLM 过滤比例的动机分析，这是理解全文的入口。实验部分应重点看三类图表：第一，过滤池与完整池随 compute 增长的交叉点；第二，模型大小、训练步数、epoching 对过滤收益的交互；第三，pool size scaling law 对 240T Common Crawl 的外推。噪声数据章节值得细看，尤其是随机字符串和 shuffled-word documents 的对照，因为它区分了“模型能忍受噪声”和“模型能从弱统计中获益”这两个命题。理论章节不必先读公式，可先看假设：有限模型容量下清洗数据有利，高容量模型下清洗可能丢失可学习信号。真正值得深挖的是评价协议：同等算力、同等 token、同等最好性能这几种比较方式会给出不同结论；数据过滤工作的分歧，很多来自比较口径不同。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether data filtering remains necessary when language-model pretraining moves into a high-compute, data-scarce regime. The usual assumption is that Common Crawl contains enough low-quality text that strong filters are required. The authors test the opposite hypothesis: once models are large enough and trained long enough, removing most of the crawl may become the main bottleneck.
summary_en.importance: The practical implication is that data filtering should be treated as a compute-dependent decision, not as a fixed offline quality step. At small compute, filtered subsets can be better because the model cannot reliably extract signal from heterogeneous or noisy text. At larger compute, the lost token volume, lost coverage, and increased need for repeated epochs can outweigh the gains from higher average quality. This shifts attention from ever more aggressive static filters toward broader pool construction, parsing quality, deduplication, safety constraints, source diversity, and scaling laws for filtering thresholds. The result does not imply that all bad data is harmless; it says that, for naturally noisy Common Crawl-style pools, existing filters may discard useful statistical signal too early.
summary_en.technical_approach: The experimental design scales down Common Crawl and its filtered variants while preserving their relative sizes, then varies model size and training steps over these pools. Increasing steps induces data repetition; increasing model size raises compute per step. This setup directly probes the tradeoff introduced by filtering: it improves average document quality but reduces the available token pool. The authors compare the best performance achievable under different compute budgets rather than relying only on fixed-token or fixed-step comparisons. They then fit empirical relationships among pool size, number of training steps, and model size to predict when no filtering should become optimal. A second set of experiments injects deliberately degraded data, including random strings and documents with shuffled word order, to test whether large models merely tolerate noise or can still extract weak signals from it. A post-hoc theoretical model explains the observed pattern: cleaning helps imperfect, capacity-limited learners, while sufficiently capable learners can benefit from modeling the noisy generation process itself.
summary_en.experiments: The key scale numbers are informative. A heavily filtered dataset such as DCLM-Baseline keeps roughly 1% of the original Common Crawl, yielding about 3.8T tokens, while the DCLM-Pool scale is around 240T tokens. The study spans about two orders of magnitude in compute, and the same qualitative trend persists as the pool scale increases: once the model is large enough and trained long enough, the full pool overtakes filtered pools. The fitted scaling law suggests that the 240T-token Common Crawl pool may become optimal around 1e30 FLOPs. Filtering still wins in lower-compute regimes, which explains why earlier filtering studies saw strong benefits. The noisy-data experiments add a useful boundary case. Random strings hurt at low compute, but sufficiently trained large models narrow the gap. Shuffled-word documents are more revealing: they destroy syntax and local semantics while preserving unigram statistics, yet large models can still benefit from them. This indicates that useful signal is not limited to human-defined high-quality prose; token frequencies, entity coverage, topical diversity, and long-tail lexical statistics also matter. The authors also state an important limitation: adversarial, non-factual, or safety-critical data that resembles high-quality text could still be harmful.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the motivation around data scarcity, epoching, and the DCLM filtering ratio. The most important experimental figures are the compute-dependent crossover between filtered and unfiltered pools, the interaction between model size and number of training steps, and the pool-size scaling law used to extrapolate to the 240T-token setting. The degraded-data section is worth close reading because it separates two claims: robustness to noise and positive use of weak statistical signal. The theory section can be read after the experiments; focus first on its assumptions rather than the algebra. The most important methodological detail is the comparison protocol. Equal compute, equal tokens, and best-achieved performance answer different questions, and many disagreements about data filtering come from mixing these evaluation regimes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接动摇“先把数据洗干净再谈 scaling”的默认流程；先看实验设定是否真在 data-scarce 且 train-to-convergence，若是，内部数据过滤 ablation 该重做。
recommendation.en: This one can genuinely weaken the default 'filter hard before scaling' prior; first verify that the setup is truly data-scarce and close to convergence, and if so, redo your internal filtering ablations.

paper.title: GQA-μP: The maximal parameterization update for grouped query attention
paper.abstract: Hyperparameter transfer across model architectures dramatically reduces the amount of compute necessary for tuning large language models (LLMs). The maximal update parameterization (μP) ensures transfer through principled mathematical analysis but can be challenging to derive for new model architectures. Building on the spectral feature-learning view of Yang et al. (2023a), we make two advances. First, we promote spectral norm conditions on the weights from a heuristic to the definition of featu

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体但很关键的问题：μP/Complete-P 这套超参迁移理论，到了 grouped-query attention（GQA）这种生产里常见的注意力结构上，原有做法会出现“坐标检查通过，但学习率迁移失败”的现象。论文要解决的不是再给一个经验修补，而是解释为什么旧理论在这里失效，并给出一套能覆盖低秩权重矩阵、深度缩放、weight decay 与 GQA 的统一推导框架。更细一点说，问题有两层。第一，过去 spectral μP 把谱范数条件当作推出 feature learning 的充分条件，但定义本身仍沿用较弱的 feature-learning 表述，导致一些实现虽然通过常规 coordinate check，却没有真正满足可迁移所需的算子尺度约束。第二，GQA 的某些权重天然低秩，经典谱范数刻画的是“最坏方向”的放大率，但训练时输入分布几乎不会落到这些方向上，于是谱范数给出的尺度与训练中真实看到的层输出尺度脱节，进而破坏学习率迁移。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有三点。第一，它把 μP 从“主要适用于标准 dense/attention 结构的宽度迁移工具”，往“可用于新架构设计与生产注意力变体”的方向推进了一步。GQA 已经是大模型训练和部署中的主流配置之一，如果这类结构没有可靠的 μP 标定，很多小模型调参再迁移到大模型的流程就不稳。第二，它补强了 Complete-P 这条线：不仅学习率，连 weight decay 和与训练时长相关的 τ_epoch 也开始进入可迁移的讨论范围，这对大规模预训练的超参搜索成本有直接影响。第三，它的方法论价值高于 GQA 本身。论文强调，判断 μP 是否成立，不能只看传统 coordinate check，还要看更严格的 operator-norm 级别条件；同时，当层是低秩或退化结构时，必须用与训练输入分布匹配的范数来刻画“有效尺度”。这对后续分析 MoE、共享投影、多查询/分组查询注意力、递归块等非标准结构都有启发。
summary.technical_approach:
技术上有三步。第一步，作者重写了 spectral μP 的逻辑起点。过去做法通常是：先定义 feature learning，再证明某些谱范数缩放能推出它。这里更进一步，把算子范数条件提升到定义层面，直接围绕“初始化与更新在 operator norm 下应如何随宽度、深度缩放”来组织推导。这样做的好处是，Complete-P 里涉及 depth scaling、weight decay、递归块时，不必再借助 lazy-learning 近似去兜底，而是直接从算子尺度出发给出条件。

第二步，作者指出普通谱范数在低秩矩阵上会系统性失真，于是引入 expected operator norm。它不是看矩阵对最坏单位向量的放大，而是看对训练中典型输入分布（文中取高斯 i.i.d. 输入）下向量的期望放大。对满秩随机矩阵，这个量与谱范数同阶，所以不会破坏已有理论；但对 GQA 这类低秩/退化矩阵，它更接近训练时真实激活尺度。论文的核心判断是：Tensor Programs 给出的训练期输入近似 i.i.d.，因此那些触发谱范数极值的方向在训练中概率几乎为零，用 expected operator norm 才能恢复正确的缩放律。

第三步，基于这套新范数和 operator-norm 视角，作者为 GQA 推导 μP 缩放。GQA 的关键在于 query 头数与 key/value 头数不一致，KV 头被多个 query 组共享，导致相关投影矩阵的有效秩、输出方差和更新尺度都与标准 MHA 不同。论文据此重新给出参数初始化、学习率、深度、weight decay 的缩放规则，并提出更严格的 spectral-norm coordinate check 来替代旧版实现中的坐标检查。作者还讨论了不同 GQA repetition 数之间迁移时的噪声问题，说明即便理论上宽度迁移成立，跨 repetition 的结构变化仍会引入额外不稳定性。
summary.experiments:
实验部分的重点不是刷任务分数，而是验证“旧实现为什么错，新缩放为什么对”。从引言和正文可见，作者做了几类关键实验。第一类是 coordinate check / spectral check：原始 μP 实现对 GQA 能通过传统坐标检查，但在更严格的谱范数检查下失败，这与后续学习率迁移失败相一致。也就是说，问题不是训练偶然不稳，而是检查指标本身不够强。第二类是学习率迁移实验：在 GQA 设置下，旧 μP 缩放不能实现从小宽度模型到大宽度模型的零样本学习率迁移；采用新推导的 GQA-μP 后，最优学习率区间在不同宽度间明显更一致。论文还特别指出，若同时改变 GQA repetition 数，迁移曲线会变得更噪，说明 repetition 不是一个“可忽略的次要结构超参”。

第三类是 Complete-P 相关实验。作者报告，在正确缩放下，weight decay 以及 Wang and Aitchison (2024) 提出的训练时长常数 τ_epoch 也表现出可迁移性。这一点很重要，因为很多 μP 工作只验证学习率，而预训练里真正昂贵的是一整组耦合超参。虽然给定材料里没有完整表格数字，但论文明确提到实验覆盖了 GQA 学习率迁移、weight decay 迁移和 τ_epoch 迁移，并用图 1、图 5 等展示旧实现与新实现的差异。阅读时应重点看这些图对应的最优区间是否随宽度保持稳定，以及不同 repetition 下方差如何变化。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“问题暴露—理论修正—GQA 推导—迁移验证”这条线读。

先看 Introduction，抓住两个反直觉点：一是 GQA 下旧 μP 能过 coordinate check 却不能迁移学习率；二是低秩矩阵让谱范数失去训练相关性。接着看“Deriving Novel Maximal Update Parameterizations”这一节，重点理解作者为什么把 operator-norm 条件从启发式提升到定义层面，以及 expected operator norm 的定义、适用边界和与普通谱范数何时等价。这里是全文最有方法论价值的部分。

然后精读 GQA 推导部分。要盯住三件事：GQA 的哪些矩阵是低秩或等效低秩；这些矩阵在共享 KV 头时如何改变层输出尺度；新缩放规则具体如何依赖宽度、头分组和 repetition。若只想抓住结论，可以把推导中的每个矩阵缩放整理成一张表。

实验部分优先看图 1、图 2、图 5 以及学习率迁移、weight decay 迁移、τ_epoch 迁移对应的主图。图 2 负责解释“谱范数看到了训练中几乎不会出现的方向”，这是理解 expected operator norm 必不可少的一张图。最后再看附录中的证明和实现细节，尤其是更严格 coordinate check 的定义。对做大模型训练的人，最值得深挖的是：以后遇到低秩共享结构时，是否都该用分布相关的 operator norm 来重写 μP 检查与推导。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a precise but important failure mode in μP/Complete-P: standard μP checks can appear to pass for grouped-query attention (GQA), yet learning-rate transfer across widths still breaks in practice. The goal is not to patch this empirically, but to explain why the existing theory becomes insufficient for GQA and to derive a parameterization that restores transfer. The issue has two layers. First, prior spectral-μP arguments treated spectral-norm conditions as a sufficient route to feature learning, while the operational checks used in implementations were weaker; this leaves room for architectures that pass coordinate checks without satisfying the stronger operator-scale conditions needed for transfer. Second, GQA introduces intrinsically low-rank weight structures. For such matrices, the ordinary spectral norm measures amplification along worst-case directions that are effectively never seen under the training input distribution, so it mischaracterizes the scale that actually matters during optimization.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is broader than GQA itself. First, GQA is already a standard attention variant in production LLMs, so having no principled μP scaling for it weakens the practical promise of small-model hyperparameter sweeps followed by large-model transfer. This paper closes that gap. Second, it strengthens the Complete-P line of work by extending transferability beyond learning rate to weight decay and the training-time constant τ_epoch, which matters directly for reducing hyperparameter search cost in large-scale pretraining. Third, the methodological lesson is strong: for nonstandard architectures, passing a conventional coordinate check is not enough; one needs operator-norm-level checks that reflect the actual training distribution. That point is likely relevant beyond GQA, including shared projections, low-rank modules, recursive blocks, and potentially other structured attention variants.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The technical contribution has three parts. First, the paper reformulates the spectral-μP perspective around operator norms more directly. Instead of starting from a weaker feature-learning definition and then showing that spectral conditions imply it, the authors elevate operator-norm scaling conditions to the center of the framework. This lets them derive Complete-P-style prescriptions for depth and weight decay without leaning on a lazy-training fallback.

Second, they introduce the expected operator norm to replace the ordinary spectral norm when matrices are rank-degenerate. The standard spectral norm captures the largest possible deformation over all unit vectors. That is appropriate for full-rank random matrices, where the extremal scale is asymptotically representative. But for GQA-like low-rank matrices, the extremal directions occupy measure-zero sets relative to the i.i.d. input distribution encountered during training. The expected operator norm instead measures the average deformation under a chosen input distribution, taken in the paper to be Gaussian i.i.d. This preserves the usual scaling for full-rank random matrices while correcting the mismatch for low-rank operators.

Third, using this revised norm and operator-centric framework, the paper derives μP scaling rules for GQA. Because GQA shares key/value heads across multiple query groups, the effective rank, output scale, and update scale of the relevant projections differ from standard multi-head attention. The authors work through these differences and derive the corresponding initialization, learning-rate, depth, and weight-decay scalings. They also propose a stricter spectral-norm coordinate check, showing that the original implementation can pass the old check while failing the stronger one that actually predicts transfer behavior.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are aimed at validating the theory rather than maximizing downstream benchmark scores. One key result is diagnostic: the original μP implementation for GQA passes the customary coordinate checks but fails a stricter spectral/operator-norm check, and this aligns with its empirical failure to transfer learning rates across widths. That is an important negative result because it shows the old check is not sufficiently discriminative for structured attention.

The main empirical validation is width-wise learning-rate transfer under GQA. With the original scaling, the optimal learning-rate region does not remain stable across widths. With the newly derived GQA-μP scaling, transfer becomes substantially more consistent. The paper also reports that transfer across different GQA repetition counts is noisy, which is a useful practical warning: changing repetition is not a benign architectural perturbation from the standpoint of hyperparameter transfer.

A second set of experiments concerns Complete-P quantities. Under the corrected scaling, both weight decay and the training-time constant τ_epoch from Wang and Aitchison (2024) appear transferable as well. The provided text does not include the full numeric tables, but the paper explicitly points to Figures 1 and 5 and to experiments covering learning-rate, weight-decay, and τ_epoch transfer. When reading, the important thing is to inspect whether the optimal hyperparameter bands remain aligned across widths and how variance changes when repetition is altered.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in the order of failure case, theoretical repair, GQA derivation, and transfer validation.

Start with the introduction. Two observations matter immediately: standard μP checks can succeed while transfer still fails for GQA, and low-rank structure makes the ordinary spectral norm poorly aligned with training-time behavior. Then move to the section on deriving novel maximal update parameterizations. This is the conceptual core. Focus on why operator-norm conditions are promoted from a heuristic implication to a defining principle, and on the exact role of the expected operator norm.

Next, read the GQA derivation carefully. Track which matrices become low-rank or effectively rank-deficient, how KV sharing changes output scaling, and how the final prescriptions depend on width, grouping, and repetition. If you want the practical takeaway quickly, extract the scaling rules into a table.

In the experiments, prioritize Figures 1, 2, and 5, plus the plots for learning-rate, weight-decay, and τ_epoch transfer. Figure 2 is especially important because it visualizes the gap between worst-case spectral directions and the directions actually sampled during training. The appendices are worth reading for the stricter coordinate-check definition and proof details. The deepest follow-up question is whether future μP analyses for other structured or low-rank modules should also be rewritten in terms of distribution-aware operator norms.

recommendation.zh: 首次给出GQA架构的μP缩放规则，可直接复用降低调参成本，建议立刻复现到内部GQA模型的超参搜索流程中。
recommendation.en: First derivation of μP scaling for GQA; immediately reproduce the rules in your internal GQA model's hyperparameter search pipeline to cut tuning cost.

paper.title: How to Scale Mixture-of-Experts: From muP to the Maximally Scale-Stable Parameterization
paper.abstract: Recent frontier large language models predominantly rely on Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures. Despite empirical progress, there is still no principled understanding of how hyperparameters should scale with network width $N$, expert width $N_e$, number of experts $M$, sparsity $K$, and depth $L$ to ensure both stability and optimal performance at scale. We take a principled step toward resolving this gap by analyzing three different scaling regimes: (I) co-scaling $N\asymp N_e$, (II) co-sca

summary.core_problem: 在混合专家（MoE）架构中，随着网络宽度、专家宽度、专家数量、稀疏度和深度的扩展，如何设置超参数以保证训练的稳定性和最优性能，目前缺乏原则性的理解。传统的 $\mu$P 参数化在 MoE 中无法可靠地实现学习率迁移和性能随规模的单调提升。
summary.importance: 为 MoE 模型的扩展提供了一套完整的理论框架和参数化方案。通过引入动态平均场理论（DMFT）分析不同协同扩展机制，提出了最大尺度稳定参数化（MSSP），解决了 MoE 扩展中的超参数迁移难题，对训练千亿级 MoE 模型具有直接的指导意义。
summary.technical_approach: 研究了三种 MoE 协同扩展机制：(I) 宽度与专家宽度同比例扩展；(II) 宽度、专家数量和稀疏度同比例扩展（细粒度专家机制）；(III) 所有维度同比例扩展。针对每种机制，利用 DMFT 分析了极限训练动态，发现 $\mu$P 在 MoE 中存在尺度依赖性。为此，提出了 MSSP，通过对 $\mu$P 进行结构性修正（如机制 I 中的零路由初始化、机制 II 中的放大专家输出初始化方差、机制 III 中的共享专家权重初始化），实现了跨尺度的学习率迁移和性能单调提升。
summary.experiments: 在 MLP 和 Transformer MoE 上验证了 MSSP 的有效性。实验表明，在所有三种扩展机制下，MSSP 都能稳健地恢复学习率迁移，并使性能随规模单调提升。相比之下，传统的 $\mu$P 在大规模 MoE 中表现出不稳定性。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读 Introduction 中对三种扩展机制的定义，以及 MSSP 针对不同机制提出的具体修正方案（如初始化策略的调整）。DMFT 的理论推导较为复杂，可先关注其得出的结论，即 $\mu$P 在 MoE 中失效的原因。实验部分重点关注 MSSP 与 $\mu$P 在学习率迁移和性能扩展上的对比图表。

summary_en.core_problem: There is a lack of principled understanding on how to scale hyperparameters in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures alongside network width, expert width, number of experts, sparsity, and depth to ensure stability and optimal performance. The standard $\mu$P fails to reliably deliver learning rate transfer and monotonic performance improvement with scale in MoEs.
summary_en.importance: Provides a comprehensive theoretical framework and parameterization scheme for scaling MoE models. By introducing Dynamical Mean Field Theory (DMFT) to analyze different co-scaling regimes, the authors propose the Maximally Scale-Stable Parameterization (MSSP), solving the hyperparameter transfer challenge in MoE scaling, which is highly relevant for training 100B+ parameter MoEs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors study three MoE co-scaling regimes: (I) width and expert width scale proportionally; (II) width, number of experts, and sparsity scale proportionally (fine-grained experts); (III) all dimensions scale proportionally. Using DMFT to analyze the limiting training dynamics for each regime, they find that $\mu$P exhibits scale-dependence in MoEs. To address this, they propose MSSP, which applies structural corrections to $\mu$P (e.g., zero router initialization in Regime I, amplified expert-output initialization variance in Regime II, and shared expert weights at initialization in Regime III) to achieve cross-scale learning rate transfer and monotonic performance improvement.
summary_en.experiments: Validated MSSP on MLP and Transformer MoEs. Experiments show that across all three scaling regimes, MSSP robustly recovers learning rate transfer and restores monotonic performance improvement with scale. In contrast, standard $\mu$P exhibits instability in large-scale MoEs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the definitions of the three scaling regimes in the Introduction and the specific corrections proposed by MSSP for each regime (e.g., adjustments to initialization strategies). The DMFT derivations are complex; it is advisable to first grasp the conclusions regarding why $\mu$P fails in MoEs. In the experiments, pay close attention to the charts comparing MSSP and $\mu$P on learning rate transfer and performance scaling.

recommendation.zh: 应优先读推导和缩放实验；若结论稳，MoE sweep 不能再直接套 dense μP 当安全默认值。
recommendation.en: Prioritize the derivation and scaling experiments; if robust, dense-model μP should no longer be the safe default for MoE sweeps.

paper.title: Scaling Laws from Sequential Feature Recovery: A Solvable Hierarchical Model
paper.abstract: We propose a simple mechanism by which scaling laws emerge from feature learning in multi-layer networks. We study a high-dimensional hierarchical target that is a globally high-degree function, but that can be represented by a combination of latent compositional features whose weights decrease as a power law. We show that a layer-wise spectral algorithm adapted to this compositional structure achieves improved scaling relative to shallow, non-adaptive methods, and recovers the latent directions

summary.core_problem: 现有缩放定律理论大多基于线性化、核方法或固定随机特征假设，无法解释深度神经网络中特征序列学习规律、训练动态、深度带来的效率增益三者的关联，以及缩放定律的底层产生机制。
summary.importance: 为理解LLM预训练过程中的特征涌现顺序、训练损失幂律下降规律、深度对数据效率的提升作用提供了可解的理论框架，填补了基于固定谱偏置的理论与真实深度网络训练动态之间的研究空白。
summary.technical_approach: 构建具有分层组合结构的高维可解任务，其中隐层特征权重服从幂律分布；设计适配任务结构的分层谱算法，采用基于预解式的特征向量扰动分析突破传统Davis-Kahan界的精度限制，证明单个特征的恢复样本阈值，聚合这些阈值跃迁过程即可得到预测误差的幂律衰减规律。
summary.experiments: 数值实验验证了隐特征按强度从强到弱依次恢复的规律、渐近阈值的有限尺寸平滑效应，以及分层谱算法相对浅层核基线的样本效率优势，误差衰减过程与理论推导的幂律形式完全匹配。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看引言部分的问题梳理、第2节的任务定义、图1的核心概念示意以及实验结果部分，跳过复杂的随机矩阵证明细节，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing scaling law theories mostly rely on linearized, kernel, or fixed random feature assumptions, which fail to explain the correlation between sequential feature learning, training dynamics, efficiency gains from depth in deep neural networks, and the underlying formation mechanism of scaling laws.
summary_en.importance: It provides a solvable theoretical framework for understanding feature emergence order, power-law decay of training loss, and depth-driven improvement of data efficiency during LLM pre-training, filling the research gap between fixed spectral bias theories and real deep network training dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach: A tractable high-dimensional task with hierarchical compositional structure is constructed, where latent feature weights follow a power-law distribution. A hierarchical spectral algorithm adapted to the task structure is designed, using resolvent-based eigenvector perturbation analysis that breaks through the precision limit of traditional Davis-Kahan bounds to prove sample thresholds for individual feature recovery. Aggregating these threshold transitions derives the power-law decay rule of prediction error.
summary_en.experiments: Numerical experiments validate the sequential recovery of latent features from strong to weak intensity, finite-size smoothing effect of asymptotic thresholds, and sample efficiency advantage of the hierarchical spectral algorithm over shallow kernel baselines. The error decay process fully matches the theoretically derived power-law form.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the problem framing in Introduction, task definition in Section 2, core concept illustration in Figure 1, and experiment results. Skip complex random matrix proof details. Expected reading time is 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看第3节特征恢复阈值推导和第4节scaling幂律导出部分，可用于解释预训练中能力随数据量阶跃涌现的机制
recommendation.en: Only read Section 3 on feature recovery threshold derivation and Section 4 on scaling law derivation, which can explain the stepwise emergence of capabilities during pretraining as data volume increases

paper.title: The Efficiency Gap in Byte Modeling
paper.abstract: Modern language models have historically relied on two dominant design choices: subword tokenization and autoregressive (AR) ordering. These design decisions bake in priors that dictate a model's learning. Recently, two alternative paradigms have challenged this: byte-level modeling, which bypasses static statistically-derived token vocabularies, and masked diffusion modeling (MDM), which conducts parallel, non-sequential generation. Their intersection represents a fully end-to-end modality-agno

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究 byte-level 表示在不同语言建模目标下的计算代价，重点是 byte modeling 与 masked diffusion modeling 叠加后为什么会出现更大的效率缺口。问题不只是 byte 序列更长、注意力更贵，而是去掉 BPE 的子词先验后，模型需要自己学习词内结构；AR 和 MDM 对这种结构缺失的承受能力不同。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的影响在于，它把 tokenizer 选择和建模目标之间的耦合关系量化了。byte-level 建模常被视为更通用的表示，适合跨语言、跨模态和端到端生成；MDM 又被视为摆脱固定左到右顺序的一类候选范式。结果显示，两者直接组合并不自然高效。AR byte model 可以在较低计算预算下接近 BPE AR，而 byte-level MDM 的缺口持续更久，外推需要约 4×10^26 FLOPs 才可能追平，对比 AR 约 10^22 FLOPs。这个结论提示：如果要做 modality-agnostic 的 byte/token-free diffusion LM，不能只依赖规模扩大，需要重新引入某种结构先验，例如局部分块、动态 segmentation、层级表示或更适合 byte 序列的去噪条件设计。
summary.technical_approach: 方法设计较克制，核心是控制变量。模型骨干统一使用标准 Transformer，避免架构差异干扰结论。实验同时改变两个因素：表示方式为 raw UTF-8 byte 或 Llama 2 BPE；建模目标为 autoregressive LM 或 masked diffusion model。byte vocabulary 为 256，BPE vocabulary 为 32,000。为了让不同表示在每个 step 看到近似相同的原始信息量，byte context 设为 8192 bytes，BPE context 设为 1792 tokens，而不是简单使用相同 token length。MDM 使用 continuous-time discrete diffusion 框架，前向过程按 retention schedule 将 token 替换成 [MASK]，反向模型学习从部分 mask 的状态恢复原序列，推理时迭代 unmask。技术重点不在提出新模型，而在通过 compute-matched scaling study 拆出两类开销：一类是 byte 序列变长带来的计算开销，另一类是模型必须自行恢复 BPE 原本提供的词内结构。后者才是这项工作的主要发现。机制分析进一步观察 AR byte 模型的预测熵：熵峰和 BPE 边界对齐，说明 AR 模型在看到词片开头若干 byte 后，可以较快确定后续 byte，形成一种涌现的 segmentation。MDM 的随机 mask 破坏了这种稳定的因果上下文，模型经常要在词内 byte 缺失、局部顺序不完整的条件下恢复语义，因此 byte 表示对它更脆弱。受控 permutation 实验进一步区分了局部上下文破坏和顺序上下文破坏，确认 byte-level text diffusion 对 sequential integrity 更敏感。
summary.experiments: 预训练数据使用 SlimPajama-627B。实验比较四个组合：BPE-AR、Byte-AR、BPE-MDM、Byte-MDM，并按总 FLOPs 做 compute-matched 对比。关键结果是效率缺口随目标函数而变化。Byte-AR 相对 BPE-AR 有初始损失，但随规模增长快速收敛，isoFLOPs 外推显示约在 10^22 FLOPs 量级可接近 parity。Byte-MDM 相对 BPE-MDM 的性能偏移更持久，且 byte 模型相对 BPE 模型的改进速度低于 AR 设置；isoFLOPs 外推给出的追平预算约为 4×10^26 FLOPs。这个数量级差异说明 MDM 中的 byte penalty 不是简单的序列长度问题。机制实验观察到 AR byte 模型的 entropy pattern 与 BPE 边界一致，支持“模型学出了隐式词片分割”的解释。permutation 实验显示，破坏局部连续性和顺序上下文会显著削弱 byte 表示下的预测，MDM 的随机 mask 正好放大了这种问题。提供片段未给出完整参数规模网格和全部 benchmark 数字，因此精读时需要核对正文表格和 appendix 中的 scaling fit、loss 曲线和外推假设。
summary.reading_guide: 建议优先读实验设置和 scaling 结果，而不是只看引言结论。重点看四处：第一，Experimental Setup 中 context normalization 的设计，尤其是 8192 bytes 对 1792 BPE tokens，这决定了比较是否公平；第二，compute-matched scaling 曲线和 isoFLOPs extrapolation，关注外推公式、拟合区间和 confidence，而不只看 10^22 与 4×10^26 两个数字；第三，entropy 与 BPE boundary 对齐的机制分析，这是解释 AR byte 能追上 BPE 的核心证据；第四，controlled permutation experiments，它回答了为什么 MDM 更受伤。值得深挖的问题有三个：MDM 的 mask schedule 是否可以改到更保留局部连续性；byte 表示是否应和 learned chunking 或 hierarchical latent 一起使用；跨模态场景中是否存在类似 BPE 的结构先验，只是形式不是文本子词。

summary_en.core_problem: The work studies the compute cost of byte-level language modeling under different generative objectives. The central question is not only whether byte sequences are longer than BPE sequences, but why removing subword structure hurts masked diffusion models much more than autoregressive models. Byte modeling removes a fixed segmentation prior; AR and MDM objectives differ in how easily they can recover that structure during training.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a clean measurement of the interaction between tokenization and modeling objective. Byte-level modeling is attractive for universal, tokenizer-light, modality-agnostic pretraining. Masked diffusion is attractive because it removes the fixed left-to-right generation order. Their direct combination, however, has a poor scaling profile in this study. AR byte models approach BPE AR models at around 10^22 FLOPs in the isoFLOPs extrapolation, while byte-level MDMs are projected to need roughly 4×10^26 FLOPs to close the gap. This suggests that byte-level diffusion LMs need additional structure. Scaling alone is unlikely to be the right answer. Promising directions include learned segmentation, local chunking, hierarchical latents, or denoising objectives that preserve short-range sequential context.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper uses a controlled compute-matched scaling setup. All variants use a standard Transformer backbone to avoid confounding the comparison with architecture changes. The two representation choices are raw UTF-8 bytes with a vocabulary of 256 and the Llama 2 BPE tokenizer with a vocabulary of 32,000. The two objectives are AR language modeling and masked diffusion modeling. To match raw information per step, byte models use an 8192-byte context and BPE models use a 1792-token context, rather than forcing the same sequence length. The MDM follows a continuous-time discrete diffusion formulation: a forward process independently replaces tokens with [MASK] according to a retention schedule, and the model learns to reconstruct the original sequence from partially masked states through iterative unmasking. The main technical value is the decomposition of the byte penalty. Part of the cost comes from longer sequences, but a separate cost comes from having to learn subword structure that BPE provides upfront. The mechanistic analysis shows emergent segmentation in AR byte models: predictive entropy aligns with BPE boundaries, meaning the model can often resolve the remaining bytes of a wordpiece once early bytes are observed. Random masking in MDM removes this reliable causal scaffold. Controlled permutation experiments separate local-context damage from sequential-context damage and show that byte-level text generation is particularly sensitive to preserving local order.
summary_en.experiments: The models are pretrained on SlimPajama-627B. The main comparison covers four settings: BPE-AR, Byte-AR, BPE-MDM, and Byte-MDM, evaluated under matched total FLOPs. The key result is that the byte penalty is objective-dependent. Byte-AR starts below BPE-AR but improves quickly with scale; the isoFLOPs extrapolation places parity around 10^22 FLOPs. Byte-MDM has a much more persistent offset from BPE-MDM, and its relative improvement rate is lower than in the AR case; the projected parity point is around 4×10^26 FLOPs. This gap is too large to explain only by the quadratic attention cost of longer byte sequences. The entropy analysis supports the view that AR byte models learn an implicit segmentation aligned with BPE boundaries. The permutation studies show that disrupting local continuity and sequential integrity disproportionately hurts byte representations, which explains why stochastic masking is a poor match for raw byte text. The provided content does not include the full parameter grid or all benchmark numbers, so the exact scaling-law fits and ablation tables should be checked in the main figures and appendix.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the experimental setup before the results, especially the context normalization choice of 8192 bytes versus 1792 BPE tokens. Then focus on the compute-matched scaling plots and the isoFLOPs extrapolation; the important details are the fitted scaling curves, the fitting range, and the assumptions behind the extrapolated parity points. The most useful mechanistic sections are the entropy analysis around BPE boundaries and the controlled permutation experiments. Those sections explain why AR byte modeling can recover much of the lost segmentation prior, while MDM struggles when local byte continuity is fragmented. Good follow-up questions are whether mask schedules can be made locality-preserving, whether byte diffusion needs learned chunks or hierarchical latents, and what the analogous structural priors should be for multimodal token-free pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 会改我对“byte+MDM更通用”的先验：先复现 compute-matched 曲线，再谈去 tokenizer。
recommendation.en: This changes the prior that byte+MDM is a clean universal route; reproduce the compute-matched curves before dropping the tokenizer.

commentary.article_excerpt: 每日ComputerScience 清华大学 关注 谷歌：字节建模效率塌陷，扩散模型更吃亏 这篇论文研究一个看似“更通用”的方向：不用BPE等子词分词器，直接用原始UTF-8字节建模，并进一步结合Masked Diffusion Model实现非自回归、任意顺序生成。结论很直接：字节建模并不是免费的“去分词器升级”，尤其在扩散语言模型里，计算代价会被显著放大。 核心亮点 ： 字节建模的代价不是固定的：论文通过compute-matched scaling study发现，字节模型相对BPE模型的性能差距会随规模变化，而且强烈依赖建模目标。 AR还能靠规模追上：自回归字节模型在大规模训练下逐渐接近BPE模型，论文外推显示大约在1.3e22 FLOPs附近可能达到性能接近。 MDM字节模型明显掉队：Masked Diffusion Model在字节级输入下持续存在BPB性能偏移，论文估计可能需要约4.2e26 FLOPs才接近BPE版本，计算代价极高。 根因是上下文脆弱性：BPE token天然封装了子词语义，而单个byte几乎没有独立语义；MDM的随机mask又破坏局部连续性，使模型更难从碎片化上下文恢复语义。 AR会自发学出“隐式分词”：论文发现AR byte模型的预测熵高点与BPE边界高度对齐，ROC AUC达到0.829，说明模型会自己学会类似子词边界的结构。 简单span masking救不了问题：附录实验显示，用BPE边界做字节span mask反而更差，因为模型仍需逐字节恢复连续缺失片段，输出空间难度没有被真正压缩。 arXiv：2605.12928 #语言模型 #扩散模型 #科研 #分词器 #ScalingLaw #自回归模型 #谷歌 #模型效率 #transformer #Tokenization 2小时前
