paper.title: There Will Be a Scientific Theory of Deep Learning
paper.abstract: In this paper, we make the case that a scientific theory of deep learning is emerging. By this we mean a theory which characterizes important properties and statistics of the training process, hidden representations, final weights, and performance of neural networks. We pull together major strands of ongoing research in deep learning theory and identify five growing bodies of work that point toward such a theory: (a) solvable idealized settings that provide intuition for learning dynamics in rea

summary.core_problem: 论证并梳理“深度学习正在形成可检验的科学理论”，并给出该理论的五条主要研究脉络。
summary.importance: 观点/综述型贡献：把训练动态、可解模型、极限理论、宏观规律、超参理论与跨系统普适行为串成框架；对预训练研究员的价值在于建立可复用的分析语言与可测量的对象，而非给出新算法。
summary.technical_approach: 以立场论文方式归纳五类进展：(a) 可解的理想化设定解释真实系统学习动态；(b) 可处理的极限（如宽度/深度/数据维度极限）揭示现象；(c) 简单数学定律刻画宏观可观测量；(d) 将超参“理论化”以从复杂系统中剥离可控变量；(e) 寻找跨架构/任务的普适行为以界定哪些现象需要解释。
summary.experiments: 非实验论文；主要是文献组织与论证，不提供新的大规模训练结果或基准对比。
summary.authors_note: Harvard University; Flatiron Institute; New York University; Stanford University

summary_en.core_problem: Argues that a falsifiable scientific theory of deep learning is emerging, and organizes the field into five converging research threads.
summary_en.importance: A perspective/synthesis contribution: provides a shared vocabulary around training dynamics, solvable models, tractable limits, macroscopic laws, hyperparameter theories, and universality; useful for pretraining researchers as an analysis framework rather than a new method.
summary_en.technical_approach: Position paper synthesizing five strands: (a) solvable idealized settings for intuition about realistic dynamics; (b) tractable limits to expose core phenomena; (c) simple mathematical laws for macroscopic observables; (d) theories of hyperparameters to isolate controllable factors; (e) universal behaviors across systems to clarify what needs explanation.
summary_en.experiments: Not an experimental paper; no new large-scale training runs or benchmark deltas.
summary_en.authors_note: Harvard University; Flatiron Institute; New York University; Stanford University

recommendation.zh: 不是新结果而是“研究纲领”，读它的价值在于把你关心的训练现象放进可检验的对象集合；只需扫摘要和五条脉络小节。
recommendation.en: Not new results but a research agenda; useful for mapping pretraining phenomena onto measurable, falsifiable objects—skim the abstract and the five-thread taxonomy.

paper.title: Parcae: Scaling Laws For Stable Looped Language Models
paper.abstract: Traditional fixed-depth architectures scale quality by increasing training FLOPs, typically through increased parameterization, at the expense of a higher memory footprint, or data. A potential alternative is looped architectures, which instead increase FLOPs by sending activations through a block of layers in a loop. While promising, existing recipes for training looped architectures can be unstable, suffering from residual explosion and loss spikes. We address these challenges by recasting loo

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 looped language model 的两个核心障碍：一是训练不稳定，表现为 residual state 爆炸和 loss spikes；二是即便 looped 架构在参数效率上有吸引力，也缺少像参数规模、数据规模那样可预测的 scaling law，因此很难把“循环深度”当成一个可靠的计算扩展轴。作者的目标不是单纯把已有 recurrent-depth 模型训稳，而是把 looping 从一个脆弱技巧，变成可分析、可训练、可做训练与测试时计算扩展的体系。
summary.importance: 这项工作对预训练研究的意义比较直接，而且量级不小。它触及一个很现实的问题：如果未来部署成本越来越受参数量和 KV/cache 内存约束，那么“增加 FLOPs 但不增加参数”会成为重要方向。looped / recurrent-depth 模型正好提供了这条路，但过去一直卡在稳定性和 recipe 不可靠。Parcae 的贡献有三层。第一，它给出了一个解释 instability 的分析框架，把 looped Transformer 写成 residual stream 上的动力系统，并把问题收敛到 injection 参数的谱范数。第二，它提出了结构约束和训练算法修正，使 1.3B、100B token 量级的训练变得稳定。第三，它给出 looping 的训练 FLOP scaling law 和 test-time scaling law，说明循环深度可以像参数和数据一样成为独立扩展轴。这一点对 pretrain 设计空间很重要，因为它意味着 compute-optimal 配方不一定只能在参数和数据之间分配，还可以在“重复计算同一块”上分配。
summary.technical_approach:
技术路线分成三部分：稳定性建模、稳定架构设计、以及面向随机深度训练的算法修正。

先看建模。作者把 middle-looped 架构写成三段：prelude 单元把输入 token 映射成条件向量 e，recurrent unit 在循环步 t 上更新 hidden state h_t，coda 单元把最终状态映射到 logits。关键是把 recurrent update 视为一个关于 residual stream 的非线性时变系统，其中一部分参数控制“保留多少旧状态、注入多少新状态”。在对系统做线性化近似后，这个更新退化成经典 LTI 系统，稳定性可以用状态转移矩阵的谱性质来分析。作者发现，已有 looped 架构中的 injection 参数会学到过大的谱范数，从而导致 residual explosion。这不是经验上“有时会炸”，而是能被动力系统视角解释的结构性风险。

基于这个分析，Parcae 的核心设计是对 A 做连续到离散的稳定参数化，并把连续形式的 A 约束为 negative diagonal matrix。这样离散化后的状态更新天然带有收缩性质，谱范数被控制住，残差不会在循环中指数放大。这个设计很像把 recurrent depth 的自由度从“任意线性耦合”收缩到“逐维稳定衰减/保留”，牺牲了一部分表达灵活性，换来训练稳定性和可预测性。作者没有选择更宽松的全矩阵稳定化，而是用对角负矩阵，原因很实际：它足够稳定、参数少、实现简单，而且在大模型训练里更容易和现有 Transformer block 兼容。

除了结构约束，作者还处理了两个训练层面的尖点来源。第一，对输入条件 e 做归一化，缓解训练后期的 loss spikes。这里可以理解为 recurrent unit 在不同 loop depth 下反复接收同一个条件信号，如果其尺度漂移，容易在深循环时放大不稳定模式。第二，训练目标需要对随机深度的期望损失做优化。已有做法常在 batch 级别采样统一深度，导致梯度方差和深度切换带来的不连续更明显。Parcae 改成 intra-batch per-sequence depth sampling，让同一 batch 内不同样本走不同 loop 次数，从而平滑优化过程，也更接近“对深度分布求期望”的目标。

论文还有一个重要点是把训练时 scaling 和测试时 scaling 统一起来。训练时，他们在 isoFLOP 设定下研究给定总训练 FLOPs 时，应该把预算分给更多数据还是更多 looping；测试时，他们研究增加 loop 次数带来的 loss 改善曲线，并拟合出带 irreducible loss 的指数衰减形式。最终得到一个统一的 looping scaling 视角：训练阶段学到的 recurrent refinement 能在推理阶段继续通过更多循环释放出来，但收益遵循可预测的递减规律。
summary.experiments:
实验分成稳定性、端到端质量、训练 FLOP scaling、测试时 scaling 四块。

稳定性方面，作者先证明旧配方确实容易出现 residual explosion 和 loss spikes，并把问题和 injection 参数的谱范数联系起来。Table 2 是关键证据之一：不稳定模型会学到更危险的 A 参数化，而 Parcae 的约束能显著抑制这种现象。文中还强调，过去一些 looped 模型往往依赖敏感超参和 Post-Norm 才能勉强收敛，Parcae 则把稳定性更多前移到参数化本身。

端到端质量方面，Parcae 与参数量、数据量匹配的 RDMs 和标准 Transformer 比较。结果上，相比 RDM，验证集 perplexity 降低 6.3%。当规模扩展到 1.3B 参数、100B tokens 时，Parcae 在 Core 和 Core-Extended benchmark 上分别比参数匹配 Transformer 高最多 2.99 和 1.18 分，并能匹配约两倍参数量的 Transformer。这是全文最重要的结果之一，因为它说明 looping 不是只在 toy setting 下省参数，而是在较实在的预训练规模上也能换到质量。

训练 FLOP scaling 方面，作者做了 parameter-matched isoFLOP 实验：总训练 FLOPs 固定时，比较把预算用于更多数据，还是用于更多 loop depth。结论是 looping 构成了与参数、数据并列的独立 scaling 轴，最优配方会同时增加数据和 looping，并满足经验幂律。Figure 1 右图是这里的核心图。这个结果的含义不是“looping 总比数据好”，而是“在固定参数下，compute-optimal 解不只是一味加数据”。

测试时 scaling 方面，作者观察到增加循环次数会带来可预测的 loss 下降，形式接近指数衰减并存在不可约下界。也就是说，模型确实学会了可继续 refinement 的动态，但额外 loop 的边际收益会越来越小。论文进一步把训练期和测试期的 scaling law 合在一起，形成统一拟合。这一点对部署很关键，因为它支持按场景做 per-token 或 per-request 的计算分配。

从全文叙述看，消融实验还覆盖了 A 的参数化方式、e normalization、以及 per-sequence depth sampling 对 loss spikes 的影响。值得注意的是，作者不是只报告最终分数，而是把训练曲线稳定性本身当成一等结果来分析，这对做大规模预训练的人更有参考价值。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇建议精读。最值得看的不是 benchmark 表，而是作者如何把 looped Transformer 重新表述成动力系统，以及这个表述如何直接导出可训练的参数化。

阅读顺序建议如下。先看 Introduction，把问题框住：为什么 looped model 值得做，过去卡在哪里。然后直接看 Background 里 middle-looped architecture 的形式化定义，确保符号 e、h_t、P/R/C 三段结构都看明白。接着重点读稳定性分析部分，尤其是从非线性时变系统线性化到 LTI 的那一步，以及为什么谱范数会控制残差爆炸。这里是全文的理论支点。之后看 Parcae 的参数化设计：连续 A、离散化、negative diagonal constraint。再看训练算法修正，包括 e normalization 和 intra-batch per-sequence depth sampling。最后看三组实验：Table 2 的稳定性证据、Figure 1 的 scaling law、以及 1.3B/100B token 的主结果表。

几个值得深挖的点。第一，negative diagonal A 很稳，但表达能力是否受限，未来是否可以做更丰富但仍稳定的低秩或块对角参数化。第二，test-time scaling 的指数衰减说明 recurrent refinement 有“可榨取但有限”的剩余计算空间，这和 latent reasoning、adaptive compute、early exit 都有联系。第三，训练时随机深度分布如何选，可能会显著影响模型在不同推理预算下的 Pareto 曲线，这里还有不少可做空间。第四，这项工作和传统 AR Transformer 不是替代关系，更像在固定参数预算下增加一个 compute 维度；如果和 MoE、长上下文、speculative decoding 联合考虑，系统层面的最优点可能会变。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles two bottlenecks in looped language models. First, training is often unstable, with residual-state explosion and late-stage loss spikes. Second, even when looping is parameter-efficient, it has lacked the kind of predictable scaling behavior that makes parameter count and data size useful design axes. The goal is therefore broader than “make recurrence work”: it is to turn looping into a stable and analyzable compute-scaling mechanism for language model pretraining.
summary_en.importance: This is directly relevant to pretraining research. If deployment is increasingly constrained by parameter memory and inference footprint, then scaling quality through extra FLOPs without extra parameters becomes attractive. Looped or recurrent-depth models are a natural candidate, but prior recipes have been fragile. Parcae contributes at three levels. It provides a dynamical-systems explanation for instability, tying divergence to the spectral norm of injection parameters. It introduces a stable architecture and training recipe that works at meaningful scale, including 1.3B parameters and 100B tokens. And it derives training-time and test-time scaling laws for looping, arguing that recurrent depth can serve as an orthogonal scaling axis alongside parameters and data. That is a meaningful expansion of the pretraining design space.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The technical story has three parts: stability analysis, stable parameterization, and training-algorithm fixes for stochastic depth.

The model is written as a middle-looped architecture with a prelude module, a recurrent middle block, and a coda module. The recurrent update over the residual stream is cast as a nonlinear time-varying dynamical system. After linearization, the update reduces to a linear time-invariant system, which makes classical stability analysis available. The key empirical observation is that prior looped architectures can learn unstable injection operators with large spectral norms, leading to residual explosion.

Parcae addresses this by parameterizing the continuous-time state matrix A and discretizing it in a controlled way, while constraining A to be a negative diagonal matrix. This gives the recurrent update an inherently contractive character and prevents the hidden state from blowing up across loop iterations. The design is deliberately conservative: a diagonal stable parameterization gives up some flexibility relative to a full matrix, but it is simple, cheap, and robust enough for large-scale Transformer training.

The paper also identifies two practical sources of loss spikes. First, the conditioning signal e is repeatedly injected across loop steps, so scale drift in e can destabilize deep recurrence. Parcae adds normalization on e to mitigate this. Second, the training objective optimizes expected loss over variable depths. Prior recipes often sample one depth per batch, which creates higher variance and sharper optimization discontinuities. Parcae instead uses intra-batch per-sequence depth sampling, so different sequences in the same batch use different loop counts. This better matches the expectation-over-depth objective and empirically smooths training.

A further strength of the paper is that it connects training-time and inference-time scaling. Under isoFLOP training, it studies how compute should be split between more data and more looping. At test time, it studies how additional loop iterations reduce loss, finding an exponential-decay form with an irreducible floor. The result is a unified view in which recurrence learned during training can be exploited at inference, but with predictable diminishing returns.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments cover stability, end-to-end quality, training-FLOP scaling, and test-time scaling.

On stability, the paper shows that earlier looped recipes indeed suffer from residual explosion and loss spikes, and links this behavior to the learned spectral properties of the injection operator. Table 2 is central here: unstable models learn more dangerous parameterizations, while Parcae’s constrained form suppresses that failure mode. An important practical point is that prior looped models often relied on sensitive hyperparameters and normalization choices such as Post-Norm just to converge; Parcae moves much of the stability burden into the parameterization itself.

On end-to-end quality, Parcae is compared against parameter- and data-matched RDMs and standard Transformers. Relative to RDMs, it reduces validation perplexity by 6.3%. At 1.3B parameters trained on 100B tokens, it outperforms parameter-matched Transformers by up to 2.99 points on Core and 1.18 points on Core-Extended, while matching Transformers roughly twice as large. That is the headline result: looping is not only a toy parameter-saving trick, but can buy real quality at meaningful pretraining scale.

For training-FLOP scaling, the paper runs parameter-matched isoFLOP studies and asks whether extra compute should go into more data or more loop depth. The answer is that looping behaves like an additional scaling axis. FLOP-optimal training increases both data and looping according to empirical power laws. The implication is not that looping dominates data, but that under a fixed parameter budget, the compute-optimal solution is not exhausted by “just add more tokens.”

For test-time scaling, increasing the number of loop iterations yields predictable loss improvements that follow an exponential decay toward an irreducible floor. This suggests that the model learns a genuine iterative refinement process, but one with diminishing returns. The paper then combines training-time and test-time fits into a unified scaling-law view. That is especially relevant for adaptive inference and per-request compute allocation.

The ablations also examine the parameterization of A, normalization of e, and the effect of per-sequence depth sampling on loss spikes. Importantly, the paper treats training-curve stability itself as a first-class result, which makes it more useful for practitioners than papers that only report final benchmark scores.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This one is worth a close read. The most important part is not the benchmark table but the way the paper reformulates looped Transformers as dynamical systems and then turns that analysis into a trainable architecture.

A good reading order is: Introduction, then the formal definition of the middle-looped architecture in the background section, then the stability analysis. Pay special attention to the step from the nonlinear time-varying system to the linearized LTI view, and to why the spectral norm governs residual explosion. That is the conceptual core of the paper. After that, read the Parcae parameterization carefully: continuous A, discretization, and the negative-diagonal constraint. Then read the training fixes, especially e normalization and intra-batch per-sequence depth sampling. Finally, study three experimental anchors: the stability evidence in Table 2, the scaling-law plots in Figure 1, and the main 1.3B / 100B-token quality results.

Several follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind. The negative-diagonal parameterization is stable, but perhaps restrictive; future work could explore low-rank or block-diagonal stable forms. The exponential test-time scaling curve suggests a finite but usable reserve of iterative computation, which connects naturally to latent reasoning, adaptive compute, and early exit. Also, the choice of training-time depth distribution likely shapes the quality/compute Pareto frontier at inference. There is still room to optimize that interface.

recommendation.zh: 如果你认真看 looped/shared-depth，这篇该立刻进复现实验：它不是又一个“能训起来”的经验 patch，而是把不稳定性钉到谱范数上，先看稳定性分析和 ablation。
recommendation.en: If you are serious about looped or shared-depth models, this should go straight into your internal repro queue: it is not another empirical patch, but a stability story pinned to spectral norms—read the analysis and ablations first.

paper.title: How Can We Synthesize High-Quality Pretraining Data? A Systematic Study of Prompt Design, Generator Model, and Source Data

summary.core_problem: 在可用真实Web语料接近“爬尽/滤尽”的背景下，合成预训练数据（把Web文本重写成更“可学”的形式）成为主流，但生成策略（prompt设计）、生成器模型规模、源数据与mix-in数据的选择缺乏系统对照。本文核心问题是：在严格可控的实验框架下，哪些合成数据设计维度真正决定下游效果与性价比？如何用最小生成成本得到最高的预训练收益？
summary.importance:
这是直接面向“预训练数据科学”的高价值工作：
- 给出可复现的三轴系统消融（重写prompt/生成器/数据配比），把合成数据从经验主义拉到工程可优化的设计空间。
- 结论对数据scaling与成本结构影响很大：生成器>1B不再带来收益、结构化教学式格式显著优于既有合成范式与curated web基线、mix-in选择比source质量更关键——这些会直接改变合成数据预算分配与数据配比策略。
- 产出FinePhrase 486B tokens与生成框架，并宣称在最高30×生成成本降低下超过现有合成基线，属于“可落地、可规模化”的数据管线贡献。
summary.technical_approach:
1) 统一实验框架：把合成预训练配置形式化为(重写prompt P, 指令微调生成器G, 源数据D_source, mix-in数据D_mix)。对每个配置，生成合成样本并与mix-in混合，从零训练一个LM M，固定训练token预算为21B tokens，用一组覆盖知识/阅读理解/推理的基准做聚合评估，从而实现可控对比。
2) 重写策略系统对照：对比既有方法的多种prompt（如Nemotron-HQ-Synth的Diverse QA、Extract Knowledge、Distill、Wikipedia paraphrase、Knowledge List等，以及其他工作如WRAP/BeyondWeb/REWIRE类别）与作者提出的四类“结构化教学格式”：tutorials、FAQs、tables、math reformulations。核心假设是：结构化输出提供更强的学习信号（显式字段、问答对齐、步骤化推理/讲解），提升token的“有效信息密度”和可预测性。
3) 生成器规模与家族：测试6个模型家族、135M–27B参数，评估“更大生成器是否更好”。关键发现是超过约1B参数收益饱和，意味着合成数据的瓶颈更多在prompt/格式与数据混合，而非生成器能力。
4) 源数据与mix-in解耦：分别改变D_source质量与D_mix选择，分析谁是主导因素。结论指向mix-in更关键：即便合成来自较好/较差source，最终与何种真实web/高质语料混合决定了训练稳定性与泛化。
5) 多样性 vs 一致性：作者强调“输出多样性比格式一致性更重要”，暗示合成数据应覆盖多种结构化模板/表达方式，避免单一模板导致分布过窄、过拟合格式。
6) 数据集产出：基于最优配置生成FinePhrase 486B tokens，并用SmolLM2 1.7B作为生成器实现显著降本。
summary.experiments:
本文实验规模与关键结论（来自全文引言与框架描述）：
- 生成规模：累计生成超过1T tokens用于系统对照；最终发布FinePhrase为486B tokens。
- 训练评估：每个配置训练一个从零LM，训练token固定21B，用跨知识/阅读理解/推理的聚合指标评估（具体基准与分数需在§3/§4主表核对）。
- 主要发现：
  (i) 重写prompt/格式是影响下游性能的主导因素；结构化格式（tables/math/FAQ/tutorial）稳定优于curated web基线与既有合成方法。
  (ii) 生成器模型规模超过1B参数“无额外收益”。
  (iii) mix-in数据选择比source数据质量更关键。
  (iv) 输出多样性比格式一致性更重要。
- 成本/效果：用SmolLM2 1.7B生成FinePhrase，在相对既有方法最高可达30×生成成本降低下仍优于所有现有合成基线（具体“优于”的幅度、在哪些benchmark上领先、是否在同等训练token下比较，需要到§6与主结果表读取精确数字）。
注意：你提供的全文在§2后被截断，缺少§4–§6的主结果表、各prompt的具体胜率/提升幅度、不同generator家族的曲线、mix-in对照的定量结论等；要做“数字级复现”需要补齐这些章节。
summary.reading_guide:
精读建议（建议2–3小时，必须看表和消融）：
1) §2 方法框架：明确P/G/D_source/D_mix的定义、采样与混合比例、去重与过滤策略（这些决定结论可迁移性）。
2) §3 评测协议：训练token固定21B这一点非常关键；确认模型规模、训练超参、tokenizer是否固定、以及聚合指标如何计算。
3) §4 主结果：逐行看不同重写prompt的对比表，尤其是四类结构化格式相对Nemotron/WRAP/BeyondWeb/REWIRE类prompt的提升幅度；同时看“多样性>一致性”的实证证据（是否通过混合多prompt、温度、采样策略实现）。
4) §5 生成器规模实验：重点看135M→1B→10B→27B的收益曲线与方差，确认“>1B无收益”是否在所有格式/所有mix-in下成立，还是与prompt交互显著。
5) §5/§6 数据组成实验：精读source质量与mix-in选择的交互消融（最好有二维表/热力图）；这部分直接指导你自己的数据配比与预算。
6) §6 FinePhrase：关注生成成本核算口径（tokens/s、推理batch、温度、拒答率、过滤后保留率），以及与现有合成数据在“同训练token、同模型规模”下的公平比较。
值得深挖的研究点：结构化格式为何提升（信息密度、长程依赖、显式对齐、噪声分布变化）、以及如何把“格式选择”纳入数据scaling law（有效token vs 原始token）。

summary_en.core_problem: As high-quality web text becomes saturated, synthetic pretraining data (LLM-rewritten web documents) is increasingly used, but the design space—rewrite prompt strategy, generator model choice/scale, and source vs mix-in data—lacks controlled, apples-to-apples comparisons. The paper’s core question is: which knobs actually drive downstream gains and cost-efficiency when synthesizing pretraining data at scale?
summary_en.importance:
A high-impact data-science-for-pretraining study:
- Introduces a controlled experimental framework that isolates prompt design, generator scale, and data composition, turning synthetic-data generation from ad hoc practice into an optimizable pipeline.
- Produces actionable conclusions with major budget implications: structured pedagogical formats consistently win; generator models beyond ~1B parameters do not help; mix-in selection matters more than source quality; diversity beats strict formatting consistency.
- Releases FinePhrase (486B tokens) and claims state-of-the-art synthetic-data performance with up to ~30× lower generation cost—directly relevant to teams building trillion-token corpora under constrained inference budgets.
summary_en.technical_approach:
1) Factorized pipeline: a synthetic configuration is defined by a rewrite prompt P, an instruction-tuned generator G, a source dataset D_source to be rewritten, and a real-data mix-in D_mix. For each configuration, they generate synthetic samples, mix with D_mix, and pretrain a model from scratch for a fixed 21B-token budget, then evaluate on a benchmark suite spanning knowledge, reading comprehension, and reasoning.
2) Prompt/rewrite strategy sweep: compare multiple established prompts (e.g., Nemotron-HQ-Synth variants like Diverse QA, Extract Knowledge, Distill, Wikipedia-style paraphrase, Knowledge List; plus other prior synthetic paradigms) against four newly proposed structured pedagogical formats: tutorials, FAQs, tables, and math reformulations. The hypothesis is that explicit structure (fields, Q/A alignment, stepwise exposition) increases learnable signal per token.
3) Generator model sweep: test six model families from 135M to 27B parameters to quantify whether larger generators yield better synthetic pretraining data. Key finding: scaling the generator beyond ~1B provides no additional benefit.
4) Source vs mix-in disentanglement: vary D_source quality and D_mix choice separately to identify the dominant driver; they conclude mix-in selection is more critical.
5) Diversity vs consistency: empirically argue that output diversity (across formats/prompts) matters more than enforcing a single consistent template.
6) Dataset release: apply the best configuration to build FinePhrase (486B tokens), using SmolLM2 1.7B as a cost-effective generator.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text sections:
- Scale: >1T synthetic tokens generated across controlled experiments; FinePhrase release is 486B tokens.
- Protocol: each configuration trains a fresh LM for a fixed 21B-token budget; success is measured by aggregated performance across benchmarks (exact benchmark list and aggregation are in §3/§4, not included in the excerpt).
- Main empirical claims:
  (i) Rewrite prompt/format is the dominant factor; structured outputs (tables, math problems, FAQs, tutorials) consistently outperform curated-web baselines and prior synthetic methods.
  (ii) Increasing generator size beyond ~1B parameters yields no gains.
  (iii) Mix-in dataset choice matters more than the rewritten source dataset.
  (iv) Output diversity is more important than strict formatting consistency.
- Cost/performance: FinePhrase generated with SmolLM2 1.7B reportedly beats existing synthetic baselines with up to ~30× lower generation cost.
Caveat: the excerpt ends before the main result tables (§4–§6). For numeric deltas (per-benchmark improvements, generator scaling curves, mix-in ablations), you must consult those sections.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Must-read path (2–3 hours, table-driven):
- §2: confirm the exact pipeline details (sampling, filtering, dedup, mixing ratios), since these govern transferability.
- §3: scrutinize the training/eval protocol—model size, tokenizer, hyperparameters, and how the aggregate score is computed.
- §4: main prompt-strategy comparison tables; quantify how much each structured format wins and whether gains are consistent across tasks.
- §5: generator scaling results; check interaction effects (does “>1B no gain” hold for every prompt and mix-in?).
- §5/§6: source vs mix-in ablations; this is the most actionable for data composition decisions.
- §6: FinePhrase construction and cost accounting (throughput, rejection/cleanup rates, effective kept tokens) and fairness of comparisons.
Deep-dive angle: model the results in terms of “effective tokens” and connect structured-format gains to data scaling laws (quality-adjusted token budgets).

recommendation.zh: 三轴消融把“合成数据”从玄学拉回可优化工程；结论直接改我对预算分配的prior（>1B生成器无益、mix-in更关键），值得立刻按其配方做内部复现。
recommendation.en: Clean 3-axis ablations turn synthetic data from folklore into knobs; it updates my budget prior (no gains past ~1B generator, mix-in dominates), and is worth reproducing in-house as a pipeline baseline.

paper.title: Better and Worse with Scale: How Contextual Entrainment Diverges with Model Size

summary.core_problem: 随着模型规模增大，LLM对上下文的“被带偏”行为（contextual entrainment：仅因token出现在上下文就提高其概率）如何变化？尤其是：为什么大模型一方面更能抵抗语义层面的错误信息（counterfactual misinformation），另一方面却更容易被无关/随机上下文token干扰（irrelevant/random copying）？论文要给出可量化的、可拟合的scaling law解释这一“越大越好又越大越糟”的悖论。
summary.importance: 这是少见的“机制型行为”的scaling law工作：不再只看loss/accuracy，而是对特定上下文机制（语义过滤 vs 机械复制）给出可预测的幂律标度，并发现不同上下文类型的指数符号相反。对预训练研究的启发在于：1）规模扩展并不会单调改善所有上下文鲁棒性，存在两条相反的随规模增强/减弱的子机制；2）长上下文、RAG、对抗检索噪声等问题，可能需要在训练目标/数据上显式抑制“非语义复制”而不是指望scale自然解决；3）提供了可作为训练动态诊断的度量（Δd、Δg、Δg-Δd）与拟合框架，便于比较不同数据配比、tokenizer、位置编码、长上下文训练对entrainment指数的影响。
summary.technical_approach:
沿用Niu et al. (2025)对contextual entrainment的定义，用“上下文前缀引起的logit位移”刻画：对gold token g与distractor token d分别计算Δg、Δd（相对无上下文的logit变化）。Δd>0即表示entrainment（仅因出现过就被boost）。同时报告相对优势Δg-Δd，作为语义过滤能力指标。
数据与条件：使用LRE（Linear Relational Embedding）事实查询数据集，覆盖47种关系，每个query配四类上下文：Related（语义相关真陈述）、Counterfactual（语义相关但错误陈述）、Irrelevant（真但无关）、Random（随机token/无语义）。
模型族与拟合：在Cerebras-GPT 111M–13B上做主实验，并在Pythia 410M–12B上验证。对各指标按模型参数量N做log-log线性回归，拟合幂律E(N)=a·N^b；以R^2>0.8且p<0.01作为强证据。
关键控制：先验证无上下文时gold logit随规模一致幂律增长（b约0.129–0.134，R^2>0.93），排除“题更容易/模型更强”导致的伪差异；同时无上下文的distractor logit不随规模系统变化（R^2<0.25），说明distractor的规模效应主要由上下文priming引入。
summary.experiments:
核心结果是“同一现象两条相反scaling曲线”：
- 在Cerebras-GPT上，distractor entrainment对四类上下文均可被幂律很好拟合（R^2>0.87，p<0.01）。
- 语义型上下文（Related/Counterfactual）呈负指数：规模越大，Δd越小（更能抑制被语义相关但可能错误的上下文带偏）。文中给出Counterfactual的指数b=-0.33，Related的指数b=-0.13。
- 非语义上下文（Random/Irrelevant）呈正指数：规模越大，Δd越大（机械复制/“见过就抬高概率”的倾向随规模增强）。
- 论文在摘要中给出直观量化：最大模型相对最小模型，对反事实错误信息的抵抗力约提升4倍，但对无关token的易感性约增加2倍（具体对应哪个指标需结合正文图表）。
- 在Pythia族上进行验证，结论方向一致（全文片段未给出具体指数与R^2数值）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约40–60分钟）：
1）读Introduction把“entrainment”四种上下文条件与两层机制（语义过滤 vs 机械复制/induction head）对应关系建立起来。
2）读Method里指标定义（Δd、Δg、Δg-Δd）与幂律拟合标准；特别关注他们如何做无上下文对照来排除混杂。
3）看Results的Table 1与Figure 2（文中引用）：这是全文最关键的信息密度点，直接展示四类上下文的指数符号分化。
4）带着预训练视角思考：哪些训练因素会改变“非语义entrainment”的正指数（如数据去重、长上下文训练、位置编码、attention正则、RAG噪声注入训练、对比学习式context filtering目标）。如果你在做scaling实验，可复用其拟合流程把“机制指标”纳入scaling dashboard。

summary_en.core_problem: How does contextual entrainment—boosting tokens merely because they appeared in the provided context—scale with model size, and why do larger LMs become more resistant to semantic misinformation yet more vulnerable to irrelevant/random context tokens?
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism-level scaling-law study: instead of aggregate loss, it fits power laws to a specific contextual behavior and shows two opposing scaling trends depending on context type. For pretraining research, it implies that scaling alone will not monotonically improve context robustness (critical for long-context and RAG). It also provides concrete, reproducible metrics (Δd, Δg, Δg−Δd) and a fitting protocol that can be reused to compare data mixes, tokenizer choices, long-context training, or architectural changes in terms of how they shift the entrainment exponents.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Using the LRE factual-query dataset with four context conditions (Related, Counterfactual, Irrelevant, Random), the paper measures entrainment as context-induced logit shifts relative to a no-context baseline: Δd for a distractor token and Δg for the gold token. Δd>0 indicates entrainment; Δg−Δd summarizes semantic filtering.
They evaluate Cerebras-GPT models from 111M to 13B parameters and validate on Pythia 410M–12B. For each condition/metric, they fit a power law E(N)=a·N^b via log-log linear regression, requiring strong fits (R^2>0.8, p<0.01).
Crucial controls: gold-token logits without context scale consistently with size (b≈0.129–0.134, R^2>0.93), while distractor logits without context do not (R^2<0.25), supporting that observed scaling differences are driven by contextual priming rather than baseline capability or dataset artifacts.
summary_en.experiments:
All four context conditions show strong power-law fits for distractor entrainment on Cerebras-GPT (R^2>0.87, p<0.01). The key finding is a sign flip in the scaling exponent:
- Semantic contexts: entrainment decreases with scale (negative b). Reported examples: Counterfactual b=-0.33, Related b=-0.13, indicating larger models better suppress semantically relevant but potentially misleading context.
- Non-semantic contexts: entrainment increases with scale (positive b), indicating stronger mechanistic copying/priming as models grow.
The abstract-level effect size: the largest models are ~4× more resistant to counterfactual misinformation than the smallest, yet ~2× more prone to irrelevant-token distraction. Validation on Pythia shows consistent qualitative trends (the excerpt does not include the exact fitted coefficients).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (40–60 minutes):
- Introduction: map the four context types to the hypothesized dual dynamics (semantic filtering vs mechanistic copying/induction-head-like behavior).
- Method: focus on the exact definitions of Δd/Δg and the regression protocol; the no-context controls are important for causal interpretation.
- Results: prioritize Table 1 and Figure 2 (as referenced) to see the exponent sign divergence across context types.
- For a pretraining lens, think about interventions that could reduce the positive exponent under non-semantic contexts (data curation, long-context objectives, contrastive context filtering, noise-in-context training, architectural attention constraints) and how to incorporate these metrics into a scaling dashboard.

recommendation.zh: 读它的 entrainment 指数拟合和“语义抗误导变强、随机复制变强”的反号 scaling；这会逼你在长上下文/RAG 训练里显式压制非语义复制，而不是迷信 scale。
recommendation.en: Read the entrainment exponent fits and the sign-flip scaling (better semantic filtering, worse random copying); it argues you must explicitly suppress non-semantic copying in long-context/RAG training rather than rely on scale.

paper.title: Parcae: Scaling Laws For Stable Looped Language Models

summary.core_problem: 解决 looped / recurrent-depth Transformer（通过在中间层循环同一组 block 来增加 FLOPs 而不增加参数）训练不稳定的问题（residual explosion、loss spikes），并进一步建立“循环次数（looping）作为独立 scaling 轴”的训练 FLOP scaling law 与测试时 compute scaling 规律，使其成为可预测、可控的算力扩展手段。
summary.importance:
这是少见把“架构稳定性（动力系统/谱半径）→ 可训练性 → scaling law”串成闭环的工作，对预训练研究的影响主要在三点：
1) 提供一种在不增参条件下扩展训练 FLOPs 的正交维度（looping），对参数受限/部署受限场景（edge、推理成本占比上升）很关键。
2) 给出 looped 模型不稳定的可解释根因（注入/残差更新矩阵的谱范数过大），并用结构化参数化把稳定性“写进参数空间”，减少靠 Post-Norm/玄学超参救火。
3) 把 looping 纳入 scaling law：不仅展示端到端质量可对标更大 Transformer，还给出 FLOP-optimal 下 data 与 looping 的幂律关系，以及测试时循环带来的可预测收益（指数衰减到不可约损失），这对制定训练配方与预算分配有直接指导意义。
summary.technical_approach:
核心思路：把 middle-looped 架构重写为残差流上的非线性时变动力系统，然后在线性化近似下用控制理论判定发散条件，最后据此设计稳定参数化与训练算法。

1) 动力系统表述：将循环深度的残差更新写成 h_{t+1}=\overline{A} h_t + \overline{B} e + \overline{R}(h_t,e)（文中符号为 \overline{\bm{A}}, \overline{\bm{B}}, \overline{\mathcal{R}}），其中 \overline{A} 控制“保留旧残差 vs 注入新残差”的比例，\overline{B} 将输入表征 e 注入残差流，\overline{R} 吸收注意力/MLP 等非线性模块。

2) 线性化诊断：去掉非线性项得到 LTI 系统，用经典稳定性条件（与 \overline{A} 的谱范数/谱半径相关）解释 residual explosion：既有 looped 架构会学到谱范数过大的注入/更新参数，导致残差随循环步数发散；作者用实证（如 Table 2）展示该现象与训练崩溃/损失尖峰相关。

3) Parcae 架构稳定化：
- 关键结构约束：显式使用连续形式的 A 并做离散化（discretization），再将 A 参数化为“负的对角矩阵”（negative diagonal），从参数空间层面约束谱范数，保证循环更新收缩，从而避免 residual explosion。
- 训练后期 loss spikes 修复：对输入 e 引入额外 normalization（文中称对 e 的归一化），经验上抑制后期尖峰。
- 训练算法修复：原训练目标是对“随机深度/循环次数”的期望损失做最小化；作者提出 intra-batch per-sequence depth sampling（同一 batch 内不同样本采不同循环深度）以降低梯度方差/减少 loss spikes，并改善可扩展训练稳定性。

4) Scaling law 建模：在参数匹配、isoFLOP 设定下，比较“增加数据”与“增加循环次数”两种提升训练 FLOPs 的方式，拟合 FLOP-optimal 下 data 与 looping 的幂律；并在测试时研究循环次数增加带来的 loss 改善呈指数衰减并趋于不可约项，最后把训练与测试两类规律合并成统一 scaling 公式。
summary.experiments:
论文在引言给出关键数字与设置：
- 端到端质量：对比参数/数据匹配的 RDMs（Recurrent Depth Models，looped 基线）与标准 Transformer。相对 RDM，Parcae 将验证集 PPL 降低 6.3%。
- 大规模结果：当扩展到 1.3B 参数、100B tokens 训练时，Parcae 在 Core 与 Core-Extended 基准上分别比参数匹配 Transformer 高最多 2.99 与 1.18 分，并能“匹配最多两倍参数量的 Transformer”。
- 稳定性：文中声称通过谱约束避免 residual explosion，并通过 e-normalization 与 intra-batch 深度采样减少训练后期 loss spikes（具体量化需在正文表格/曲线中核对）。
- Scaling：给出 looping 作为正交轴的训练 FLOP scaling（Figure 1 右）以及测试时 compute scaling 的指数衰减规律（需结合正文拟合曲线与不可约损失项的估计方式理解）。
summary.reading_guide:
精读建议（建议 2–3 小时，带着复现/迁移的目的）：
1) Section 1 + 动力系统公式（Eq.1）：弄清 \overline{A}/\overline{B}/\overline{R} 分别对应到 Transformer 残差路径的哪些参数（尤其是“injection parameters”具体指什么）。
2) 线性化与稳定性推导：重点看从非线性时变系统到 LTI 的近似假设、稳定性条件如何落到谱范数约束，以及该条件与实际训练崩溃现象（Table 2）如何对应。
3) Parcae 的 A 离散化与 negative diagonal 参数化：这是核心创新之一。建议对照实现细节理解：为何选对角、为何必须为负、离散化形式（如 Euler/指数映射类）对稳定域的影响。
4) 两个“工程但关键”的稳定化：e 的 normalization、intra-batch per-sequence depth sampling。建议看消融：分别去掉会发生什么、是否与 batch size/学习率/优化器强相关。
5) Scaling law 部分：
- 训练侧：isoFLOP 下 data vs looping 的幂律拟合方法、误差条与外推稳定性；
- 测试侧：指数衰减到不可约损失的拟合与解释；
- 统一公式：如何把训练与测试规律组合用于预算分配（训练 loops、训练 tokens、推理 loops）。

summary_en.core_problem: Stabilize training of looped (recurrent-depth) language models—where compute is scaled by iterating a shared block rather than adding parameters—by eliminating residual-stream explosion and loss spikes, and then establish predictable scaling laws where looping becomes an orthogonal axis for both training-FLOP scaling and test-time compute scaling.
summary_en.importance: Parcae is valuable to foundation-model pretraining because it connects three usually separate threads into one actionable recipe: (i) a mechanistic instability diagnosis (dynamical systems + spectral conditions), (ii) an architecture that bakes stability into parameterization (rather than relying on fragile norms/hyperparameters), and (iii) empirical scaling laws showing looping can substitute for parameters/data under isoFLOP constraints and can be used for test-time compute scaling with predictable returns. This directly informs how to allocate budgets when parameters are capped (deployment memory) but FLOPs are available (training or inference).
summary_en.technical_approach:
1) Dynamical-systems reframing: middle-looped transformers are written as a nonlinear time-varying dynamical system over the residual stream, with matrices controlling state carryover (\overline{A}), input injection (\overline{B}), and a nonlinear operator (\overline{R}) subsuming attention/MLP modules.

2) Linearized stability analysis: by linearizing (dropping \overline{R}), the update becomes an LTI system, enabling classic control-theory reasoning: divergence/residual explosion occurs when the effective state-update has too large a spectral norm. The authors argue prior looped recipes can learn such unstable \overline{A}-like injection parameterizations, empirically correlating with training blow-ups and loss spikes.

3) Parcae architecture: they introduce an explicit continuous-time representation A, discretize it, and parameterize A as a negative diagonal matrix. This constrains the spectrum to be contractive, preventing residual explosion by construction.

4) Training stabilizers for loss spikes: (i) an additional normalization on the input representation e to mitigate late-stage spikes, and (ii) a modified stochastic-depth objective implementation via intra-batch per-sequence depth sampling, reducing spike frequency/variance when optimizing expected loss over variable loop counts.

5) Scaling-law modeling: under parameter-matched isoFLOP comparisons, they fit FLOP-optimal power laws showing data and looping should co-increase; at test time, increasing recurrence yields predictable exponential decay toward an irreducible loss, and they combine train-time and test-time laws into a unified scaling relation for looped models.
summary_en.experiments:
Key reported numbers from the paper’s main text:
- End-to-end quality: vs parameter/data-matched RDM baselines, Parcae reduces validation perplexity by 6.3%.
- Large-scale run: at 1.3B parameters trained on 100B tokens, Parcae beats parameter-matched standard Transformers by up to +2.99 (Core) and +1.18 (Core-Extended), and matches Transformers up to ~2× larger.
- Stability: they report eliminating residual explosion (linked to spectral issues) and reducing late-stage loss spikes via e-normalization and intra-batch depth sampling (confirm exact spike metrics/plots in the experiments section).
- Scaling: they provide empirical power laws for FLOP-optimal training where looping is an orthogonal axis, and test-time scaling curves consistent with exponential decay to an irreducible loss (see Figure 1 right and the test-time scaling section).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Deep-read checklist (2–3 hours):
- The dynamical-system formulation and the mapping from transformer components to \overline{A}/\overline{B}/\overline{R} (this determines how general the stability claim is).
- The linearization assumptions and the exact spectral condition used to argue instability; cross-check with the empirical residual-explosion evidence (e.g., Table 2).
- The discretization choice and the negative-diagonal parameterization of A: why diagonal, why negative, and what stability region it guarantees.
- The two spike mitigations (e-normalization, intra-batch per-sequence depth sampling) and their ablations—these are likely to matter in real pretraining pipelines.
- Scaling-law methodology: isoFLOP setup, fitting procedure, confidence intervals, and how the unified train+test scaling law can be used to choose (tokens, loops) during training and (loops) at inference.

recommendation.zh: 把looped深度循环的失稳根因用谱半径讲清并给出“写进参数化”的稳定方案，还顺手给了可用的looping scaling law；值得按其稳定化手段做一次干净ablation再决定是否上生产配方。
recommendation.en: They pin looped-depth instability to spectral-radius issues and bake stability into the parameterization, then provide usable looping scaling laws; worth running a clean ablation with their stabilization trick before betting on looping as a production recipe.

paper.title: On The Application of Linear Attention in Multimodal Transformers

summary.core_problem: 多模态 Transformer（尤其视觉 token + 文本 token）序列更长，标准 softmax attention 的 O(N^2) 计算/显存开销成为扩展瓶颈。线性注意力（Linear Attention, LA）虽在单模态中被研究较多，但在多模态预训练（如 CLIP/OpenCLIP 范式）里能否在保持性能的同时获得可观效率收益仍缺少系统验证。
summary.importance: 多模态模型的 token 数往往由高分辨率视觉 patch 主导，N 很容易上千，二次复杂度直接限制训练吞吐与可用分辨率/上下文。若 LA 在多模态预训练中能稳定工作并遵循类似 scaling law，将为更长序列、更大 batch 或更高分辨率提供直接的算力杠杆。
summary.technical_approach: 论文用可分解核将注意力从 softmax(QK^T)V 改写为线性形式：用特征映射 φ 使得相似度 f(q,k)=φ(q)^Tφ(k)，从而把计算重排为 O(ND^2)。具体实现采用仿射核 f(x)=1+x，并指出其潜在问题：若 q·k<-1 会产生负权重，因此先对 Q、K 做归一化以保证内积落在 [-1,1]，使核输出非负。进一步分析发现，带标准分母归一化（类似把权重“归一到和为 1”）会随序列长度增长导致注意力矩阵过度平滑（论文用 Figure 1 展示），削弱显著性与梯度信号；因此提出在已对 Q、K 预归一化的前提下，去掉分母项，改用不做该归一化的形式以缓解随长度增长的“分布变平”问题，从而提升可训练性与表达能力。整体贡献是：在 OpenCLIP 训练框架下，把 LA 作为标准 attention 的替代模块，并系统评估其性能与效率，以及与模型规模的 scaling 行为。
summary.experiments: 在 LAION-400M 上用 OpenCLIP 预训练 ViT-S/16、ViT-B/16、ViT-L/16，并以 ImageNet-21K zero-shot accuracy 做验证对比。论文报告 LA 相对标准 attention 显著降低计算开销，同时保持有竞争力的零样本精度；并观察到 LA 与标准 attention 呈现相近的“精度-模型规模”scaling 趋势（即扩大模型时的收益曲线形态类似）。
summary.reading_guide: must_read（精读）：(1) Background 中标准 attention 与 LA 的推导（从 softmax 到 φ 分解与重排），明确复杂度从 O(N^2D) 到 O(ND^2) 的前提与代价。 (2) Model 章节：仿射核 f(x)=1+x 的数值问题、Q/K 归一化约束、以及“去掉分母”这一关键改动；重点看 Figure 1（过度平滑现象的可视化）并理解其对梯度/表达性的影响。 (3) 实验部分：不同 ViT 尺寸下的 zero-shot 精度对比与效率指标，验证“性能接近 + 省算力 + scaling law 类似”。skim（泛读）：读 Introduction+贡献点；快速看 LA 公式重排与仿射核的处理（归一化 + 去分母的动机）；然后直接看实验主结果（ImageNet-21K zero-shot 与训练/推理效率对比）即可把握结论。
summary.authors_note: 作者的关键洞察是：在多模态长序列下，LA 的线性复杂度优势更“刚需”，但简单替换核会带来数值与训练动态问题；通过 Q/K 预归一化保证非负，再通过去掉分母缓解长度增长导致的过平滑，从而让 LA 在 CLIP 式预训练中更可用，并给出系统化的规模与效率验证。

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal Transformers face severe scalability limits because standard softmax attention is quadratic in sequence length, and multimodal inputs often include hundreds to thousands of visual tokens plus text. While Linear Attention (LA) is well-studied in unimodal settings, its viability for multimodal pretraining (e.g., CLIP-style) lacks systematic validation.
summary_en.importance: In multimodal models, token counts are frequently dominated by high-resolution visual patches, making O(N^2) attention a major training/inference bottleneck. If LA can preserve competitive performance while reducing complexity to linear in N, it enables longer contexts, higher resolutions, or larger batches under the same compute budget, and provides a clearer path for scaling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper replaces softmax attention with a kernelized linear form using a decomposable feature map φ such that f(q,k)=φ(q)^Tφ(k), allowing associative reordering to achieve O(ND^2) computation. Concretely, it uses an affine kernel f(x)=1+x. Because affine kernels can yield negative scores when q·k<-1, the method pre-normalizes Q and K so dot products lie in [-1,1], ensuring non-negative kernel outputs. The authors further argue that the standard normalization denominator (making weights sum to one) causes attention to become increasingly uniform as sequence length grows, leading to over-smoothing and weaker gradient signals; they therefore propose omitting this denominator given the bounded, pre-normalized scores. Figure 1 visualizes the over-smoothing effect and the improvement from the modified formulation. The work integrates this LA variant into OpenCLIP-style multimodal training and evaluates accuracy/efficiency and scaling behavior.
summary_en.experiments: ViT-S/16, ViT-B/16, and ViT-L/16 are pretrained on LAION-400M within the OpenCLIP framework, with validation via ImageNet-21K zero-shot accuracy. Results indicate substantial compute savings versus standard attention while maintaining competitive zero-shot performance, and LA exhibits similar accuracy–model size scaling trends to standard attention.
summary_en.reading_guide: must_read (deep dive): (1) Background derivations: softmax attention vs LA factorization and the exact condition for reducing O(N^2D) to O(ND^2). (2) Model section: affine kernel pitfalls, Q/K normalization, and the key change of removing the denominator; focus on Figure 1 to understand over-smoothing and its training implications. (3) Experiments: compare zero-shot accuracy and efficiency across ViT sizes to validate “competitive performance + efficiency + similar scaling laws.” skim (high-level): read Intro/contributions, glance at the LA reordering and the affine-kernel fixes (normalization + no denominator), then jump to the main experimental results (ImageNet-21K zero-shot and efficiency comparisons).
summary_en.authors_note: The central message is that LA’s linear-in-N advantage is especially compelling for multimodal long sequences, but naive LA substitutions can introduce numerical and optimization issues. By bounding dot products via Q/K normalization and mitigating length-induced over-smoothing by dropping the denominator, the paper makes LA more practical for CLIP-style multimodal pretraining and supports the claim with scaling and efficiency evidence.

recommendation.zh: 看训练吞吐-精度曲线与分辨率/序列长度的 scaling 部分即可；若结果站得住，LA 可能是多模态预训最便宜的算力杠杆。
recommendation.en: Read the throughput–accuracy curves and the resolution/sequence-length scaling section; if it holds up, linear attention is one of the cheapest compute levers for multimodal pretraining.

paper.title: Is More Data Worth the Cost? Dataset Scaling Laws in a Tiny Attention-Only Decoder

summary.core_problem: 论文研究“更多训练数据是否值得其成本”，但刻意把问题缩小到一个可控的微型设置：使用强约束的 attention-only decoder（移除 MLP、冻结 embedding 与输出层）来隔离 dataset size 对性能的影响。核心问题是：在这种 tiny、组件隔离的 Transformer 中，数据规模是否仍呈现类似 Kaplan 等提出的 scaling-law 式平滑提升与边际收益递减？以及达到接近满数据性能需要多少数据？
summary.importance: 工业级 scaling law 往往同时扩大模型、数据与算力，难以归因；而在算力/数据受限的研究与原型阶段，理解“数据加到多少开始不划算”具有直接工程价值。该工作通过极简架构把学习能力主要限制在自注意力参数上，提供了一个更可解释的对照实验：在固定容量下，仅改变数据量，观察是否仍出现可预测的递减收益，并给出“用部分数据即可逼近满数据性能”的可操作结论。
summary.technical_approach:
（must_read 级别技术分析）
1) 受控架构设计：attention-only + 冻结表示层
- 基于 GPT-2 117M 的标准配置与 tokenizer，但只训练约 2.4M 参数：冻结 token embedding、positional embedding/或其组合（文中强调冻结 embedding 与输出投影），并移除每个 block 的 MLP 子层，使训练信号主要作用于 self-attention。
- 冻结输出层的动机：GPT-2 输出投影与输入 embedding 权重共享（weight tying）。冻结它们可固定词表表示空间，避免小数据下 embedding 适配主导学习、导致过拟合与不稳定，从而把差异更干净地归因到“注意力学到的上下文关系”。

2) 数据规模实验协议：幂次子集 + 多随机种子
- 训练数据使用从小到大的 2 的幂次子集（power-of-two subsets），覆盖约 0.1M 到 134M tokens，形成从强数据匮乏到接近常见 token/param 比启发式（如 Chinchilla 风格）的区间。
- 通过 token 分布分析与多 seed 实验检查子集代表性与结论稳健性。

3) 观测指标与 scaling-law 对齐
- 主要报告验证集 token-level accuracy（以及训练动态），观察随数据量增长的平滑提升与递减收益形态。
- 论文结论与 scaling law 的“幂律/平滑可预测”精神一致：性能随数据增加单调改善但边际收益下降。

（skim 级别概述）
- 用一个只训练注意力层的 tiny decoder，固定模型容量，逐步扩大训练 token 数。
- 发现性能随数据量平滑提升且递减收益明显；约用 30% 数据即可达到约 90% 的满数据验证准确率。
summary.experiments:
作者在固定 attention-only 架构下，训练多个数据子集规模并对比验证 token-level accuracy，得到：
- 随数据规模增大，性能提升平滑且呈现清晰的 diminishing returns。
- 经验性“性价比点”：约 30% 的训练数据即可达到约 90% 的 full-data 验证准确率。
- 通过 token 分布/代表性分析与多随机种子实验，验证趋势并非由某个子集抽样偶然性驱动（至少在该受控设置内）。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读建议：详细技术分析 + 重点章节/图表/创新点）
- Architecture 章节（尤其 3.1.1 冻结 embedding/输出层、3.1.2 移除 MLP）：这是“隔离数据规模效应”的关键实验设计，决定了结论适用边界。
- 实验设置章节：关注数据子集构造（power-of-two）、token/parameter ratio 覆盖范围、训练超参是否固定，以确认确实是“只变数据量”。
- 结果图表：
  1) 验证准确率 vs 数据规模（最好是 log-log 或随子集倍增的曲线），用于判断是否呈现 scaling-law 式平滑与递减收益。
  2) 多 seed 方差/置信区间图，判断结论稳健性。
  3) token 分布/代表性分析图表，确认子集抽样不会系统性偏置。
- 创新点抓手：
  1) 用 attention-only + 冻结表示层构造“组件隔离”的 scaling 实验台；
  2) 给出可操作的“部分数据达到大部分性能”的经验比例；
  3) 在 tiny regime 验证 scaling-law 形态仍可观察。

skim（泛读建议：方法概述 + 推荐看哪些部分）
- 先读 Introduction 把握问题动机（数据成本 vs 收益）。
- 快读 Architecture：理解为何冻结 embedding/输出层、为何移除 MLP。
- 直接看主要结果曲线与结论段：记住 30%→90% 的经验结论，以及“平滑提升+递减收益”的总体趋势。
summary.authors_note: 作者强调该研究的目标不是追求强基准性能，而是通过极简、可控的 attention-only 训练设置隔离变量，从而更清晰地观察数据规模带来的收益曲线。结论应被理解为“在固定容量、冻结表示、无 MLP 的 tiny 模型中”的数据性价比规律，而非直接等价于完整 LLM 预训练的最优数据配比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether more training data is worth its cost, but studies it in a deliberately controlled tiny setting: an attention-only decoder where embeddings and the output projection are frozen and MLP sublayers are removed. The central question is whether dataset-size scaling in this component-isolated Transformer still shows smooth improvements with clear diminishing returns (scaling-law-like behavior), and how much data is needed to approach full-data performance.
summary_en.importance: Most scaling-law studies operate at industrial scale and often co-scale model size, data, and compute, making causal attribution difficult. For compute- and data-constrained pretraining or prototyping, knowing when additional data yields diminishing returns is directly actionable. By constraining learning largely to self-attention parameters, this work provides a more interpretable testbed for isolating dataset-size effects under fixed capacity, and yields a practical “fraction of data for most of the performance” rule of thumb in this setting.
summary_en.technical_approach:
(must_read technical analysis)
1) Controlled architecture: attention-only + frozen representation layers
- Built on the GPT-2 117M design/tokenizer, but only ~2.4M parameters are trainable: token embeddings and the output projection are frozen, and MLP sublayers are removed so learning is concentrated in self-attention.
- Motivation for freezing: GPT-2 ties input embeddings and output projection weights. In tiny/data-limited regimes, training embeddings can dominate learning, cause rapid overfitting, and confound dataset-size effects. Freezing stabilizes optimization and keeps the representation space fixed.

2) Dataset scaling protocol: power-of-two subsets + robustness checks
- Train on progressively larger power-of-two token subsets spanning ~0.1M to 134M tokens, covering strongly data-limited regimes up to token/parameter ratios near common heuristics.
- Analyze subset representativeness via token-distribution checks and run multi-seed experiments to assess robustness.

3) Metrics and scaling-law alignment
- Track validation token-level accuracy (and training dynamics) as data increases, looking for smooth monotonic gains and diminishing returns consistent with scaling-law intuition.

(skim-level overview)
- Train a tiny decoder where only attention is learned, vary only dataset size.
- Observe smooth improvements with diminishing returns; ~30% of the data reaches ~90% of full-data validation accuracy.
summary_en.experiments:
Under a fixed attention-only architecture, the authors train across multiple dataset subset sizes and report validation token-level accuracy. Main findings:
- Performance improves smoothly with more data and exhibits clear diminishing returns.
- A practical efficiency point: using ~30% of the training data achieves ~90% of the full-data validation accuracy.
- Token-distribution analyses and multi-seed runs support that the observed trend is not driven by sampling artifacts (within this controlled setup).
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep dive)
- Architecture section (especially freezing embeddings/output and removing MLPs): this is the key design that isolates dataset-size effects and defines the scope of conclusions.
- Experimental setup: how power-of-two subsets are constructed, the covered token/parameter ratios, and whether hyperparameters are held constant to ensure only data size changes.
- Core result figures/tables:
  1) Validation accuracy vs dataset size curves (ideally across subset doublings) to assess smoothness and diminishing returns.
  2) Multi-seed variance/CI plots to judge robustness.
  3) Token distribution/representativeness analyses to rule out biased subsets.
- Innovations to extract:
  1) A component-isolated scaling testbed (attention-only + frozen representations);
  2) An actionable partial-data/near-saturation empirical rule;
  3) Evidence that scaling-law-like behavior can persist in tiny regimes.

skim (fast path)
- Read the Introduction for motivation (data cost vs benefit).
- Skim the Architecture rationale (why freeze embeddings/output; why remove MLPs).
- Jump to the main scaling curves and the conclusion highlighting the ~30%→~90% result and diminishing returns trend.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors frame the work as an interpretability- and control-oriented scaling study rather than a competitive LM benchmark. The conclusions should be interpreted as applying to a fixed-capacity, attention-only, frozen-representation tiny model, not as a direct prescription for full-scale LLM pretraining data-optimality.

recommendation.zh: 又一次 data scaling 验证，但用 attention-only 的极简 setup 做归因还算干净；只看数据量-性能曲线和“多少数据接近满配”的拐点结论即可。
recommendation.en: Another data-scaling check, but the attention-only constrained setup makes attribution cleaner; just read the data-size vs performance curves and the “fraction of data to near-saturation” takeaway.

paper.title: Generalization and Scaling Laws for Mixture-of-Experts Transformers

summary.core_problem: MoE Transformer 的“条件计算”带来一个核心理论缺口：误差/泛化/缩放到底应当由“每个输入实际激活的参数量（active capacity）”主导，还是由“总参数量 + 路由组合复杂度”主导？现有 dense scaling law 直接用总参数刻画会误配 MoE；而仅看 active 参数又忽略了路由模式数量带来的统计开销。
summary.importance: 该文试图给出一个可分解、可解释的 MoE 统计理论基线：把 MoE 的收益（按输入激活的容量更大/更专门化）与代价（路由模式的组合爆炸）在同一套覆盖数/泛化界中显式拆开。这样才能讨论：1）MoE 的逼近误差应如何随 active 参数缩放；2）泛化误差是否会因路由而显著变差；3）compute-optimal 训练在 MoE 下应如何耦合数据量与 active capacity。
summary.technical_approach:
（must_read 级别：详细技术分析）
1）模型与约束：分析一个受限但贴近实践的 MoE Transformer 类：固定深度/宽度子模块；确定性 top-k 路由；参数有界；路由族足够表达 k-sparse partition of unity。每层包含注意力/非专家参数 Π_attn 与 M 个专家（每个专家参数 Π_exp），每 token 至多激活 k 个专家，从而定义“active attention+expert budget”（核心是把统计复杂度用 active 参数计量）。
2）覆盖数分解（关键贡献）：先“条件化在固定路由模式上”分析函数类复杂度，再对所有可能路由模式做 union bound。由此得到 sup-norm covering-number 上界，其 metric entropy 由两部分相加：
  - 与 active 参数预算相关的项（类似 dense 网络，只是把总参数替换为 active 参数）；
  - MoE 特有的“路由组合开销”项（来自路由模式数量的对数因子/额外复杂度）。
  直观上：MoE 的统计复杂度 =（每次实际用到的网络容量）+（你允许模型在样本间切换多少种子网络/专家组合）。
3）在内在维度 d 的数据模型下做 ERM 泛化：采用 d 维 C^1 流形上的数据分布假设，目标函数属于 C^β(ℳ)。将上面的覆盖数界代入标准平方损失 ERM 的 uniform generalization 分析，得到“逼近误差 + 估计误差 + 路由开销”的三部分分解；其中逼近/估计的主导指数由内在维度 d 而非环境维度 D 决定。
4）构造性逼近定理：证明存在 MoE 架构在给定 active 参数预算下可达到经典的 C^β 在 d 维流形上的最小极大逼近速率，指数为 −2β/d（文中强调这是经典 minimax 指数）。这一步把“MoE 只要按 active 参数计量，就能恢复 dense 网络的逼近缩放”形式化。
5）缩放律结论：当以 active parameter budget 为横轴时，MoE 可恢复 dense 网络在 (d,β) 控制下的模型/数据/计算最优缩放指数；最坏情形下路由只额外引入对数级（log）开销。作者也明确指出：如果实证更好，通常来自数据依赖的路由稳定性/专家专门化等非最坏情形效应。
summary.experiments: 该论文主线为理论工作（覆盖数、逼近与泛化界、缩放律推导）。在给定的全文片段中未呈现系统实验部分；作者将结论定位为“保守的统计基线”，并强调与真实训练动力学/数据依赖路由行为可能存在差距。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读建议）
- 先读 Introduction：抓住三件事——active capacity vs routing combinatorics 的分离、内在维度 d 的动机、以及“保守基线”定位。
- 精读 MoE Model and Approximation Theory：
  1）Definition 3.1（MoE Transformer 类与 top-k 路由设定）；
  2）active attention+expert budget 的定义（这是后续所有缩放律的“横轴”）；
  3）Theorem 3.2（构造性逼近，指数 −2β/d，常数依赖关系）。
- 重点追踪“覆盖数分解”的证明结构：条件化固定路由 → 得到与 active 参数相关的 covering → 对路由模式 union bound → 路由开销项出现（通常是 log 级）。
- 泛化界部分建议对照三项分解：逼近项（由 β,d 与 active 参数决定）+ 估计项（由 n 与复杂度决定）+ 路由项（组合数/对数项）。
skim（泛读建议）
- 只看：Introduction（贡献列表）+ 逼近定理主结论（−2β/d）+ 泛化/缩放律的最终形式（强调“按 active 参数计量恢复 dense 指数，路由带 log 开销”）。
- 证明细节可跳过：覆盖数推导与 union bound 的技术细节只需理解其来源与为何是“额外对数项”。
summary.authors_note: 作者反复强调该理论是 worst-case 的 uniform generalization 基线：它能“认证”哪些缩放行为不依赖优化与数据依赖效应；若实践中 MoE 表现更优，往往需要用路由稳定性、专家专门化、结构偏置等更细的、非最坏情形分析来解释。

summary_en.core_problem: MoE Transformers introduce conditional computation: only a small subset of experts is active per token. The theoretical gap is how to separate (a) benefits driven by per-input active capacity from (b) statistical overhead induced by the combinatorics of routing patterns. Dense scaling laws based on total parameters mischaracterize MoE, while counting only active parameters ignores routing multiplicity.
summary_en.importance: The paper provides a conservative, optimization-agnostic statistical baseline for MoE: a clean decomposition of complexity/generalization into an active-parameter term plus a routing-combinatorial term. This enables principled discussions of (1) approximation scaling with active capacity, (2) how routing affects generalization, and (3) compute-optimal training laws coupling data size with active (not total) capacity.
summary_en.technical_approach:
(must_read: detailed technical analysis)
1) Model class and restrictions: The authors analyze a restricted yet practical MoE Transformer family: fixed depth/width submodules, deterministic top-k routing, uniformly bounded weights, and a routing family expressive enough to implement a k-sparse partition of unity. Each block has non-expert (attention) parameters Π_attn and M experts (each with Π_exp), with at most k experts active per token, leading to an explicit “active attention+expert budget”.
2) Metric-entropy (covering-number) decomposition: The key proof strategy is to condition on a fixed routing pattern, bound the sup-norm covering number for that conditioned class (scaling with active parameters), then union-bound over all routing patterns. This yields an additive decomposition of metric entropy into:
   - an active-parameter complexity term (dense-like once measured by active parameters), and
   - an MoE-specific routing overhead term (from the number of routing patterns, typically appearing as an extra logarithmic factor in worst case).
3) Uniform generalization under intrinsic dimension: Assuming data lie on a compact d-dimensional C^1 manifold and targets are C^β, the covering bound is plugged into a standard ERM analysis for squared loss. The resulting bound separates approximation, estimation, and routing contributions, with rates governed by intrinsic dimension d (not ambient D) and by active capacity.
4) Constructive approximation theorem: The paper proves existence of MoE architectures achieving the classical minimax approximation rate for C^β functions on a d-manifold, with exponent −2β/d, when expressed in terms of the active parameter budget.
5) Scaling-law implications: When plotted against active parameters, MoE recovers dense-network scaling exponents in (d,β) for model/data/compute-optimal regimes; routing contributes only an additional (worst-case) logarithmic overhead. Any sharper empirical gains are attributed to data-dependent routing stability/specialization beyond worst-case uniform bounds.
summary_en.experiments: The provided content indicates a primarily theoretical paper (covering numbers, approximation and generalization bounds, scaling-law consequences). No dedicated experimental section is visible in the supplied full-text excerpt; the authors explicitly position the results as a conservative statistical baseline rather than a tight predictor of training dynamics.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep reading)
- Introduction: focus on the three-way separation (active capacity vs routing combinatorics vs compute-optimal coupling) and the intrinsic-dimension motivation.
- MoE Model and Approximation Theory:
  1) Definition 3.1 (the analyzed MoE Transformer class and top-k routing),
  2) the definition of the active attention+expert budget (the main scaling axis),
  3) Theorem 3.2 (constructive approximation with rate exponent −2β/d and constant dependencies).
- Follow the covering-number proof blueprint: fix routing → cover conditioned class → union bound over routings → identify the routing overhead term.
- In the generalization section, track the final decomposition: approximation (β,d,active params) + estimation (n,complexity) + routing overhead (combinatorial/log term).
skim (quick reading)
- Read: Introduction (contribution bullets) + the main approximation rate statement (−2β/d) + the final generalization/scaling-law takeaway (“dense-like exponents vs active params; routing adds log overhead”).
- Skip: technical covering-number derivations and union-bound details unless you need the exact constants/entropy forms.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors stress these are worst-case uniform generalization guarantees—useful as a certified baseline independent of optimization. If practice is better, it likely comes from data-dependent routing stability, expert specialization, or architectural biases not captured by worst-case analysis.

recommendation.zh: 偏理论的 MoE 泛化界把 active capacity 和路由组合复杂度拆开，能帮你写 proposal/解释现象，但离可用的 compute-optimal 配方还有距离；读定理假设和结论式子就够。
recommendation.en: Theory-heavy MoE bounds that separate active capacity from routing combinatorics—handy for proposals and post-hoc explanations, but not yet a usable compute-optimal recipe; skim assumptions and final bound forms.
